Observed feedback drives policy or workflow improvement and conditional world-model adaptation, while component and compatibility checks govern the retention of updated policy-model pairs. Across diverse computational and scientific domains, RSI-Anything demonstrates substantial gains. In code repair, with the coder fixed, success increases from 26.3% with a static verifier to 29.2% through predictive selection and 31.2% after world-model adaptation, at comparable test usage. Graphical user interface (GUI) evaluations showed higher task completion, while average actions decrease by 39.4%. Across five successive policy versions, laboratory-planning scores more than double from 21.80% to 46.01%. In reaction optimization, RSI-Anything achieves 96.15% mean best observed yield versus 82.16% for Bayesian optimization under the same 40-experiment budget. An end-to-end immune-science application further connects workflow evolution and predictive modeling with therapeutic hypothesis generation. These results demonstrate how predictive world models and retained system updates enable recursive improvement across diverse environments.

Our main analysis compares Detection Transformer and Vision Transformer, which exhibit the most informative differences among the evaluated architectures. At the same time, results for Swin Transformer and Data-Efficient Image Transformer support the broader applicability of our framework. Our findings reveal gradual representational changes across transformer layers as a shared characteristic of Detection Transformer and Vision Transformer, as well as systematic differences in how they preserve contextual shape and fine-grained image details, and in their robustness to color perturbations. These findings deepen understanding of transformer-based vision models and demonstrate the utility of modular feature inversion as an interpretability tool.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies attention-head sufficiency signals and uses them to stop context processing dynamically, offering a mechanistic finding and an algorithmic efficiency contribution for LLMs. The QA setting involves answering queries, but the abstract does not describe advances in reasoning or compositional generalization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) process entire input contexts indiscriminately, which is inefficient when the information required to answer a query is localized within the context. We present dynamic context cutoff, a novel method enabling LLMs to self-terminate processing upon acquiring sufficient task-relevant information. Through analysis of model internals, we discover that specific attention heads inherently encode "sufficiency signals" -- detectable through lightweight classifiers -- that predict when critical information has been processed. This reveals a new efficiency paradigm: models' internal understanding naturally dictates processing needs rather than external compression heuristics. Comprehensive experiments across six QA datasets (up to 40K tokens) with three model families (LLaMA/Qwen/Mistral, 1B-70B) demonstrate 3.4% accuracy improvement while achieving 1.33x token reduction on average. Furthermore, our method demonstrates superior performance compared to other context efficiency methods at equivalent token reduction rates. Additionally, we observe an emergent scaling phenomenon: while smaller models require probing for sufficiency detection, larger models exhibit intrinsic self-assessment capabilities through prompting.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DeltaLLM’s main contribution is a training-free attention algorithm and FPGA dataflow that reuse keys and exploit structured sparsity for edge inference. This is a strong systems contribution; the reported accuracy and deployment results do not provide substantive insight into representations, compositionality, or reasoning.

    DeltaLLM 的主要贡献是一种免训练注意力算法和 FPGA 数据流，通过复用键并利用结构化稀疏性来实现边缘推理。这是一项显著的系统贡献；报告的准确率和部署结果并未对表征、组合性或推理提供实质性见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-device LLM inference is increasingly important for edge platforms but remains challenging due to high computational and memory demands and tight resource constraints. Modern applications often involve long prompts. Although compact models reduce linear-layer costs through weight compression, attention remains largely unoptimized and becomes the dominant bottleneck, especially during prefilling. Existing attention pruning methods primarily target highly parallel hardware (e.g., GPUs) and long context windows, limiting their suitability for edge scenarios. We present DeltaLLM, a training-free LLM framework based on algorithm-hardware-dataflow co-design to accelerate prefilling attention. DeltaLLM introduces a causal-attention-aware K-only delta formulation that enables Delta-Key reuse across query heads under Grouped-Query Attention (GQA). A context-aware hybrid strategy preserves exact attention near the diagonal while applying delta approximation to nonlocal regions. For score-value multiplication, we propose a vectorized structured sparse online softmax (VSSOS) that converts fine-grained spatial score sparsity into hardware-friendly column-level skipping. A specialized vector-processor architecture and unified sparse/dense attention dataflow exploit the resulting sparsity. Evaluated on BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T and LLaMA3.2-1B-Instruct, DeltaLLM achieves up to 60% Delta-Key sparsity and 63% structured attention-score sparsity with negligible average accuracy loss. On the KV260 FPGA board, it delivers a 1.62x speedup over TeLLMe-v2 while reducing DSP and BRAM usage. These results show that DeltaLLM supports efficient edge LLM deployment and integration with existing pipelines without fine-tuning.

    中文

    在边缘平台上进行设备端 LLM 推理日益重要，但由于计算和内存需求高、资源约束严格，这仍然颇具挑战。现代应用通常涉及较长的提示。尽管紧凑模型通过权重压缩降低了线性层的成本，注意力仍基本未经优化，并成为主要瓶颈，尤其是在预填充阶段。现有注意力剪枝方法主要面向高度并行的硬件（如 GPU）和长上下文窗口，因此不太适合边缘场景。我们提出 DeltaLLM，这是一种基于算法、硬件与数据流协同设计的免训练 LLM 框架，用于加速预填充阶段的注意力计算。DeltaLLM 引入一种感知因果注意力的仅 K 增量公式，使分组查询注意力（GQA）下的查询头能够复用 Delta-Key。一种感知上下文的混合策略在对角线附近保留精确注意力，同时对非局部区域应用增量近似。对于分数与值的乘法，我们提出向量化结构化稀疏在线 softmax（VSSOS），将细粒度的空间分数稀疏性转化为硬件友好的列级跳过。专用的向量处理器架构以及统一的稀疏/稠密注意力数据流能够利用由此产生的稀疏性。在 BitNet-b1.58-2B-4T 和 LLaMA3.2-1B-Instruct 上的评估中，DeltaLLM 实现了最高 60% 的 Delta-Key 稀疏率和 63% 的结构化注意力分数稀疏率，平均准确率损失可以忽略不计。在 KV260 FPGA 板卡上，相较 TeLLMe-v2，它实现了 1.62 倍的加速，同时减少了 DSP 和 BRAM 的使用量。这些结果表明，DeltaLLM 无需微调即可支持高效的边缘 LLM 部署，并能集成到现有流水线中。

    WorldTest and AutumnBench evaluate whether learned world models support varied environment-level queries, including reachability and counterfactuals, and report a human-model gap linked to exploration and belief updating.     WorldTest 和 AutumnBench 评估学习到的世界模型是否支持多种环境级查询，包括可达性和反事实，并报告了人类与模型之间的差距，且将其与探索和信念更新联系起来。这实质性地聚焦于智能体推理和世界模型评估，并通过跨查询类型的泛化与组合性有一定关联；它没有研究内部表征，也没有引入智能体系统机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models are central to building AI agents capable of flexible reasoning and planning. Yet current evaluations (i) test only properties measurable from observed interactions, such as next-frame prediction or task return, and (ii) do not test whether a learned model supports diverse queries about the environment. In contrast, humans build $\textit{general-purpose}$ models that can answer many different questions about an environment$\unicode{x2014}$including questions that require understanding global structure and counterfactual consequences. We propose $\textit{WorldTest}$: a protocol for evaluating whether agents learn models that support multiple $\textit{environment-level queries}\unicode{x2014}$questions whose answers depend on properties of the full environment, not just observed trajectories. Individually, these queries can target properties (e.g., reachability or the effects of interventions) that no single rollout distribution determines. Collectively, they assess model generality across query types. We instantiate WorldTest as $\textit{AutumnBench}$, a benchmark of 43 interactive grid-world environments and 129 tasks across three query families for both humans and learning agents. Experiments with 517 human participants and five frontier models show that humans substantially outperform these models, a gap we attribute to differences in exploration and belief updating. AutumnBench provides a framework for evaluating world-model learning in grid-world environments with environment-level queries, and WorldTest provides a template for extending such evaluations to richer domains.

    Lars Lorch, Jiaqi Zhang, Charlotte Bunne, Andreas Krause, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Caroline Uhler

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a diffusion model and causal linearization method that recover gene-level causal effects and regulatory modules, offering mechanistic insight into how biological responses are structured. Predicting unseen perturbation combinations supports compositional generalization, but this is secondary to causal modeling.

    该论文提出一种扩散模型和因果线性化方法，用于恢复基因层面的因果效应和调控模块，从而深入揭示生物响应的结构。预测未见过的扰动组合支持组合泛化，但这只是次要贡献，核心仍是因果建模。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Perturbation screens hold the potential to systematically map regulatory processes at single-cell resolution, yet modeling and predicting transcriptome-wide responses to perturbations remains a major computational challenge. Existing methods often underperform simple baselines, fail to disentangle measurement noise from biological signal, and provide limited insight into the causal structure governing cellular responses. Here, we present the latent causal diffusion (LCD), a generative model that frames single-cell gene expression as a stationary diffusion process observed under measurement noise. LCD outperforms established approaches in predicting the distributional shifts of unseen perturbation combinations in single-cell RNA-sequencing screens while simultaneously learning a mechanistic dynamical system of gene regulation. To interpret these learned dynamics, we develop an approach we call causal linearization via perturbation responses (CLIPR), which yields an approximation of the direct causal effects between all genes modeled by the diffusion. CLIPR provably identifies causal effects under a linear drift assumption and recovers causal structure in both simulated systems and a genome-wide perturbation screen, where it clusters genes into coherent functional modules and resolves causal relationships that standard differential expression analysis cannot. The LCD-CLIPR framework bridges generative modeling with causal inference to predict unseen perturbation effects and map the underlying regulatory mechanisms of the transcriptome.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn code generation typically relies on online reinforcement learning (RL), in which models learn from repeatedly generated online rollouts. Although effective, online RL can be costly and unstable. In this paper, we present contextual bandit learning with offline trajectories (COBALT), a simple method that reuses offline multi-turn trajectories to efficiently train LLMs for multi-turn code generation. Building on the observation that multi-turn code generation is a one-step recoverable Markov decision process, COBALT first collects code generation trajectories using a reference LLM and divides them into partial trajectories. Then, during online bandit learning, the LLM is trained to complete each partial trajectory through single-step code generation. On LiveCodeBench, COBALT substantially improves R1-Distill 8B and Qwen3 8B by up to 9.0 and 6.2 absolute Pass@1 points and matches the performance of two multi-turn online RL baselines using GRPO and VeRPO. We also perform a perturbation-based analysis of in-context reward hacking and show that Cobalt can improve robustness to misleading execution feedback. Overall, our results demonstrate that Cobalt is a promising solution for multi-turn code generation. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/OSU-NLP-Group/cobalt.

    训练大型语言模型（LLM）进行多轮代码生成通常依赖在线强化学习（RL），模型通过反复生成在线 rollout 来学习。尽管效果良好，在线 RL 的成本可能很高，而且不稳定。本文提出基于离线轨迹的上下文赌博机学习（COBALT），这是一种简单的方法，通过复用离线多轮轨迹来高效训练 LLM 进行多轮代码生成。COBALT 基于这样一个观察：多轮代码生成是一个单步可恢复的马尔可夫决策过程。它首先使用参考 LLM 收集代码生成轨迹，并将其拆分为部分轨迹。随后，在在线赌博机学习期间，模型通过单步代码生成来完成每条部分轨迹。在 LiveCodeBench 上，COBALT 使 R1-Distill 8B 和 Qwen3 8B 分别最多提升 9.0 和 6.2 个 Pass@1 绝对百分点，并达到使用 GRPO 和 VeRPO 的两个多轮在线 RL 基线的性能。我们还通过基于扰动的分析研究上下文内奖励劫持，并表明 Cobalt 能够提高对误导性执行反馈的鲁棒性。总体而言，我们的结果表明，Cobalt 是一种有前景的多轮代码生成解决方案。我们的代码和数据可在 https://github.com/OSU-NLP-Group/cobalt 获取。

    Recent multi-agent frameworks have shown promise for oncology decision support, yet most assume centralized data access and rely on prompt-based assignment, limiting their applicability in privacy-sensitive clinical settings. We propose Contribution-Aware Medical Multi-Agents (CoMMa), a decentralized LLM-agent framework where specialists operate on partitioned clinical data streams. Unlike prior approaches that share inputs across agents, CoMMa enforces data decentralization to include stronger role specialization and further enhances this via agent-specific finetuning. To enable reliable and interpretable coordination, we introduce a contribution-aware aggregation mechanism that replaces stochastic, narrative-based reasoning with deterministic embedding projections to approximate each agent's marginal utility. This yields explicit credit assignment over agents, providing a stable and interpretable decision pathway aligned with clinical requirements.     As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents, existing safety evaluations face a fundamental trade-off: manual benchmarks are costly, while LLM-based simulators are scalable but suffer from logic hallucination. We present AutoControl Arena, an automated framework for frontier AI risk evaluation built on the principle of logic-narrative decoupling. By grounding deterministic state in executable code while delegating generative dynamics to LLMs, we mitigate hallucination while maintaining flexibility. This principle, instantiated through a three-agent framework, achieves over 98% end-to-end success and 60% human preference over existing simulators. To elicit latent risks, we vary environmental Stress and Temptation across X-Bench (70 scenarios, 7 risk categories). Evaluating 9 frontier models reveals: (1) Alignment Illusion: risk rates surge from 21.7% to 54.5% under pressure, with capable models showing disproportionately larger increases; (2) Scenario-Specific Safety Scaling: advanced reasoning improves robustness for direct harms but worsens it for gaming scenarios; and (3) Divergent Misalignment Patterns: weaker models cause non-malicious harm while stronger models develop strategic concealment. Code and data are available at https://github.com/CosmosYi/AutoControl-Arena.

    ENGLISH

    Vision Language Models (VLMs) offer the exciting possibility of processing text as rendered images, bypassing the need for tokenizing the text into long token sequences. Since VLM image encoders map fixed-size images to a fixed number of visual tokens, varying rendering resolution provides a fine-grained compression knob. However, accuracy deteriorates quickly as compression increases: characters shrink below the vision encoder's effective resolution, making them indistinguishable. To address this, we propose LensVLM, an inference framework and post-training recipe that enables VLMs to scan compressed images, then selectively expand only the relevant images to their uncompressed form via learned tools. Building on Qwen3.5-9B-Base, LensVLM maintains accuracy comparable to the full-text upper bound at 4.3$\times$ effective compression and outperforms retrieval-based, text- and visual-compression baselines up to 10.1$\times$ effective compression across seven text QA benchmarks. LensVLM also generalizes to multimodal document and code understanding tasks, with the accuracy gain over baselines growing as compression increases. Our analysis validates this approach: training makes visual compression robust to rendering choices, and as compression grows the model increasingly relies on expanded content rather than unreliable visual reading. The analysis also yields practical tool-choice guidance: text expansion is preferable for rendered text, while high-resolution image expansion suits native documents whose layout cues carry task-relevant information.

    ENGLISH

    Existing accounts of grokking explain the phenomena in terms of mechanistic frameworks such as circuit efficiency or lazy-to-rich transitions. However, despite a known dependence between grokking and model size, how model capacity shapes grokking remains an open question. We give an information-theoretic account of this relationship on the task of modular arithmetic, showing that grokking does not immediately occur when a model becomes large enough to memorise the training set, but rather emerges as the outcome of a competition between two measurable timescales: a memorisation speed $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$ and a generalisation speed $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$, both of which are functions of model parameter count $P$. Adapting the information capacity framework of Morris et al. (2025), we estimate $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$ on random-label data of equivalent complexity and $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$ on the modular task itself, and show that grokking emerges close to the parameter scale where these timescales intersect. The framework also suggests an empirical model for predicting memorisation speed given model capacity and dataset complexity, recovering the previously reported empirical observation that larger models memorise faster. Overall, we motivate the formalisation of different learning timescales as important abstractions to study when explaining how model capacity shapes grokking on algorithmic tasks.

(2025) 的信息容量框架，在复杂度相当的随机标签数据上估计 $T_{\text{mem}}(P)$，并在模运算任务本身上估计 $T_{\text{gen}}(P)$；结果表明，grokking 出现在这两个时间尺度交汇附近的参数规模。该框架还提出了一个经验模型，可根据模型容量和数据集复杂度预测记忆速度，并复现了此前报告的经验观察：较大的模型记忆得更快。总之，我们主张将不同学习时间尺度形式化为重要的抽象概念，以研究如何解释模型容量对算法任务中 grokking 的影响。

    Self-evolving language-model agents must decide what to learn next and how to preserve what they have learned across iterations. Existing systems typically carry this cross-iteration knowledge as natural-language feedback, flat episodic memory, or implicit reinforcement signals, none of which cleanly supports a frozen weak backbone at inference time. This paper introduces MAGE (Multi-Agent Graph-guided Evolution), a framework that externalizes self-knowledge into a four-subgraph co-evolutionary knowledge graph. Its experience subgraph stores both teacher-written failure corrections and the learner's own past correct reasoning traces, which are retrieved as task-conditioned guidance for a frozen execution model. During evolution, the graph, a task-level search bandit, and a skill-level routing bandit are updated from the same reward stream, while the learner's backbone remains unchanged. We further provide structural analysis showing how append-only memory growth, bounded curriculum coverage, and task-filtered retrieval together support stable improvement of the retrieval substrate for frozen-learner evolution. Ablations show that self-harvested success traces and teacher-written corrections are complementary, with success memories contributing most on reasoning-template-heavy tasks and corrective memories supporting harder composition and interaction settings. Existing methods often rely on retrieval to recover information discarded during memory overwriting, but remain vulnerable to evidence loss during memory formation and interference from invalid queries. To overcome these limitations, we propose MemReread. Built upon streaming reading, it circumvents intermediate retrieval, triggering question decomposition and targeted rereading when the final memory is insufficient. By recovering indirect evidence that may have been prematurely discarded, MemReread enables non-linear reasoning while preserving the logical flow of document comprehension. We further introduce a reinforcement learning framework that improves length extrapolation and adaptively determines the number of rereading passes according to task complexity, enabling flexible control of computational overhead.     Xiaolin Zhou, Aojie Yuan, Zheng Luo, Zipeng Ling, Xixiao Pan, Yicheng Gao, Haiyue Zhang, Jiate Li, Shuli Jiang, Prince Zizhuang Wang, Zixuan Zhu, Jinbo Liu, Ryan A. Rossi, Hua Wei, and Xiyang Hu

    The paper introduces a benchmark for tool-agent robustness to deployment failures and an RL domain-randomization recipe that improves performance, including transfer to unseen runtime perturbations. Agent robustness and retry behavior make this a strong Systems contribution, while RL is used for robustness rather than advancing reasoning mechanisms.

    本文提出了一个基准，用于评估工具智能体对部署故障的鲁棒性，并提出一种能够提升性能、包括迁移到未见运行时扰动的 RL 领域随机化方案。智能体鲁棒性和重试行为使其成为一项重要的系统贡献；而 RL 用于提升鲁棒性，并非用于推进推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-use language agents are evaluated on benchmarks that assume clean inputs, unambiguous tool registries, and reliable APIs. Real deployments violate all these assumptions: user typos propagate into hallucinated tool names, a misconfigured request timeout can stall an agent indefinitely, and duplicate tool names across servers can freeze an SDK. We study these failures as a sim-to-real gap in the tool-use partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP), where deployment noise enters through the observation, action space, reward-relevant metadata, or transition dynamics. We introduce RobustBench-TC, a benchmark with 22 perturbation types organized by these four POMDP components, each grounded in a verified GitHub issue or documented tool-calling failure. Across 21 models from 1.5B to 32B parameters (including the closed-source o4-mini), the robustness profile is sharply uneven: observation perturbations reduce accuracy by less than 5%, while reward-relevant and transition perturbations reduce accuracy by roughly 40% and 30%, respectively; scale alone does not close these gaps. We then propose ToolRL-DR, a domain-randomization reinforcement learning (RL) recipe that trains a tool-use agent on perturbation-augmented trajectories spanning the three statically encodable POMDP components. On a 3B backbone, ToolRL-DR-Full retains roughly three-quarters of clean accuracy and reaches an aggregate perturbed accuracy comparable to open-source 14B function-calling baselines while substantially narrowing the gap to o4-mini. It closes approximately 27% of the Transition gap despite never seeing transition perturbations in training, suggesting that RL on adversarial static tool-use inputs induces a more persistent retry policy that transfers to unseen runtime failures. The dataset, code and benchmark leaderboard are publicly available.

    本文研究教师刷新计划如何影响自我在线策略蒸馏的稳定性，并提出一种巩固门控刷新规则及用于诊断坍塌的方法。这为训练动态和面向学习的自适应优化提供了重要证据，但摘要并未直接分析内部表征或组合能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self on-policy distillation trains a student policy against a teacher derived from its own parameter history, yet the teacher's update schedule -- which governs the \emph{temporal coupling} between teacher and student -- has not been systematically studied as a stability variable. Through a controlled schedule sweep on Qwen3-8B, we establish that \emph{isolation periods}, defined as complete teacher freezing between updates, are the key structural property enabling stable learning, not teacher age. To characterize these underlying training dynamics, we introduce a diagnostic framework of temporal KL structure, refresh shock, and length-tail risk. This framework further uncovers \emph{state-oblivious collapse}: optimal short-horizon fixed schedules catastrophically fail under long-horizon training because a clock-driven refresh can copy a transiently drifting student into the teacher in a single, irreversible step. This failure mode is invisible under short-horizon evaluation and mechanistically distinct from EMA's chronic contamination. To address this, we propose \emph{Consolidation-Gated Teacher Refresh} (CGTR), which preserves isolation periods while gating each refresh on joint evidence of reward improvement and length-tail safety, ensuring every teacher movement responds to genuine student consolidation rather than a clock signal. With a single shared parameter set and no per-dataset retuning, CGTR achieves \textbf{zero collapse} and the best final score on all four tasks (Chemistry, Biology, Physics, ToolUse), self-regulating its refresh frequency to each task's learning dynamics.

Existing methods usually manage this trade-off with handcrafted heuristics, confining generation to known priors and overlooking underexplored patterns. While recent open-ended agentic evolution can push this limit, unconstrained general agents lack strict simulator grounding and tend to collapse the multi-objective tension into single-scalar maximization. Here we present EvoDrive, the first automated, LLM-based agentic evolution framework for multi-objective scenario generation. EvoDrive employs a simulator-grounded actor-critic architecture where a memory-driven actor iteratively proposes improvements to the generators and critics filter out implausible candidates, and a self-evolving world evaluator routes promising proposals to optimize simulation budgets. EvoDrive further maintains a Pareto archive of evaluated candidates to preserve diverse attack-realism trade-offs and guide future evolution via simulation feedback. Benchmark results on MetaDrive and CARLA show that EvoDrive not only significantly expands the Pareto frontier across various generators, but also produces valuable scenarios for policy training.

    Modern video diffusion models generate increasingly realistic and temporally coherent videos, motivating their use as candidate world simulators. Yet it remains unclear whether these models internally encode physical structure, or merely reproduce motion patterns seen during training. To obtain such trajectories, we approximately invert the deterministic sampling process by integrating the learned velocity field backward from a clean video latent to noise, giving access to the model's intermediate states and attention maps. Using these recovered trajectories, we show that physical plausibility is linearly decodable from diffusion transformer states across IntPhys and InfLevel, reaching around 81.27% average accuracy and outperforming dedicated representation-learning baselines such as V-JEPA and VideoMAE.     Choosing whether to replace a single-agent controller requires evidence on both task performance and inference expenditure. We present BenchAgent, a shared evaluation framework, and compare six multi-agent workflow configurations against its single-agent reference, BenchAgent Core, across ten reasoning, coding, and tool-use benchmarks. All configurations use GPT-4.1 and common tool and scoring interfaces; Core executions share the same step limits. We measure accuracy and recorded token use over three runs on fixed task sets, with 3,302 instances per configuration per run. EvoAgent reaches 79.70% mean pooled accuracy versus 76.65% for Core and exceeds Core in all three runs; the other five MAS trail by 1.71-8.76 percentage points.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a mathematical measure of how topological invariants of learned representations transfer across tasks, with exact results and experiments on encoders and image models. This substantially advances analysis of representation structure, while its task-change framework offers a more limited connection to composition; it does not study reasoning or model and agent systems.

    本文为学习表征的拓扑不变量如何跨任务迁移建立了一种数学度量，并给出了精确结果以及对编码器和图像模型的实验。这显著推进了对表征结构的分析；其任务变化框架与组合性有较有限的联系，但并未研究推理或模型及智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a learned representation is reused for a new task, which of its structure should survive? A task is a small category, a change of task is a functor $J$, and the invariants of a trained representation form a functor $F$. The left Kan extension $\operatorname{Lan}_JF$ is the invariant that the source and the change of task force on the target: by its universal property, every comparison of the source with an observed target invariant factors through it. The transfer discrepancy is the largest distance, over the target objects, between this extension and the observed invariant. For persistent homology the extension is a cokernel over comma categories, and a functorial version of the discrepancy, which also compares the maps between target objects, is $1$-Lipschitz under interleavings. On finite samples the discrepancy is a bottleneck distance, computed without approximation. For data glued from two pieces whose exclusive parts lie farther apart than the filtration scale, a Mayer-Vietoris sequence identifies what extending homology loses, while extending chains loses nothing. For a merge of labelled point clouds, the degree-zero discrepancy vanishes if and only if some $1$-Lipschitz classifier has a margin above the filtration scale at every sample point. In experiments on sampled manifolds, trained encoders and pretrained image models, every exact prediction holds on every sample. The discrepancy of truncated invariants recovers a hidden merge of separated parts far above chance and tells the intended target of a merge from a permuted control, but across pretrained models it does not track the accuracy of a linear probe.

    中文

    当学习到的表征被用于新任务时，它的哪些结构应该保留下来？任务是一个小范畴，任务变化是一个函子$J$，而训练所得表征的不变量构成一个函子$F$。左 Kan 延拓$\operatorname{Lan}_JF$是源端与任务变化共同强加于目标端的不变量：根据其泛性质，源端与观测到的目标不变量之间的每一种比较，都可以通过它分解。迁移差异度是该延拓与观测到的不变量之间、在目标对象上取最大值的距离。对于持续同调，该延拓是逗号范畴上的余核；而差异度的函子性版本还会比较目标对象之间的映射，并且在交错意义下是$1$-Lipschitz 的。在有限样本上，差异度就是瓶颈距离，无需近似即可计算。对于由两部分粘合而成、且各自独有部分之间的距离大于过滤尺度的数据，Mayer-Vietoris 序列揭示了延拓同调所丢失的信息，而延拓链则不会丢失任何信息。对于带标签点云的合并，当且仅当存在某个$1$-Lipschitz 分类器，使其在每个样本点上的间隔都大于过滤尺度时，零阶差异度才为零。在对采样流形、训练所得编码器和预训练图像模型进行的实验中，每一条精确预测都在每个样本上成立。截断不变量的差异度能以远高于随机猜测的水平恢复分离部分的隐藏合并，并能从置换对照中识别合并的预期目标；但在不同预训练模型之间，它并不能反映线性探测器的准确率。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Medical agent systems are increasingly expected to support interactive clinical decision making rather than only static question answering. In such settings, effective agents must reuse prior experience across evolving cases, yet existing memory mechanisms often retain raw historical traces that are redundant, noisy, and difficult to govern. More importantly, they rarely distinguish which memories are truly useful for future reasoning. This limits their ability to accumulate compact and reliable experience for long-horizon clinical reasoning. To close this gap, we propose SkeMex, a post-deployment self-evolution framework that improves medical agents through a skill-based memory without updating model weights. SkeMex distills informative interaction trajectories into structured skills that encode reusable procedural knowledge, and organizes them into a multi-branch repository spanning general, task-specific, and action-level experience. To determine which memories should be reused and retained, SkeMex estimates context-dependent utility from environment feedback and uses it to guide value-aware retrieval and repository governance. A closed-loop ``Read--Write--Assess--Govern" lifecycle further supports continual evolution by writing new skills, updating utilities, promoting useful memories, and removing harmful entries. Experiments across diverse clinical tasks show that SkeMex consistently outperforms representative memory-based agents in both offline and online settings. It also generalizes across model backbones and supports transferable skill memory. All data and code will be released publicly.

    Objective: To enhance the accuracy, interpretability, and robustness of large language models (LLMs) in medical question answering (MedQA). Method: We designed a multi-agent peer-reviewed reasoning method in which multiple LLM agents independently generate chain-of-thought reasoning with candidate answers, then act as peer reviewers to evaluate each other's reasoning for factual correctness and logical soundness. The highest-rated reasoning chain is selected to produce the final answer. The method also scaled effectively with more participating models, while peer assessments reliably distinguished high- from low-quality reasoning chains. Conclusion: The proposed multi-agent peer-reviewed reasoning method enables LLMs to act as both solvers and evaluators, yielding superior performance in MedQA. By emphasizing reasoning quality rather than answer agreement alone, this approach improves accuracy, interpretability, and robustness, offering a promising direction for trustworthy biomedical AI systems.

    Multi-turn tool-use agents must reason, call tools, and adapt to observations across several interaction turns. Post-training such agents is challenging, as reinforcement learning often suffers from sparse rewards and weak credit assignment despite matching the prompt-only inference setting, while supervised fine-tuning on expert traces provides dense process supervision but can over-constrain the model to fixed trajectories. To tackle this, we propose PACT, a Privileged trAce Co-Training framework for multi-turn tool-use agents. The key idea is to use expert traces only as training-time optimization signals rather than rollout-time hints. PACT keeps rollout generation prompt-only, then uses expert traces to guide optimization through two complementary signals: a trace-conditioned RL surrogate that evaluates prompt-only rollouts under expert-trace context, and a component-aware SFT loss that provides annealed process supervision over reasoning and tool-call components. To reduce over-reliance on the training-only trace context, PACT incorporates prompt-only anchoring with standard prompt-only RL updates. Experiments on FTRL, BFCL, and ToolHop show that PACT consistently outperforms strong SFT- and RL-based baselines. Further analyses support the complementarity of the two training objectives and the benefits of component-aware supervision and prompt-only anchoring. These results highlight the effectiveness of privileged trace co-training for multi-turn tool-use learning. The project page is available at https://zhenbangdu.github.io/pact-project-page.

    多轮工具使用智能体必须进行推理、调用工具，并在多轮交互中根据观察结果调整行为。对此类智能体进行后训练颇具挑战：尽管强化学习符合仅基于提示的推理设置，但常常面临奖励稀疏和信用分配薄弱的问题；而在专家轨迹上进行监督微调虽能提供密集的过程监督，却可能过度限制模型，使其遵循固定轨迹。为此，我们提出 PACT，即面向多轮工具使用智能体的特权轨迹协同训练框架。其核心思想是仅将专家轨迹用作训练时的优化信号，而非生成轨迹时的提示。PACT 保持生成轨迹时仅使用提示，然后通过两种互补信号利用专家轨迹引导优化：一种是轨迹条件化的 RL 替代目标，它在专家轨迹上下文中评估仅基于提示生成的轨迹；另一种是组件感知的 SFT 损失，它对推理和工具调用组件提供逐步退火的过程监督。为减少对仅在训练期间提供的轨迹上下文的过度依赖，PACT 还结合了仅基于提示的锚定机制，并采用标准的仅基于提示的 RL 更新。在 FTRL、BFCL 和 ToolHop 上的实验表明，PACT 持续优于强大的 SFT 和 RL 基线。进一步分析支持这两种训练目标的互补性，也证实了组件感知监督和仅基于提示锚定的益处。这些结果凸显了特权轨迹协同训练在多轮工具使用学习中的有效性。项目页面见 https://zhenbangdu.github.io/pact-project-page。

    Bistable by Construction: Wall-Clock-Calibrated State Monitors Have No Moment-Detection Regime at Agent Cadence

    由构造而成的双稳态：经墙钟时间校准的状态监视器在智能体运行节奏下不存在时刻检测区间

    Manvendra Modgil

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how time calibration changes runtime-monitor behavior on agent streams, finding that wall-clock leaky integrators fail as moment detectors while sample-time CUSUM is cadence-invariant. This is a substantial insight for agent monitoring, but it does not study model internals, composition, or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文分析时间校准方式如何改变智能体数据流上的运行时监视器行为，发现按墙钟时间计时的泄漏积分器无法充当时刻检测器，而按采样时间计算的 CUSUM 不受运行节奏影响。这对智能体监控提供了重要洞见，但并未研究模型内部机制、组合性或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Runtime monitors for autonomous agents commonly threshold an accumulated internal state - a behavioural baseline, a drift statistic, or, in our prior work, a modelled affective state. We previously reported a State Saturation Trap: threshold-on-state triggers over a continuous affect engine become near-constant alarms on SWE-bench debugging agents (Modgil 2026). A post-release audit found the engine received dt=0 between actions, so its exponential decay never operated: the published trap is a pure-accumulator result. We correct the record (erratum, v2) and treat the flaw as an experiment. The key variable it exposes is whether a monitor's dynamics are calibrated in sample time (per observation, as in CUSUM) or wall-clock time (half-lives in seconds, as in affect models and EMA baselines). On fixed-rate streams these coincide; on agent streams, where inter-action time varies by orders of magnitude, they do not. A pre-registered sweep over uniform intervals (dt in {0..600}s) on 20 trajectories shows the wall-clock level trigger has two regimes: at dt<=1s a constant alarm (20/20; median 18 firings); at dt>=60s silent. Every critical dt lies in (1,30]s. A scriptable gpt-5.4-mini agent loop measures latency at median 1.53s (p90 2.33s), inside the trap regime, vindicating the empirical finding under a corrected mechanism. The structure is a property of the calibration class, not the engine: a minimal wall-clock accumulator over the raw error stream reproduces the same cliff, while a sample-time CUSUM over the identical stream is exactly dt-invariant (20/20). A rising-edge trigger with hysteresis fires 0-3 times per trajectory in every condition. We conclude that wall-clock-calibrated leaky-integrator monitors admit no regime in which they act as moment detectors on agent streams; transition detection escapes the trap at every cadence, but does not recover human intervention timing.

    中文

    自主智能体的运行时监视器通常会对累积的内部状态设定阈值，例如行为基线、漂移统计量，或我们此前工作中的建模情感状态。我们先前报告了“状态饱和陷阱”：在 SWE-bench 调试智能体上，对连续情感引擎的状态设阈触发会变成近乎持续的警报（Modgil 2026）。发布后的审计发现，该引擎在动作之间收到的 dt=0，因此指数衰减从未运行：已发表的陷阱结果其实是纯累加器的结果。我们更正了记录（勘误，v2），并将这个缺陷作为一项实验来处理。它揭示的关键变量是：监视器的动态是按采样时间（每次观察更新，如 CUSUM）还是按墙钟时间（以秒计的半衰期，如情感模型和 EMA 基线）校准。对于固定频率数据流，两者一致；而对于智能体数据流，由于动作间隔可能相差几个数量级，两者并不一致。对 20 条轨迹按预注册方案扫描均匀间隔（dt ∈ {0..600}s）的结果显示，墙钟时间的电平触发器有两种工作区间：dt<=1s 时持续报警（20/20；触发次数中位数为 18），dt>=60s 时则保持静默。所有临界 dt 均位于 (1,30]s。一个可编写脚本的 gpt-5.4-mini 智能体循环测得延迟中位数为 1.53s（p90 为 2.33s），处于陷阱区间内；这表明在修正机制后，实证发现仍然成立。该结构是校准类别的属性，而非引擎本身：对原始误差流采用一个最小化的墙钟时间累加器，也会重现相同的断崖；而对同一误差流使用按采样时间计算的 CUSUM，则完全不受 dt 影响（20/20）。在每种条件下，带滞后的上升沿触发器每条轨迹触发 0–3 次。我们的结论是，按墙钟时间校准的泄漏积分器监视器在智能体数据流上不存在能够充当时刻检测器的工作区间；转变检测在所有运行节奏下都能避开这一陷阱，但无法恢复人工干预时机。

    Decoupling the Declarative from the Procedural in Vision-Language-Action Models

    解耦视觉-语言-动作模型中的陈述性知识与程序性知识

    Nikolaos Tsagkas, Andreas Sochopoulos, Chris Xiaoxuan Lu, Oisin Mac Aodha, Alexandros Kouris

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper restructures a VLA’s information flow to decouple declarative concepts from procedural skills, enabling interpretable modular representations and transfer to unseen objects. This directly advances representation organization and compositional transfer, while robot skill execution alone offers only an incidental connection to reasoning and system design.

    本文重新设计 VLA 的信息流，以将陈述性概念与程序性技能解耦，从而实现可解释的模块化表征，并迁移到未见物体。这直接推进了表征组织和组合迁移；机器人技能执行本身与推理和系统设计仅有间接关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deploying generalist robotic agents in the real world requires transferable skills. Specifically, a policy trained to clone a behavior from object-specific demonstrations must generalize beyond that object, otherwise data collection requirements become intractable. Recently, fine-tuning of pre-trained billion-parameter Vision-Language Models (VLMs), initially on large-scale robot datasets and then on fewer scenario-specific demonstrations, has emerged as the predominant paradigm for designing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. While these policies achieve state-of-the-art manipulation performance in-distribution, they remain brittle to minor spatial, semantic, and task variations. In this work, we address the inability of current models to decouple the declarative (i.e., concepts and entity semantics) from the procedural knowledge (i.e., how to do something) encoded in their parameters, which is a fundamental bottleneck for zero-shot skill transfer to novel objects. To address this, we propose w$^{2}$VLA, a new VLA model with restructured information flow. Rather than feeding all multimodal tokens from the VLM encoder into a large, opaque transformer-based action expert, our approach modulates the robot state sequence with visual, spatial, and skill information in a compositional and interpretable manner. Unlike popular, state-of-the-art VLAs, we show that our modular approach successfully decouples knowledge representations, enabling robust behavior cloning and unprecedented zero-shot skill transfer capabilities across dissimilar, unseen objects.

    中文

    要在现实世界中部署通用机器人智能体，就需要可迁移的技能。具体而言，若一个策略通过克隆针对特定物体的示范来训练，就必须能够泛化到该物体之外，否则数据收集需求将变得难以承受。近年来，设计视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的主流范式已发展为：先在大规模机器人数据集上微调预训练的十亿参数视觉-语言模型（VLM），再使用数量较少的场景特定示范进行微调。尽管这些策略在分布内操作任务上达到最先进水平，但面对细微的空间、语义和任务变化时仍然脆弱。在这项工作中，我们针对当前模型的一个缺陷：它们无法将参数中编码的陈述性知识（即概念和实体语义）与程序性知识（即如何完成某件事）解耦；这构成了向新物体进行零样本技能迁移的根本瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出 w$^{2}$VLA，一种重新设计信息流的新型 VLA 模型。我们的方法并非将 VLM 编码器输出的所有多模态 token 都输入一个庞大且不透明的基于 Transformer 的动作专家，而是以组合且可解释的方式，利用视觉、空间和技能信息调节机器人状态序列。与流行的最先进 VLA 不同，我们证明模块化方法能够成功解耦知识表征，从而实现稳健的行为克隆，并在差异显著的未见物体上实现前所未有的零样本技能迁移能力。

    Soumil Rathi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark showing that robot memory degrades under distracting sessions and evaluates retrieval as a way to restore performance. Its substantive contribution concerns persistent memory and retrieval in agent systems; memory here does not investigate internal model mechanisms, compositionality, or reasoning.

    本文提出一个基准，展示机器人记忆会因有干扰的会话而退化，并评估利用检索恢复性能的方法。其主要贡献涉及智能体系统中的持续记忆和检索；这里的记忆并未探究模型内部机制、组合性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Robots deployed in realistic settings will accumulate experience across many sessions and tasks over their deployment. The robot's tasks may often require it to remember information from multiple sessions ago, making long-context robot memory important for real-world deployments. However, most robot-memory benchmarks today are based on single episodes or a short context. To measure how current robot memory systems perform on longer sessions with more distractions, we introduce RoboMME-Interference, a cross-session benchmark built on RoboMME (Dai et al., 2026). For each query episode, we construct a session history using the query's relevant prior demonstration followed by a controlled number of unrelated sessions, which we provide to the VLA as memory and measure accuracy. Running RoboMME's released memory-augmented $\pi_{0.5}$ variants unmodified through this benchmark, we find that while perceptual memory variants improve success when given the history without any distractors, they decay strongly and steadily as unrelated sessions accumulate. The subgoal variants, which read the history with a vision-language model and pass written subgoals to the policy, improve less at their best but hold more of that improvement as distractors accumulate. Adding a retrieval step to the strongest perceptual variant, which selects the section of history most visually similar to the robot's current view and passes only that section to the policy, restores its no-distractor success rate at every interference level. With this release, we emphasize the importance of long-context memory and robustness to interference and show that current systems largely fail on such capabilities. The project page, videos, code, and data are at https://robotmemorybench.com.

    中文

    部署在现实环境中的机器人会在整个部署期间积累跨多个会话和任务的经验。机器人执行任务时往往需要记住多个会话之前的信息，因此长上下文机器人记忆对现实部署十分重要。然而，如今大多数机器人记忆基准都基于单个情节或较短上下文。为衡量当前机器人记忆系统在更长会话和更多干扰下的表现，我们推出 RoboMME-Interference，这是一个基于 RoboMME（Dai et al., 2026）构建的跨会话基准。对于每个查询情节，我们构建一段会话历史：先加入与查询相关的先前示范，再接入数量受控的无关会话；我们将其作为记忆提供给 VLA，并测量准确率。在该基准上原样运行 RoboMME 已发布的记忆增强版本$\pi_{0.5}$后，我们发现：在没有任何干扰项的历史记录下，感知记忆版本能提升成功率，但随着无关会话不断累积，其表现会持续大幅下降。子目标版本使用视觉-语言模型读取历史记录，并将书面子目标传递给策略；它们的最佳提升幅度较小，但随着干扰项累积，能保留更多提升效果。为表现最强的感知记忆版本加入检索步骤，选取与机器人当前视图在视觉上最相似的历史片段，并只将该片段传递给策略，可使其在所有干扰级别下恢复到无干扰时的成功率。通过此次发布，我们强调了长上下文记忆和抗干扰能力的重要性，并表明当前系统在这些能力上普遍表现不佳。项目页面、视频、代码和数据见 https://robotmemorybench.com。

    Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents

    层级实验者智能体

    Abhranil Chandra, Utsav Dhanuka, Varun Gandhi, Sankaran Vaidyanathan, Scott Niekum

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HExA develops agents that run targeted experiments, distill experience into reusable, composable skills, and transfer them across tasks, with evaluations in multi-step reasoning and interactive environments. This substantially advances compositional skill reuse, reasoning, and agent organization, but the abstract does not study internal model representations.

    HExA 开发的智能体能够开展有针对性的实验，将经验提炼为可复用、可组合的技能，并在任务间迁移这些技能；其评估涵盖多步推理和交互环境。这显著推进了组合式技能复用、推理和智能体组织，但摘要没有研究模型内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to act in the real world and augment human decision-making, yet most systems rely on parametric knowledge acquired through imitation, optionally improved by post-training, retrieval, or search over fixed data. This paradigm struggles in novel domains or on complex queries that require information unavailable from prior knowledge alone; knowing the laws of physics, for example, does not by itself enable reliable reasoning or long-horizon actions in a complex physical system. We argue that agents need active experimentation: the ability to gather targeted query-specific evidence, discover general principles of unseen environments, and convert interaction experience into reusable skills. We introduce Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents (HExA), an in-context, experiment-centric self-improvement framework that (1) iteratively designs and refines query-relevant experiments, (2) incrementally distills experience into reusable and composable skills that accelerate experimentation within and across tasks, and (3) integrates experimental evidence to act or answer queries. HExA can work with any LLM including frontier black-box models, and requires no external supervision, oracle solutions, or offline data. We evaluate HExA on multi-step reasoning, interactive partially observable games, and physics law discovery tasks. To further evaluate when active experimentation is necessary, we introduce Interphyre, a set of hard procedural physics tasks where we enable tool-calling and intervention APIs. Current frontier LLMs including GPT-6 Astra fail in these settings: on the most challenging Interphyre tasks, we show that HExA can enable such models to near 100% success. Moreover, HExA improves token efficiency compared to naive agentic and memory baselines and enables generalization via hierarchical skill transfer from easier to harder tasks.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）日益被用于在现实世界中采取行动并辅助人类决策，但大多数系统依赖通过模仿获得的参数化知识，并可选择通过后训练、检索或在固定数据上搜索加以改进。这种范式在新领域或复杂查询上表现不佳，因为这些场景所需的信息无法仅从先前知识中获得；例如，仅仅了解物理定律本身，并不能让模型在复杂物理系统中进行可靠推理或采取长时程行动。我们认为，智能体需要主动实验：有能力收集针对特定查询的证据，发现未见环境中的一般规律，并将交互经验转化为可复用技能。我们提出层级实验者智能体（HExA），这是一种以实验为中心的上下文内自我改进框架，能够：（1）迭代设计并改进与查询相关的实验；（2）逐步将经验提炼为可复用、可组合的技能，从而加速单个任务内及跨任务的实验；（3）整合实验所得证据以采取行动或回答查询。HExA 可与任何 LLM 配合使用，包括前沿黑盒模型，且无需外部监督、标准答案或离线数据。我们在多步推理、交互式部分可观测游戏和物理定律发现任务上评估 HExA。为进一步评估主动实验何时不可或缺，我们推出 Interphyre，这是一组高难度程序化物理任务，并在其中开放工具调用和干预 API。包括 GPT-6 Astra 在内的当前前沿 LLM 在这些设置中表现不佳：我们展示了在最具挑战性的 Interphyre 任务上，HExA 能使此类模型的成功率接近 100%。此外，与朴素的智能体和记忆基线相比，HExA 提高了 token 效率，并通过从较易任务到较难任务的层级技能迁移实现泛化。

    On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as an effective post-training paradigm by providing supervision on student-generated trajectories. However, existing OPD methods for multimodal reasoning usually rely on a static teacher routing, assigning each sample to a single teacher based on modality or task type. This ignores that visual grounding and abstract reasoning may dominate different decoding steps, making a single teacher insufficient for the full trajectory. To this end, H-OPD is proposed as a confidence-aware heterogeneous multi-teacher OPD framework for multimodal reasoning. By verifying the complementarity of heterogeneous teachers in the same reasoning process, H-OPD replaces task or sample level teacher routing with token-level teacher arbitration along the shared student trajectory. H-OPD employs vision-to-language description transfer to enable text-only teachers to access key visual semantics, and uses a confidence-aware arbitration mechanism to dynamically combine vision-language teacher and text-only teachers at each token.     Vision-language models (VLMs) can behave very differently depending on whether the same underlying problem is presented textually or visually. This inconsistency suggests that different views expose different reasoning paths and failure modes that standard multimodal post-training does not fully exploit. To study and exploit this phenomenon, we construct ODA-Data, a high-quality paired multimodal geometry dataset with text-dominant, image-dominant, and combined image+text views of the same problems, together with splits for training and evaluating view dependent reasoning behaviors. We then develop Modality-Informed Reciprocal Reasoning Optimization (MIRROR), a reinforcement learning approach that derives a cross-view self-distillation signal from the model's own modality-dependent capabilities. For each problem, MIRROR evaluates the model under all views, selects the best-performing view as a teacher, and trains the remaining views using a GRPO task-reward objective augmented with a reverse-KL regularizer toward that teacher. Across reasoning benchmarks that evaluate on multimodal mathematics problems, MIRROR improves over standard RL and yields more accurate and consistent behavior across different input modality representations.

    中文

    视觉语言模型（VLM）会因同一个底层问题以文本还是视觉形式呈现而表现出显著差异。这种不一致表明，不同视角会展现不同的推理路径和失败模式，而标准的多模态后训练未能充分利用这些差异。为研究并利用这一现象，我们构建了 ODA-Data，这是一个高质量的配对多模态几何数据集，包含同一问题的文本主导、图像主导以及图像与文本结合的视角，并划分数据以训练和评估依赖视角的推理行为。随后，我们开发了模态信息互惠推理优化（MIRROR），这是一种强化学习方法，可从模型自身依赖模态的能力中提取跨视角自蒸馏信号。对于每个问题，MIRROR 会在所有视角下评估模型，选择表现最佳的视角作为教师，并使用 GRPO 任务奖励目标训练其余视角，同时加入一个以该教师为目标的反向 KL 正则项。在针对多模态数学问题进行评估的推理基准上，MIRROR 优于标准 RL，并使模型在不同输入模态表征下的行为更加准确、一致。

    Kaibing Yang, Guangfeng Cai, Shengtian Yang, Shuo He, Yu Li, Mengyi Liu, Pengwei Chen, Jun Xu, Lei Feng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CovGPO addresses a credit trap in long-horizon agent training by using first-visit observation coverage to guide all-failed groups, improving agent learning on two benchmarks. Its policy-optimization method is a substantial contribution to agent training and task execution, while exploration has only an incidental connection to compositional generalization and the abstract makes no claim about model internals.

    CovGPO 通过利用首次访问观察覆盖率引导全失败组，解决长时程智能体训练中的信用陷阱，并提升了两个基准上的智能体学习效果。其策略优化方法对智能体训练和任务执行作出了实质性贡献；探索与组合泛化只有间接关联，摘要也未声称研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Group-based policy optimization has been increasingly used to train large language model (LLM) agents from sparse outcome rewards by comparing trajectories or steps within a group. However, on difficult long-horizon agentic tasks, we found this comparison suffers from a sampling imbalance: repeated or low-effect actions dominate the high-probability region of the policy, leaving useful state-changing actions under-sampled. This imbalance produces many all-failed rollout groups, where the relative advantages within such a group provide no direction for updating the policy. Consequently, the sampling imbalance and the all-failed groups collapse into a self-perpetuating credit trap: failure-dominated sampling yields no learning signal, allowing repeated low-effect actions to persist. To break this trap, we propose Coverage-conditioned Group Policy Optimization (CovGPO), which uses first-visit observation coverage only when all samples in a group receive zero outcome reward. Specifically, within such groups, CovGPO assigns higher relative advantages to state-exploring actions without corrupting the original reward signal, as reaching new observations is a prerequisite for task success. Experiments on two challenging agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld and WebShop, show that CovGPO consistently improves over group-based baselines, with particularly large gains on hard tasks.

    中文

    基于组的策略优化日益用于通过比较组内的轨迹或步骤，利用稀疏结果奖励训练大型语言模型（LLM）智能体。然而，我们发现，在困难的长时程智能体任务中，这种比较受到采样不平衡的影响：重复或效果较低的动作占据策略的高概率区域，使有用的状态改变动作采样不足。这种不平衡会产生许多全失败的 rollout 组，在这些组中，组内的相对优势无法为策略更新提供方向。因此，采样不平衡与全失败组共同形成一个自我强化的信用陷阱：由失败主导的采样无法产生学习信号，使重复的低效动作得以持续。为打破这一陷阱，我们提出覆盖率条件组策略优化（CovGPO），仅当组内所有样本的结果奖励均为零时，才使用首次访问观察覆盖率。具体而言，在这类组中，CovGPO 会为探索状态的动作分配更高的相对优势，同时不改变原始奖励信号，因为到达新的观察状态是任务成功的先决条件。在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 这两个具有挑战性的智能体基准上的实验表明，CovGPO 持续优于基于组的基线，在困难任务上尤其提升显著。

    As large language models move from isolated task solving toward long-term service in human environments, they require social intelligence: the ability to infer mental states, track social relations, reason over norms, and adapt behavior under context. This report presents ZenGen, an integrated framework for measuring, internalizing, and grounding social intelligence. For measurement, we introduce SoMBench, a psychology-grounded benchmark spanning 3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, and 71 task paradigms. It controls question format, narrative perspective, and context length across 284 shared scenarios and 3,481 expert-verified instances. Evaluation of 20 representative LLMs reveals substantial headroom: the best model achieves only 72.08% overall accuracy, and none of the 17 secondary dimensions reaches the 90% near-ceiling band. For internalization, we develop ZenGen, a diagnosis-driven training recipe combining supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and rubric-based reinforcement learning. For deployment-time grounding, we build Actio, a harness-controlled inference architecture that routes four typed supports into reasoning: PRISM for procedural guidance, Starling for runtime mental-state representation, SAGE for reusable experience, and gated RAG for external social and normative knowledge. Across five base models and three benchmarks, the full harness improves 14 of 15 model-benchmark pairs and is best or tied for best in 8, demonstrating the effectiveness of typed runtime support.     Jakub Antczak, Joanna Wojciechowicz, Kamil Ksi\k{a}\.zek, Marcin Mazur, {\L}ukasz Struski, Jacek Tabor

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Fast LapSum contributes a scalable, differentiable exact-mass top-k algorithm with a verification step and GPU implementation, enabling sparse computation and routing at large scale. Its applications demonstrate utility, while the algorithmic contribution supports a strong systems score; the abstract does not address interpretability, composition, or reasoning.

    Fast LapSum 提出一种可扩展、可微分且具有精确总量的 top-k 算法，并配有验证步骤和 GPU 实现，可在大规模场景中实现稀疏计算和路由。其应用展示了实用价值，而算法贡献有力地支持系统方面的评价；摘要未涉及可解释性、组合性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Selecting the top-$k$ elements is a fundamental operation for inducing sparsity in large-scale models and optimization problems, enabling robust expert activation, token routing or attention pruning. However, hard top-$k$ is non-differentiable, while existing differentiable alternatives become increasingly expensive as the number of coordinates grows. We introduce Fast LapSum, a scalable solver for the LapSum soft top-$k$ formulation that preserves an exact selection mass of $k$, while supporting end-to-end differentiation. In Fast LapSum, we reduce sorting cost using probabilistic bracketing, which restricts sorting to a narrow band of scores around the threshold using a binomial order-statistic from kernel-noised samples. A certification pass upgrades the probabilistic localization to a verified one at the cost of one additional linear pass, with a full-sort fallback that covers the worst-case scenario. Our certified GPU implementation processes $10^6$, $10^7$, and $10^8$ scores in median times of $0.92$, $1.39$, and $7.24$ ms, respectively, making exact-budget soft top-$k$ practical within million-scale optimization loops. We demonstrate this capability in two applications: megapixel sparse adversarial examples with a small fraction of initial image pixels, where Fast LapSum achieves an order-of-magnitude speedup over state-of-the-art methods, and 3D Gaussian splatting. In the latter, we use Fast LapSum to reduce the number of Gaussians produced by Adaptive Density Control to a substantially smaller number while retaining nearly the same rendering quality and massively reducing computation. These results demonstrate that exact-budget differentiable top-$k$ can be incorporated into practical million-scale optimization pipelines.

    中文

    选择 top-$k$个元素是大型模型和优化问题中实现稀疏性的基础操作，可支持稳健的专家激活、token 路由或注意力剪枝。然而，硬 top-$k$不可微分，而现有可微分替代方法的开销会随着坐标数量增加而不断上升。我们提出 Fast LapSum，这是一种可扩展的求解器，用于 LapSum 软 top-$k$表述；它在支持端到端微分的同时，保持精确的选择总量为 $k$。在 Fast LapSum 中，我们采用概率括定来降低排序成本：利用核噪声样本的二项次序统计量，将排序限制在阈值附近的狭窄分数区间内。一次认证流程仅需额外进行一次线性遍历，便可将概率定位升级为经过验证的定位；此外还提供完整排序回退方案，以覆盖最坏情况。我们经过认证的 GPU 实现处理中位时间为 $10^6$、$10^7$和$10^8$毫秒，分别对应 $0.92$、$1.39$和$7.24$个分数，因此在百万规模优化循环中实际使用精确预算软 top-$k$成为可行。我们通过两个应用展示了这一能力：其一是百万像素级稀疏对抗样本，仅使用少量初始图像像素时，Fast LapSum 的速度比最先进方法快一个数量级；其二是 3D Gaussian Splatting。在后者中，我们使用 Fast LapSum 将 Adaptive Density Control 生成的 Gaussian 数量大幅减少，同时保持几乎相同的渲染质量，并显著降低计算量。这些结果表明，精确预算的可微分 top-$k$可以纳入实用的百万规模优化流程。

    In medical education, physicians convert academic knowledge into clinical expertise through residency: years of training across thousands of encounters, with diverse sources of feedback and progressively greater autonomy. Much of clinical reasoning relies on the patient encounter, a dialogue in which a clinician elicits history, refines diagnostic hypotheses, and decides management under uncertainty. While large language models (LLMs) excel on static medical benchmarks, methods to optimize the full sequence of clinical decisions remain underdeveloped. We present ResidencyRL, a reinforcement learning (RL) method for training clinical artificial intelligence (AI) agents through simulated multi-turn clinical encounters (up to 60 dialogue turns and 8 tool calls per trajectory). ResidencyRL pairs the policy agent with LLM simulators capable of complex, adversarial behaviors, training against a structured reward aligned to diagnostic accuracy, management quality, communication, documentation, and safety. On held-out evaluations, the ResidencyRL agent improves diagnostic accuracy by 7.0% under adversarial conditions (88.0% vs. 81.0%) and reduces missed red flag rates by 31%, demonstrating rigorous mitigation of premature closure. Blinded expert clinicians validated these gains, preferring the trained agent in 87.6% of side-by-side comparisons. The procedural competencies transfer to unseen benchmarks: the agent outperforms the base model across all six clinical axes of the AMIE multi-visit benchmark, and shows consistent directional improvements on AgentClinic and CRAFT-MD. Our findings demonstrate that sequential clinical decision-making can be effectively learned through multi-turn RL in simulation, yielding robust, generalizable capabilities, paving the way towards clinical mastery. Prospective validation with real-world workflows remains necessary to establish clinical utility.

    User feedback offers natural supervision for persistent LLM improvement, but a single message may support multiple behavioral changes with different scopes of generalization. We introduce SLIFT, a selective self-learning framework built on a task-relative view of user feedback. SLIFT decomposes each feedback message into atomic components and interprets each component relative to the original task as Fix, Spec, or Null: requirements for task validity, compatible condition-specific refinements, or content with no reliable positive update direction. To incorporate each change at the appropriate scope, SLIFT trains two complementary LoRA adapters on a shared frozen backbone: a Generalist that consolidates Fix requirements into default behavior through feedback-conditioned self-distillation, and a Specialist that observes only the task and Generalist response to supply residual guidance for applicable, unmet Spec refinements. Null components induce no positive update. Across backbones, SLIFT achieves strong performance on both MemoryBench and WildFB, with targeted analyses further examining its underlying mechanisms.     Hanlin Jiang, Jionghao Huang, Shaofei Li, Bojia Yu, Peng Jiang, Yuxin Ren, Ning Jia, Yao Guo, Ding Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    STAIR contributes a shared incident-state framework, experience retrieval, and feedback-driven planning for long-horizon response. Its agent architecture and stateful execution are a substantial Systems contribution; planning is relevant to Reasoning, while the abstract gives no internal-model mechanism or compositional generalization contribution.

    STAIR 提出了共享事件状态框架、经验检索和由反馈驱动的长时程响应规划。其智能体架构和有状态执行对系统作出了实质性贡献；规划与推理相关，而摘要没有提出内部模型机制或组合泛化方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Incident response planning is critical for restoring compromised software systems. Existing AIOps methods automate fault diagnosis and remediation and adapt response using feedback, but lack a unified decision basis across planning and execution. This limits their ability to maintain incident state and align actions with evolving recovery objectives during long-horizon, multi-stage security incident response. We present STAIR, an end-to-end agentic response framework that organizes planning and execution around a shared incident state. STAIR maintains incident evidence, response actions, and execution feedback in Graph-as-State (GAS), using the latest state to determine the response stage and recovery objectives for stage-specialized planning. The framework retrieves effect-validated historical experience based on the current state and stage to guide action selection. An Execution Harness executes actions, returns feedback to update GAS, and validates action effects for future experience reuse. We construct STAIR-Bench, an executable incident response benchmark comprising 44 Docker-based cyber-range cases. On its held-out test cases, STAIR achieves an overall defense score of 0.95, improving over the strongest baseline by approximately 10.47%. In the independent CAGE4 environment with ongoing attacks and benign activity, STAIR reduces cumulative penalties by approximately 28.8% relative to the strongest baseline.

    中文

    事件响应规划对于恢复遭到入侵的软件系统至关重要。现有 AIOps 方法可以自动执行故障诊断和修复，并根据反馈调整响应，但缺乏贯穿规划与执行的统一决策依据。这限制了它们在长时程、多阶段安全事件响应过程中维护事件状态并使行动与不断变化的恢复目标保持一致的能力。我们提出 STAIR，这是一种端到端智能体响应框架，以共享事件状态为中心组织规划与执行。STAIR 在状态即图（GAS）中维护事件证据、响应行动和执行反馈，并利用最新状态确定响应阶段和恢复目标，以进行针对阶段的规划。该框架根据当前状态和阶段检索经过效果验证的历史经验，以指导行动选择。执行框架负责执行行动、返回反馈以更新 GAS，并验证行动效果，以供未来复用经验。我们构建了 STAIR-Bench，这是一个可执行的事件响应基准，包含 44 个基于 Docker 的网络靶场案例。在留出的测试案例上，STAIR 的总体防御得分为 0.95，比最强基线高约 10.47%。在存在持续攻击和良性活动的独立 CAGE4 环境中，STAIR 将累计惩罚降低了约 28.8%，相较于最强基线。

    GenCoord: Executable Commitments for Embodied LLM Agents under Private Information

    Junning Zhu, Peng He, Haohan Yuan, Jianpeng Liang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GenCoord uses compact, composable work commitments to coordinate embodied agents with private information, reducing inference time while maintaining task success and improving held-out-template results. This strongly advances compositional coordination and agent-system design; reasoning is involved in choosing and revising work, but the abstract does not establish a core reasoning mechanism or model-internal interpretability contribution.

    GenCoord 利用紧凑、可组合的工作承诺，在私有信息条件下协调具身智能体，既缩短推理时间，又维持任务成功率并提升留出模板上的表现。这项工作显著推进了组合式协调和智能体系统设计；选择和调整工作也涉及推理，但摘要没有提出核心推理机制或模型内部可解释性方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Embodied language-model agents must coordinate interdependent actions while each holds private task information. In dialogue-based coordination, models generate messages and interpret replies to decide what each agent should do, spending inference before the team acts. We propose GenCoord, a decentralized protocol that makes the division of work itself the message. A proposal pairs the sender's skill path with its partner's continuation in Short DSL, a compact language for expressing joint work. Compatible paths form commitments linking the sender's delivery to the partner's work after verified receipt. We check fulfillment separately from original-task success. Complete requests also let a deterministic receiver proceed without another model call. In Minecraft, trained local 0.8B agents match the task success of controlled free-form communication while reducing median commitment time by 68.2%. The same-field full-key JSON control approaches free-form output length and delay, indicating that the amount generated matters even when messages are structured. With the same prompted DeepSeek model, both protocols complete nearly all tasks, but dialogue generates 2.8 times as many output tokens. Multistep commitments improve held-out-template success from 91.3% to 98.1% with fewer decisions. These results point to a design principle for embodied cooperation: make the division of work the message, and spend inference on choosing and revising the work.

    中文

    具身语言模型智能体必须在各自掌握私有任务信息的情况下协调相互依赖的行动。在基于对话的协调中，模型生成消息并解读回复，以决定每个智能体应采取什么行动，因此团队行动之前就要消耗推理资源。我们提出 GenCoord，这是一种去中心化协议，让任务分工本身成为消息。提议会将发送方的技能路径与其伙伴的后续步骤配对，并用 Short DSL 这一表达协作任务的紧凑语言进行描述。相容的路径构成承诺，将发送方的交付与伙伴在验证接收后的工作联系起来。我们将履约情况与原始任务是否成功分开检查。完整的请求还可以让确定性接收方在无需再次调用模型的情况下继续执行。在 Minecraft 中，训练后的本地 0.8B 智能体在任务成功率上与受控自由形式通信相当，同时将承诺时间中位数降低了 68.2%。采用相同字段的完整键 JSON 对照方案，其输出长度和延迟接近自由形式输出，这表明即使消息有结构，生成内容的数量仍会产生影响。对于同一个经提示的 DeepSeek 模型，两种协议都能完成几乎所有任务，但对话生成的输出 token 数是另一种协议的 2.8 倍。多步承诺将留出模板上的成功率从 91.3% 提升到 98.1%，同时减少了决策次数。这些结果揭示了具身协作的一项设计原则：让任务分工成为消息，并将推理资源用于选择和调整工作。

    Defense-as-Skill: Evolving Runtime Guard Skill for Skill-Augmented Agents

    防御即技能：为技能增强型智能体演进运行时防护技能

    Xiaofang Yang, Ziqi Miao, Chen Qian, Dianbo Sui, Jing Shao, Lijun Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Defense-as-Skill develops an editable runtime guard for skill-augmented agents and evolves its policy through rollout feedback, with evaluated gains in attack resistance and safety-utility trade-offs. This substantially advances agent protection and runtime organization, but the abstract does not claim a core contribution to model internals, composition, or reasoning.

    Defense-as-Skill 为技能增强型智能体开发了一种可编辑的运行时防护组件，并通过运行轨迹反馈演进其策略，评估结果显示其提升了攻击抵御能力和安全性与效用之间的权衡。这显著推进了智能体保护和运行时组织，但摘要并未声称其对模型内部机制、组合性或推理作出了核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Skill-augmented agents load reusable skills as persistent runtime context, improving task performance but also giving malicious skills a durable channel for steering future actions. Such skills may leak secrets, corrupt code, bypass approvals, or stage data for exfiltration only after a concrete user task and workspace state make the unsafe action appear useful. This makes pre-install vetting insufficient and calls for runtime, task-conditioned protection. We propose Defense-as-Skill, a defense paradigm that implements the runtime guard itself as an installable, inspectable, and editable skill. Our guard, SkillSonar, runs alongside untrusted task skills and checks sensitive actions against the user's task boundary, routing each action to an allow, replan, or confirmation decision without modifying the underlying agent runtime. To study this setting, we construct SCOPE-R, a task-conditioned dataset covering 6 risk families and 21 sub-categories, with 206 attack-confirmed malicious instances and 43 benign tasks. We then improve SkillSonar on the SCOPE-R training subset using runtime guard-skill evolution, a Monte-Carlo Tree Search procedure that evolves the on-disk guard skill from feedback on the rollouts. Across Claude Code and OpenClaw, the evolved guard substantially reduces attack success while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off; on repeated GLM-5 runs, ID ASR drops from 0.482 to 0.104 and OOD ASR from 0.606 to 0.115, with gains transferring across victim models, held-out risk families, and external benchmarks. These results show that runtime guards can be skill-native, transparent, and evolvable policy artifacts for skill-augmented agents.

    中文

    技能增强型智能体将可复用技能加载为持久的运行时上下文，从而提升任务表现，但也为恶意技能提供了持久影响未来行动的渠道。只有在具体用户任务和工作区状态使不安全操作看似有用之后，这些技能才可能泄露机密、破坏代码、绕过审批，或准备数据以供外传。因此，仅在安装前进行审查并不足够，需要运行时、由任务条件决定的保护。我们提出 Defense-as-Skill，这是一种防御范式，将运行时防护本身实现为可安装、可检查、可编辑的技能。我们的防护组件 SkillSonar 与不受信任的任务技能并行运行，根据用户的任务边界检查敏感操作，并将每项操作导向允许、重新规划或请求确认的决策，同时不修改底层智能体运行时。为研究这一场景，我们构建了 SCOPE-R，这是一个由任务条件决定的数据集，涵盖 6 个风险家族和 21 个子类别，其中包含 206 个经攻击确认的恶意实例和 43 个良性任务。随后，我们使用运行时防护技能演进方法，在 SCOPE-R 的训练子集上改进 SkillSonar；该方法采用蒙特卡洛树搜索，根据运行轨迹的反馈演进磁盘上的防护技能。在 Claude Code 和 OpenClaw 上，演进后的防护组件大幅降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了良好的安全性与效用权衡；在重复的 GLM-5 运行中，ID ASR 从 0.482 降至 0.104，OOD ASR 从 0.606 降至 0.115，且收益能够迁移至不同受害模型、留出的风险家族和外部基准。这些结果表明，运行时防护可以成为技能增强型智能体中原生于技能、透明且可演进的策略制品。

    SUN: Reaching for Novelty in Reinforcement Learning

    SUN：在强化学习中探寻新颖性

    Wenyan Yang, Arsenii Mustafin, Dominik Baumann, Joni Pajarinen, Simone Parisi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SUN introduces a goal-selection method that jointly accounts for novelty and reachability in reinforcement learning, with theoretical properties and evidence across challenging environments. This substantially advances exploration and strategy formation, while its goal-selection algorithm offers only a limited connection to broader agent-system design.

    SUN 提出了一种在强化学习中同时考虑新颖性和可达性的目标选择方法，并给出了理论性质以及在具有挑战性的环境中的实验证据。这显著推进了探索和策略形成，而其目标选择算法与更广泛的智能体系统设计仅有有限关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Exploration in reinforcement learning (RL) remains a fundamental challenge. Recent goal-conditioned RL strategies (which select goals to encourage broader state coverage) have shown promising results, but none scores a goal by novelty and reachability jointly: the two signals are traded off by hand, applied in sequence, or one is neglected outright. In this paper, we introduce a reachability-aware goal-selection framework that explicitly integrates these two aspects, and that can be seamlessly incorporated into any off-policy RL algorithm. To this aim, we propose SUccessor-to-Novelty (SUN), an indicator derived from successor value functions to identify goals that are both novel and reachable. We prove that SUN is the value of a count-scaled goal-reaching reward, bounds short-horizon hitting probabilities, and rejects unreachable goals. We further present an adaptive goal-selection strategy that leverages these properties, along with an accurate yet lightweight pseudocount to avoid the overhead of classic methods. We back up all our claims with thorough benchmarks: SUN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in standard and novel environments with unreachable or hard-to-reach states, irreversible transitions, obstacles, mazes, and unbounded spaces. Code at https://github.com/sparisi/rl-anvil

    中文

    强化学习（RL）中的探索仍是一项根本性挑战。近期目标条件化 RL 策略（通过选择目标来鼓励更广泛的状态覆盖）已显示出良好前景，但没有一种方法能同时依据新颖性和可达性为目标评分：这两种信号要么通过人工权衡，要么依次应用，要么直接忽略其中之一。本文提出一种感知可达性的目标选择框架，明确整合这两个方面，并可无缝融入任何离策略 RL 算法。为此，我们提出 SUccessor-to-Novelty（SUN），一种从后继价值函数导出的指标，用于识别既新颖又可达的目标。我们证明，SUN 是按计数缩放的目标到达奖励的价值，能够界定短时域命中概率，并排除不可达目标。我们还提出一种自适应目标选择策略，利用这些性质，并结合一种准确而轻量的伪计数，以避免经典方法的开销。我们通过全面的基准实验支持所有主张：在标准环境以及包含不可达或难以到达状态、不可逆转移、障碍物、迷宫和无界空间的新颖环境中，SUN 始终优于当前最先进的方法。代码见 https://github.com/sparisi/rl-anvil

    The Convention Gap: Beyond Literal Content in Human-AI Cooperation

    惯例差距：超越人机协作中的字面内容

    Makoto Fukushima, Hua-Dong Xiong, Ehsan Moradi Pari

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper defines and validates a metric for detecting when human partners’ Hanabi actions communicate beyond literal hints, finding a convention gap in human-partnered play and a monotonic increase across agent levels trained to interpret more. It provides partial insight into learned interpretation and composition of messages with actions, while its central contribution is an evaluation method for agents cooperating with humans.

    本文定义并验证了一种指标，用于检测人类搭档在 Hanabi 中的行动何时传达了超出字面提示的信息；研究发现，与人类搭档对局时存在惯例差距，而且在经过训练、能够进行更多解读的智能体层级中，该差距单调增加。本文对习得的解读以及消息与行动的组合提供了部分见解，而其核心贡献是面向与人类协作的智能体的评估方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Cooperative AI agents are often evaluated against other AIs, yet human cooperation is thought to rely on implicit conventions: shared rules for reading meaning beyond the literal message. We propose the convention gap as a diagnostic of such implicit communication. In the card game Hanabi, where hints are the only messages about one's own hand, the convention gap is the failure probability predicted exactly from the literal content of the hints and the visible cards, minus the observed failure rate of the cards played. We prove that the population gap (the value the gap approaches over many games) is zero when the partner's choices convey nothing beyond their literal content, given a fair shuffle and a player who uses only what was said and seen. A nonzero population gap thus indicates that partner choices conveyed more; it does not measure how much. The gap was +26.2 percentage points (pp) in public human-human games (+46 pp on plays of cards that no hint had pointed to), +16.4 pp for human plays with AI partners, and -0.6 pp in AI-AI games we simulated among rule-based agents. With three AI agents of a published human-AI study, the literal failure probability of the cards humans played was similar across partners (38-41%), yet human failure ranged from 14.4% to 34.4% and the gap from +24.1 to +6.2 pp, and the contrast between partners persisted within participants. Across five levels of Off-Belief Learning agents, trained so that the first level reads past actions only for their literal content and each higher level interprets more, the gap rose monotonically from +1.6 to +21.7 pp. These results argue for reporting the convention gap on human-partnered play, not only AI-AI performance, when evaluating agents intended for human partners.

    中文

    协作式 AI 智能体通常通过与其他 AI 进行评估；然而，人们认为人类协作依赖隐含惯例：用于理解字面信息之外含义的共享规则。我们提出“惯例差距”作为诊断此类隐式沟通的指标。在纸牌游戏 Hanabi 中，提示是关于自己手牌的唯一信息，惯例差距定义为仅根据提示的字面内容和可见牌张精确预测出的失败概率，减去实际打出的牌的观测失败率。我们证明，在公平洗牌且玩家只使用所说和所见信息的条件下，当搭档的选择没有传达超出字面内容的信息时，总体差距（经过许多局游戏后差距趋近的值）为零。因此，非零的总体差距表明搭档的选择传达了更多信息；但它并不衡量信息多了多少。在公开的人类对战游戏中，差距为 +26.2 个百分点（pp）（对于没有任何提示指向的牌，打出时的差距为 +46 pp）；在人类与 AI 搭档的游戏中为 +16.4 pp；在我们模拟的基于规则的智能体 AI-AI 游戏中为 -0.6 pp。对于一项已发表的人机研究中的三个 AI 智能体，人类所打牌张的字面失败概率在不同搭档间相近（38-41%），但人类失败率介于 14.4% 至 34.4%，差距则介于 +24.1 至 +6.2 pp；而且不同搭档之间的差异在参与者内部仍然存在。在五个层级的 Off-Belief Learning 智能体中，训练时第一个层级只按字面内容读取过去的行动，每个更高层级则进行更多解读，差距从 +1.6 pp 单调上升至 +21.7 pp。这些结果表明，在评估面向人类搭档的智能体时，应报告与人类搭档对局中的惯例差距，而不应只报告 AI-AI 表现。

    Hyper Algorithm Design Agent: Evolving Learnable Optimizer from Zero

    超算法设计智能体：从零开始演进可学习优化器

    Zipei Yu, Yue-Jiao Gong, Zeyuan Ma, Yuncheng Jiang, Zhiguang Cao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The central contribution is a dual-agent framework that recursively evolves learnable optimization algorithms through code modification, evaluation, and feedback, with reported improvements and adaptation across domains. This substantially advances agent organization for algorithm design; composition and reasoning are secondary, with no specific compositional-generalization or model-reasoning mechanism established.

    核心贡献是一个双智能体框架，通过代码修改、评估和反馈递归演进可学习优化算法，并报告了性能提升以及跨领域适配能力。这显著推进了用于算法设计的智能体组织；组合和推理属于次要方面，且本文未确立具体的组合泛化或模型推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Meta-Black-Box Optimization (MetaBBO) is one of the highlights in the recent AI for Optimization trend. This paradigm's bi-level workflow leverages the learnable algorithm design policy at meta level to ensure the performance and generalization improvement on the low-level optimization task. While MetaBBO helps advance the performance lower bound of the resulted optimization system, it is currently handcrafted and customized case by case to adapt different optimization problems, which inevitably introduces inherent subjectivity and hence restricts the performance upper bound and usability in practice. In this paper, we address this issue by regarding MetaBBO's design loop as coding task, where we could introduce openendedness into MetaBBO with recursive self-improvement capability of advanced coding agents. Specifically, we propose a dual-agent framework: i) a task agent continuously refines the codebase of a target MetaBBO approach through code evolution; ii) a hyper agent progressively modifies the task agent and itself to provide open-ended design behavior; iii) the evolved MetaBBO codebase is evaluated and all in-execution information is fed back to the agents for recursive self-referential improvement. As a result, given a naive MetaBBO template, our framework automates a design evolution and finds novel variants superior to up-to-date human-made MetaBBO baselines. Surprisingly, the experimental results also demonstrate that our framework supports fast adaption across different optimization domains. Solid interpretation analysis further reveals interesting design principles emerge in such open-ended process. This work serves as the first exploration on automating design of complex learning-assisted optimization algorithms.

    中文

    元黑盒优化（MetaBBO）是近期 AI for Optimization 趋势中的亮点之一。这一范式的双层工作流利用元层的可学习算法设计策略，确保低层优化任务的性能与泛化能力得到提升。MetaBBO 虽有助于提高最终优化系统的性能下限，但目前仍需针对不同优化问题逐案手工设计和定制，这不可避免地带来固有的主观性，进而限制了性能上限及其在实践中的可用性。本文将 MetaBBO 的设计循环视为编码任务，以解决这一问题；这样便可借助先进编码智能体的递归自我改进能力，为 MetaBBO 引入开放式探索。具体而言，我们提出一个双智能体框架：i）任务智能体通过代码演进持续改进目标 MetaBBO 方法的代码库；ii）超智能体逐步修改任务智能体和自身，以实现开放式设计行为；iii）对演进后的 MetaBBO 代码库进行评估，并将执行期间的所有信息反馈给智能体，以实现递归、自我指涉的改进。因此，给定一个朴素的 MetaBBO 模板，我们的框架可以自动演进设计，并找到优于最新人工设计 MetaBBO 基线的新颖变体。令人惊讶的是，实验结果还表明，我们的框架支持在不同优化领域之间快速适配。深入的解释性分析进一步揭示，在这一开放式过程中涌现出有趣的设计原则。本工作首次探索了复杂学习辅助优化算法设计的自动化。

    ENGLISH

    Epidemic policy planning often requires coordination between geographical regions, taking into account mobility-driven spillovers and how to make use of limited resources. Existing methods either lack action-conditioned models of coupled dynamics or cannot guarantee per-period feasibility. We present EpiMind, a graph world model framework for constrained epidemic policy planning across regions. A graph-factored recurrent state-space model generates joint policy-conditioned rollouts from regional latent beliefs, while graph-temporal ADMM optimizes regional interventions, enforces shared-resource feasibility through projection, and evaluates temporal specifications under the learned model. EpiMind reduces admission RMSE by 29% relative to graph-free dynamics modeling, plans within 1-5% of the best feasible constant policy with guaranteed shared-budget feasibility, and outperforms all deployable baselines across three resource budgets in real-context evaluation. These results demonstrate that graph-structured policy imagination with explicit constrained coordination supports effective epidemic interventions from learned dynamics.
