    Prasoon Dev, Anirudh Sankar, Vasudeva Varma

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MS-GLA distributes attention heads across temporal resolutions and dynamically fuses their outputs, improving memory and long-context performance. Its architectural treatment of representational capacity is a partial connection to representation geometry, while multi-scale combination is incidental to compositional generalization; the main contribution concerns model computation and memory.

    MS-GLA 将注意力头分配到不同时间分辨率，并动态融合其输出，从而改善记忆能力和长上下文性能。它从架构层面处理表征容量，与表征几何有部分关联；多尺度组合则只是与组合泛化附带相关。其主要贡献涉及模型计算和记忆。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Gated Linear Attention (GLA) Transformers advance linear recurrent models through data-dependent gating, but face a core limitation: the fixed-capacity memory matrices across all heads operate at a single temporal resolution, where each token is processed individually, forcing them to simultaneously encode local syntactic patterns and long-range semantic structure, creating a representational bottleneck that gating alone is insufficient to resolve. We introduce Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention (MS-GLA), which addresses this by distributing attention heads across multiple temporal resolutions. Coarser resolutions pool longer token spans naturally specializing toward long-range dependencies, while finer head groups retain sensitivity to local syntactic structure. A learnable, input-dependent fusion layer dynamically recombines head group outputs at each timestep, expanding effective memory capacity without increasing per-head state size. This multi-resolution decomposition draws on principles from Multi-Scale State-Space Models (MS-SSM), adapting them to the gated linear attention setting. We evaluate MS-GLA on language modeling, recall-intensive tasks, and long-context generalization. Across all settings, MS-GLA consistently achieves higher accuracy and lower perplexity than GLA at matched parameter counts, with up to 18.9% improvement on recall-intensive tasks and 9.5% lower average perplexity on language modeling benchmarks, validating multi-temporal resolution decomposition as a principled and effective extension of Gated Linear Attention.

    中文

    门控线性注意力（GLA）Transformer 通过依赖数据的门控推进了线性循环模型的发展，但面临一个核心局限：所有注意力头的固定容量记忆矩阵都在单一时间分辨率下运行，每个 token 都被单独处理，迫使这些矩阵同时编码局部句法模式和长程语义结构，从而造成仅靠门控无法解决的表征瓶颈。我们提出多尺度门控线性注意力（MS-GLA），通过将注意力头分配到多个时间分辨率来解决这一问题。较粗的分辨率会对更长的 token 序列片段进行池化，自然地专注于长程依赖；而较细的注意力头组则保留对局部句法结构的敏感性。可学习且依赖输入的融合层会在每个时间步动态重组各注意力头组的输出，在不增加每个注意力头状态规模的情况下扩展有效记忆容量。这种多分辨率分解借鉴了多尺度状态空间模型（MS-SSM）的原理，并将其适配到门控线性注意力场景。我们在语言建模、密集回忆任务和长上下文泛化任务上评估 MS-GLA。在所有设置下，在参数量匹配时，MS-GLA 始终比 GLA 准确率更高、困惑度更低；在密集回忆任务上最多提升 18.9%，在语言建模基准上的平均困惑度则降低 9.5%，这验证了多时间分辨率分解是对门控线性注意力一种有原则且有效的扩展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous agents have made rapid progress in general-purpose computer use, yet reliable automation of professional industrial engineering remains out of reach. Engineering workflows require reasoning over geometric and physical constraints and keeping dependencies consistent across software and design stages. We present EngiWorld, a benchmark designed around the capabilities that real engineering projects require, from operating a single application to solving engineering problems end to end. It contains 1,301 expert-curated tasks spanning six engineering domains (CAD, CAE, CAM, BIM, EDA, and DCC) and 26 professional software applications, with both GUI and CLI interfaces. The tasks are organized into six types, corresponding to capabilities that real engineering projects require. We further introduce an artifact-centric evaluation methodology built on a unified suite of domain verifiers. The verifiers programmatically check whether final and intermediate artifacts are geometrically valid, physically feasible, and compliant with design rules. Beyond binary success, they also score how well optimized designs meet their specifications. Evaluation of seven frontier models reveals a substantial capability gap: the strongest model scores only 44.7/100, and just 3.6% of runs on tasks that require cross-software coordination succeed. EngiWorld provides a rigorous foundation for measuring progress toward agents that operate professional engineering software end to end.

    Yihuai Hong, Shauli Ravfogel, Chen Zhao, Eunsol Choi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures whether CoT reflects models’ internal reasoning strategies and shows that post-training can improve this alignment while preserving task accuracy. This makes a substantial contribution to interpretability and explicit reasoning; reported generalization analysis is incidental to composition, and no agent or systems contribution is described.

    本文测量 CoT 是否反映模型的内部推理策略，并表明后训练可以在保持任务准确率的同时提升这种一致性。这对可解释性和显式推理作出了重要贡献；文中报告的泛化分析与组合性仅有附带关联，也没有描述智能体或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Chain-of-thought (CoT) traces often serve as a proxy for how Large Language Models (LLMs) arrive at their answers. However, growing evidence shows that models' CoT often fails to reflect their internal computations and can be changed without affecting their final answers. In this work, we measure and improve the alignment between the reasoning described in an LLM's CoT and what it computes internally. We propose CoT-Interpretability Alignment (CIA), a metric that measures the agreement between a model's CoT traces and its internal reasoning strategies as detected by interpretability tools. We evaluate CIA on three tasks (two-hop question answering, hint intervention, and integer multiplication) across three LLMs, finding that LLMs exhibit limited alignment across all tasks (44.8-75.9%). We then experiment with improving CIA via post-training, setting both the task accuracy and parametric faithfulness signals as a reward. Experiments show that we can substantially improve CoT parametric faithfulness while maintaining or improving the task accuracy. We provide rich analysis, such as their generalization patterns. Our work provides both a framework for auditing CoT parametric faithfulness and a pathway toward making models' explicit reasoning more trustworthy. Code and data are available at https://github.com/yihuaihong/CIA-minimal-repro.

    思维链（CoT）轨迹常被用作了解大型语言模型（LLM）如何得出答案的替代指标。然而，越来越多的证据表明，模型的 CoT 往往无法反映其内部计算，而且即使改变 CoT，也可能不会影响最终答案。在本研究中，我们测量并提升 LLM 的 CoT 所描述的推理与其内部计算之间的一致性。我们提出 CoT-Interpretability Alignment（CIA），这是一种衡量模型 CoT 轨迹与可解释性工具检测到的内部推理策略之间一致程度的指标。我们在三个 LLM 上针对三项任务（两跳问答、提示干预和整数乘法）评估 CIA，发现 LLM 在所有任务上的一致性都有限（44.8-75.9%）。随后，我们尝试通过后训练提升 CIA，将任务准确率和参数忠实度信号都作为奖励。实验表明，我们能够显著提高 CoT 的参数忠实度，同时保持或提升任务准确率。我们还提供了丰富的分析，例如对其泛化模式的分析。本研究既提供了审计 CoT 参数忠实度的框架，也为提升模型显式推理的可信度提供了一条途径。代码和数据见 https://github.com/yihuaihong/CIA-minimal-repro。

    Feiyu Gavin Zhu, Xiaoyu Zhu, Jiqi Yang, Rui Yang, Arnab Kumar Mondal, Yancheng Wang, Xinke Deng, Jean Oh, Reid Simmons, Joerg Liebelt, Xiang Kong, Zhongyu Jiang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SSR makes recurring reasoning reusable by selecting among structured candidates and uses shared-cache parallel scoring to cut inference latency while preserving search performance. The reasoning and efficiency contributions are substantial, but the abstract does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    SSR 通过在结构化候选项中进行选择，使反复出现的推理可以重复使用，并借助共享缓存的并行评分降低推理延迟，同时保持搜索表现。其推理和效率方面的贡献很有分量，但摘要没有研究内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal agents commonly generate free-form reasoning before each action. For small models, limited model capacity can result in lengthy reasoning that provides little useful guidance for action generation while incurring substantial inference cost. To address this challenge, we introduce Selection-based Structured Reasoning (SSR), a framework that reformulates reasoning as selection instead of open-ended generation. SSR represents recurring high-level reasoning as pre-specified, reusable natural-language candidates. At each turn, the model selects from these reasoning candidates based on their likelihoods given the current context, without requiring an auxiliary task head. Using pre-specified reasoning traces enables parallel scoring, where teacher-forced prefilling computes token likelihoods concurrently within and across candidates using a shared context KV cache. We evaluate SSR on seven multimodal search benchmarks using 2B and 4B models. Across multiple reinforcement learning objectives and supervised fine-tuning, SSR delivers significant efficiency gains without sacrificing task performance. SSR achieves an average success rate competitive with leading search agents of the same scale, while reducing per-turn reasoning latency by over 90% and total per-question model inference latency by 28-54%. Project page: https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/.

    多模态智能体通常会在每次行动前生成自由形式的推理。对于小模型而言，模型容量有限可能导致推理冗长，却无法为行动生成提供多少有用指导，同时还会带来高昂的推理成本。为应对这一挑战，我们提出基于选择的结构化推理（SSR），这是一个将推理重新表述为选择而非开放式生成的框架。SSR 将反复出现的高层推理表示为预先指定、可重复使用的自然语言候选项。在每一轮中，模型根据这些推理候选项在当前上下文条件下的可能性进行选择，无需辅助任务头。使用预先指定的推理轨迹可以实现并行评分：通过教师强制预填充，在共享上下文 KV 缓存的基础上，并行计算各候选项内部及候选项之间的 token 似然。我们使用 2B 和 4B 模型，在七个多模态搜索基准上评估了 SSR。在多种强化学习目标和监督微调设置下，SSR 在不牺牲任务表现的情况下显著提升效率。SSR 的平均成功率可与同等规模的领先搜索智能体媲美，同时将每轮推理延迟降低 90% 以上，并将每个问题的模型总推理延迟降低 28-54%。项目页面：https://zfy0314.github.io/ssr-webpage/。

    Traian Serbanuta, Jun Xu, Andrei Stefanescu, Cosmin Radoi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that translating programming tasks into Lean theorem proving enables frontier models to prove a large benchmark, and compares proof success and cost across models and effort settings.     该论文表明，将编程任务转译为 Lean 定理证明，能使前沿模型证明大规模基准题目，并比较了不同模型和推理强度设置下的证明成功率与成本。这项工作对算法推理评估有很强的参考价值；验证器和智能体主要是应用系统，摘要也没有说明内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    VeriContest is a benchmark of 1007 competitive-programming problems in Rust, each with a Verus specification, a judge-accepted solution, and a Verus proof. Its authors report that proof generation is the bottleneck for frontier models: given the specification and the code, the best model produces an accepted Verus proof for 13.95% of the problems on the first attempt. We report on solving the same proof-generation task with Rust-Prover, a verifier for Rust backed by Lean 4. The Verus specification and the Rust code are restated and translated into Lean, each specification becomes a theorem, and agents prove the theorems with Lean's kernel as the final check. All 1325 theorems of all 1007 problems were proved. 1259 of them were proved in one run of under 32 hours on Claude Opus 5.5, at a median of 3.2 minutes and $1.17 per proof, and 70% of them on the first iteration. The restated specifications were checked against the benchmark's test suites, and reviewed where no suite applies. None was wrong or weakened. The translated Lean programs were run on 21,413 of the benchmark's test cases and produced the same output as the Rust programs on every one. Across four Claude and four GPT models at five reasoning-effort settings, every current frontier model proves nearly all of a ten-theorem sample at every setting, and more effort raises the cost without raising the number of proofs. The cheapest Claude setting, Sonnet 5.5 at low effort, proves all of the 50 hardest theorems. We also rerun the benchmark's own Verus protocol with Claude Opus 5.5 on the 50 problems with the longest reference proofs. Opus 5.5 alone fails to prove one of them.

    中文

    VeriContest 是一个包含 1007 道 Rust 竞赛编程题的基准，每道题都配有 Verus 规格说明、获评测器接受的解答以及 Verus 证明。其作者报告称，证明生成是前沿模型的瓶颈：给定规格说明和代码，最佳模型首次尝试就能为 13.95% 的题目生成获接受的 Verus 证明。我们报告了使用 Rust-Prover 完成同一证明生成任务的结果；Rust-Prover 是一个由 Lean 4 支持的 Rust 验证器。我们将 Verus 规格说明和 Rust 代码重新表述并翻译为 Lean，每个规格说明都成为一个定理，再由智能体证明这些定理，最终由 Lean 内核进行检查。所有 1007 道题的 1325 个定理全部得到证明。其中 1259 个由 Claude Opus 5.5 在一次运行中完成，耗时不到 32 小时；每个证明的中位耗时为 3.2 分钟，成本为 1.17 美元，70% 在第一次迭代中完成。我们依据该基准的测试套件检查了重新表述的规格说明；对于没有适用测试套件的情况，则进行了人工审查。没有任何规格说明存在错误或被弱化。我们运行了翻译后的 Lean 程序，测试了该基准的 21,413 个测试用例；每个用例的输出都与 Rust 程序相同。在四个 Claude 模型和四个 GPT 模型的五种推理强度设置下，每个当前前沿模型都能在每种设置下证明十定理样本中的几乎全部定理；提高推理强度会增加成本，却不会增加证明数量。成本最低的 Claude 设置——低推理强度的 Sonnet 5.5——证明了 50 个最难定理中的全部定理。我们还使用 Claude Opus 5.5，针对参考证明最长的 50 道题，重新运行该基准自身的 Verus 流程。仅使用 Opus 5.5 时，其中一道题未能得到证明。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper empirically studies when LLMs use specialist diagnostic advice effectively, finding that integration can underperform the stronger standalone source and that greater reasoning effort does not reliably fix the gap. This is a substantial contribution to tool-using system integration; its reasoning connection is more limited because it evaluates advice use rather than developing a reasoning mechanism.

    该论文通过实证研究 LLM 何时能有效利用专家诊断建议，发现集成表现可能低于较强的独立信息源，而且提高推理强度并不能可靠地弥补这一差距。这是对工具使用系统集成的重要贡献；其与推理的关联较有限，因为它评估的是建议使用情况，而不是提出一种推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.

    中文

    大型语言模型越来越多地被用作专业工具之上的集成层，但更强的组件不一定会带来更强的组合系统。我们在五个诊断数据集（轴承振动、过程监控、半导体设备）上研究 LLM 能否可靠地利用外部诊断信息；通过成对重复调用，将建议带来的影响与输出不稳定性区分开来。在全部五个数据集中，相互矛盾的外部信息都推翻了 LLM 原本正确的判断。在四个进行了直接集成比较的数据集中，没有一个显示隐式 LLM 集成能够稳定胜过更强的独立信息源。在一个田纳西—伊士曼确认集上，其评测流程在评估前已固定；未使用辅助信息时的准确率为 64.67%，隐式 LLM—专家集成的准确率为 77.43%，而专家单独使用时为 83.33%。专家信息使 LLM 的表现提高了 12.8 个百分点（95% 区间为 9.7 至 15.9），但集成输出仍比专家低 5.9 个百分点（95% 区间为 -12.0 至 -0.7）。双信息源选择器预言机达到 92.76%，说明存在集成输出未能充分实现的互补性。集成输出漏掉了 295 条专家修正中的 140 条（47.5%），同时推翻了 99 项 LLM 原本正确判断中的 15 项（15.2%）。在提示词和专家信息敏感性分析中，这一差距依然存在。在同时采用两种证据呈现方式均能解决的 CWRU 案例中，与任务相符的物理证据在七个模型中的六个模型上降低了对错误建议的易感性估计（其中五个模型的区间不含零）；在五个模型中，提高推理强度并未可靠地降低这种易感性；另一个针对四个模型的 TEP 分析也未明确显示推理强度能够解决集成问题。应分别评估信息源质量和集成质量：集成层应与其中较强的独立组件比较，而不仅仅与未获辅助的 LLM 比较。

    Green-Routed Neural Operators: Physics Determines Where the Network Reads

    绿色路由神经算子：物理决定网络在哪里读取

    Chenhao Si, Ming Yan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GRNO uses equation-derived read coordinates to route latent features, with ablations showing that this structural routing improves PDE forecasting. The routing is a substantive computational design contribution, but the abstract does not address internal interpretability, compositional generalization, or reasoning; latent-feature interventions alone do not establish those connections.

    GRNO 使用由方程推导出的读取坐标来路由潜在特征，消融实验表明，这种结构化路由能够改进 PDE 预测。该路由是重要的计算设计贡献，但摘要未涉及内部可解释性、组合泛化或推理；仅凭潜在特征干预不足以证明这些方面的关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We identify a mismatch between the physical role of transport fields in many PDEs and their usual role in neural operators: PDEs use them to select read coordinates, whereas neural operators typically treat them only as input values. We address this mismatch with the Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO), which uses the governing equation to determine where latent features are sampled. A parameter-free equation adapter evaluates the diagnostic relation and constructs a departure map whose values are the read coordinates. A multiscale encoder-decoder combines centered and routed reads of latent features to learn the complete finite-time update. Across five two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, GRNO achieves the lowest mean final relative $L^2$ error on four under 40-step autoregressive evaluation and remains competitive on Keller-Segel. Fixed-weight route interventions reveal strong dependence on direction and spatial alignment in four systems, with weak dependence in Keller-Segel. In independently trained ablations, GRNO achieves lower mean errors than variants that supply the transport field only as an input feature, substitute a learned displacement for the equation-specified route, or apply the route with a spatial misalignment, across all five systems. It also substantially outperforms directly advecting the physical state and learning the remaining update, indicating that equation-specified read coordinates provide an effective structural prior for long-horizon PDE forecasting.

    中文

    我们发现，许多 PDE 中输运场的物理作用与其在神经算子中的通常作用并不匹配：PDE 利用它们选择读取坐标，而神经算子通常只将它们视为输入值。为解决这一不匹配，我们提出绿色路由神经算子（GRNO），利用控制方程决定潜在特征的采样位置。一个无参数的方程适配器评估诊断关系，并构造一个离开映射，其值即为读取坐标。多尺度编码器—解码器结合对潜在特征的中心读取与路由读取，以学习完整的有限时间更新。在五种二维和三维 PDE 系统上，GRNO 在 40 步自回归评估中，有四种系统的最终相对均方$L^2$误差均值最低，并且在 Keller-Segel 系统上仍具竞争力。固定权重的路由干预显示，在四种系统中模型对方向和空间对齐有很强的依赖，而在 Keller-Segel 中这种依赖较弱。在独立训练的消融实验中，与仅将输运场作为输入特征、用学习得到的位移替代方程指定路由，或将路由应用于空间错位位置的变体相比，GRNO 在全部五种系统上的平均误差都更低。它还显著优于直接输运物理状态并学习其余更新的方法，表明由方程指定的读取坐标为长时程 PDE 预测提供了有效的结构先验。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MAGI coordinates molecular-design tools and adapts its strategy, while the study finds scorer applicability limits campaign success; its main contribution is an agent coordination system evaluated on real drug-discovery campaigns. Plausible SAR reasoning is an application capability, not a substantive study of general reasoning mechanisms.

    MAGI 协调分子设计工具并调整策略，而研究发现评分器的适用性限制了项目成功；其主要贡献是一个在真实药物发现项目中得到评估的智能体协调系统。合理的构效关系推理属于应用能力，并非对一般推理机制的实质性研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure--activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT 4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from three pharmaceutical companies, replayed under fixed temporal cutoffs. Both routes produced valid structures: LLM proposals stayed closer to local chemistry and reached comparable or higher primary activity in fewer operations, whereas REINVENT explored broader chemical space. Whether a campaign met its objective depended on the predictive models, not on the generation route: attainment followed model accuracy on the chemistry proposed, dropping once that chemistry moved outside the model's applicability domain. Separately, a blinded evaluation asked whether the MAGI's output could pass as expert work: chemists were not able to discriminate agentic proposals from held-out compounds, and judged the SAR reasoning broadly plausible yet incomplete. Together, these results position MAGI as a coordination layer pluggable into existing computational chemistry workflows. The ceiling on real projects, however, remains currently set by scorer applicability rather than by tool orchestration.

    中文

    智能体系统日益负责协调分子设计工具，但目前尚不清楚整个技术栈中的哪一层限制了真实项目的成果。我们开发了 MAGI，这是一种开放、模块化的智能体，能够制定目标、启动并监控优化、解读构效关系，并据此调整策略。MAGI 可以直接通过 LLM 生成分子，也可以委托 REINVENT 4 生成；评分服务则可以在统一接口契约下互换。我们在来自三家制药公司的九项回顾性先导物优化项目中测试了该系统，并按固定的时间截点重放项目。两种路径都生成了有效结构：LLM 提案更接近局部化学空间，并以更少的操作达到相当或更高的主要活性；而 REINVENT 探索了更广泛的化学空间。项目能否达到目标取决于预测模型，而非生成路径：目标达成情况取决于模型对所提议化学结构的预测准确度，一旦这些化学结构超出模型的适用域，达标情况就会下降。另有一项盲测评估 MAGI 的输出能否被视为专家成果：化学家无法区分智能体提出的结构与留出的化合物，并认为其构效关系推理总体合理但尚不完整。综合而言，这些结果表明，MAGI 可以作为协调层接入现有计算化学工作流。然而，真实项目的上限目前仍由评分器的适用性决定，而非工具编排。

    Wikidata 搜索轨迹：用于训练知识图谱搜索智能体的数据集

    Mohamed Chenene, Carlos Rosas-Hinostroza, Anastasia Stasenko, Shani Evenstein Sigalov, Pierre-Carl Langlais

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper releases multi-hop Wikidata search traces and an agent harness that manages graph results in persistent state, improving answer accuracy; this advances knowledge-graph agent systems. Nested conditions and relation chaining provide some compositional and multi-step reasoning relevance, but the abstract does not establish a broader mechanism or capability advance in those areas.

    该论文发布多跳 Wikidata 搜索轨迹和一种在持久化状态中管理图谱结果的智能体工具框架，并展示了答案准确率的提升；这推进了知识图谱智能体系统的发展。嵌套条件和关系串联使该工作与组合推理及多步推理有一定关联，但摘要并未证实这些领域中更广泛的机制或能力提升。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Wikidata is one of the largest open knowledge bases, yet answering a complex question over it still requires a SPARQL query that names the right entities and properties and chains their relations. Language models offer a natural-language alternative but answer largely from memory, which is least reliable for less prominent entities. We study agents that instead answer by exploring the graph, and argue that two obstacles limit them: the lack of training data recording how a solver explores, and interfaces that add large graph results directly to the model's context. We test three hypotheses: that the difficulty of graph search can be controlled through the structure of a question rather than only through obscure entities or wording; that much of the failure on long-horizon search comes from how retrieved evidence is managed rather than from the model itself; and that, in a suitable environment, open-weight models can match commercial closed ones. We construct multi-hop questions on a frozen Wikidata snapshot by replacing named entities with nested conditions, checking after each expansion that the target remains unique and that every new condition is necessary. We release 10,235 solving traces over single-entity and multi-hop questions, together with the recursive language model (RLM) harness that produced them, in which models batch graph calls, keep results in persistent Python state and interpret selected evidence through sub-calls. On 100 questions, the harness improves both models we ran under both interfaces compared with direct tool calling over the same functions: gpt-6-luna rises from 49 to 61 correct answers, doubling its multi-hop accuracy, and Qwen3.8-27B, an open-weight model served on a single GPU, from 60 to 74.

    中文

    Wikidata 是最大的开放知识库之一，但要回答其中的复杂问题，仍需编写 SPARQL 查询，准确指定实体和属性，并串联它们之间的关系。语言模型提供了一种自然语言替代方案，但其回答很大程度上依赖记忆，而对知名度较低的实体，记忆尤其不可靠。我们研究改为通过探索图谱来回答问题的智能体，并指出有两个障碍限制了它们：缺少记录求解过程的训练数据，以及会将大型图谱结果直接加入模型上下文的接口。我们检验三个假设：图谱搜索的难度可以通过问题结构来控制，而不只是依靠冷门实体或措辞；长时程搜索中的许多失败源于检索证据的管理方式，而非模型本身；在合适的环境中，开放权重模型可以达到商业闭源模型的表现。我们基于冻结的 Wikidata 快照构建多跳问题：将命名实体替换为嵌套条件，并在每次扩展后检查目标是否仍然唯一以及每个新增条件是否都不可或缺。我们发布了针对单实体和多跳问题的 10,235 条求解轨迹，以及生成这些轨迹的递归语言模型（RLM）工具框架。在该框架中，模型会批量调用图谱、将结果保存在持久化 Python 状态中，并通过子调用解读选定证据。在 100 道问题上，与通过相同函数直接调用工具相比，该工具框架在我们采用两种接口运行的两个模型上都提升了表现：gpt-6-luna 的正确答案数从 49 个升至 61 个，多跳准确率翻倍；在单块 GPU 上运行的开放权重模型 Qwen3.8-27B 则从 60 个升至 74 个。

    TRIAGE: Direction-Aware Mismatch Stabilization of Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning

    TRIAGE：面向方向的原生 NVFP4 强化学习失配稳定方法

    Zhen Li, Shuai Zhang, Yanggan Gu, Yiming Zhang, Yang Yu, Mingfa Feng, Congkai Xie, Shuang Yu, Junjie Lai, Hongxia Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TRIAGE analyzes how execution mismatch interacts with policy-gradient direction and introduces segment-level stabilization for low-precision RL, achieving stable training on mathematical reasoning tasks. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to training reasoning models; throughput and low-precision execution are relevant to systems, but the contribution is primarily optimization rather than a systems design advance.

    TRIAGE 分析执行失配如何与策略梯度方向相互作用，并提出片段级稳定方法，以在数学推理任务上实现稳定训练。这是对推理模型训练的一项重要算法贡献；吞吐量和低精度执行与系统相关，但其主要贡献在于优化，而非系统设计方面的进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Low-precision execution can substantially accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models, but discrepancies between learner and sampler execution can destabilize policy optimization. In this paper, we characterize the interaction between mismatch and the policy-gradient direction, distinguishing locally amplifying from contracting update contributions that mismatch magnitude alone cannot identify. In native NVFP4 runs, we observe an early imbalance between the two amplifying regions, favoring negative-advantage, negative-gap updates. Their tail tokens become concentrated in a small fraction of response segments before mismatch spreads globally. Motivated by these findings, we introduce TRIAGE, a direction-aware stabilization method that uses segment-level diagnosis to selectively rebalance policy-gradient updates and applies bounded repair to residual severe mismatch. TRIAGE modifies the optimization objective while retaining native NVFP4 weight-and activation 4-bit (W4A4) forward execution on both the sampler and learner. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B show stable optimization throughout the evaluated training horizon and achieve full precision level performance across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while native NVFP4 with TRIAGE provides up to 2.3x higher rollout throughput than BF16.

    中文

    低精度执行能够显著加速大语言模型的强化学习（RL），但学习器与采样器执行之间的差异可能使策略优化不稳定。本文刻画了失配与策略梯度方向之间的相互作用，区分局部放大和收缩的更新贡献；仅凭失配幅度无法识别这两者。在原生 NVFP4 运行中，我们观察到两类放大区域早期出现失衡，负优势、负间隙更新占据优势。在失配扩散到全局之前，这些更新的尾部 token 已集中在少量响应片段中。受此发现启发，我们提出 TRIAGE，这是一种面向方向的稳定方法，通过片段级诊断有选择地重新平衡策略梯度更新，并对残留的严重失配进行有界修复。TRIAGE 在采样器和学习器上均保留原生 NVFP4 权重与激活 4 位（W4A4）前向执行，同时修改优化目标。在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的实验表明，该方法在整个评估训练周期内实现稳定优化，并在五个数学推理基准上达到全精度水平的性能；原生 NVFP4 配合 TRIAGE 的 rollout 吞吐量最高可达 BF16 的 2.3 倍。

    Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

    中文

    大语言模型（LLM）后训练中的强化学习（RL）在 rollout 生成期间会产生大量计算和内存开销，因此需要采用低精度 rollout 来提高 RL 训练效率。然而，现有 FP4 RL 方法存在一个关键局限：它们主要分别优化训练路径和 rollout 路径上的量化精度，而不是直接减少两条量化执行路径之间的差异。本文提出 TRACE（通过紧凑引导实现训练与 rollout 量化对齐），这是一种用于混合专家（MoE）语言模型 RL 训练的 FP4 量化框架，旨在解决现有 FP4 RL 方法的局限。TRACE 纳入了 rollout 引导的量化感知训练，利用 rollout 侧的量化结果指导训练侧的 FP4 舍入决策，从而直接减少训练与 rollout 之间的差异。此外，TRACE 采用高效的量化信息缓存方案，有选择地保留较深层中的尾数和尺度信息，以减少 rollout 引导带来的存储和通信开销。我们在四个大型 MoE 语言模型上评估了 TRACE，涵盖推理、编码和长时程 RL 任务。结果表明，TRACE 能够联合进行 FP4 权重/激活量化和 FP4 KV-cache rollout，同时 RL 性能与 BF16 rollout 相当；与对 BF16 训练策略进行事后 FP4 量化相比，其 rollout 速度最高提升 5.4 倍，且最终 FP4 性能出色。

    Avyay M. Casheekar, Hariganesh Tangirala

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives how policy sharing and audit allocation affect reporting in a multi-agent safety game, with PPO experiments supporting those results. Its main contribution concerns agent organization and learning dynamics, while witness grouping is only an incidental connection to compositional structure and it does not study internal model mechanisms or general reasoning.

    本文推导了策略共享和审计分配如何影响多智能体安全博弈中的报告行为，并通过 PPO 实验支持这些结果。其主要贡献涉及智能体组织方式和学习动态；目击者分组与组合结构只有偶然关联，且本文未研究模型内部机制或一般推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a team of agents shares a reward for completed tasks, reporting and stopping unsafe work reduces the team's reward. Random audits that penalize silence can make universal reporting optimal without ensuring that a silent team learns to report. We study this problem in a game where any witness can stop a task by reporting. When a task's k witnesses share a policy and draw actions independently, the derivative of expected reward with respect to the shared silence probability at universal silence counts its benefit k times, while the comparison between universal reporting and silence counts it once. A fully shared policy can therefore be locally attracted to silence even when reporting is optimal. For any grouping into shared policies, we give an audit condition sufficient for exact policy-gradient updates to reach universal reporting and, outside boundary cases, necessary from near universal silence. In a balanced family, meeting the condition with prescribed margins costs k times as much for a fully shared policy as for one policy per role. We test these predictions with PPO on 24 witness graphs, starting from learned silence. Witness groups, which place co-witnesses in separate networks, reduce unsafe task completion by 33.59 percentage points relative to shuffled groups of the same sizes under the same audits (95% graph-bootstrap interval: 21.03-45.13). Only 9 of 48 witness-group runs achieve below 1% unsafe completion while retaining at least 90% legitimate completion. At the same audit budget, a fully shared network meets both thresholds in 0/48 runs with independent action draws and 48/48 with a common draw. On 24 further graphs with witness groups fixed, audits allocated by the condition reduce unsafe completion by 42.22 points relative to audits maximizing a static coalition deterrence ratio at the same budget.

    中文

    当一个智能体团队共享已完成任务的奖励时，报告并停止不安全工作会降低团队的奖励。对沉默行为施加惩罚的随机审计可以使全员报告成为最优策略，但不能确保一个沉默的团队学会报告。我们在一种博弈中研究这个问题：任何目击者都可以通过报告来停止任务。当某项任务的 k 名目击者共享一个策略并独立抽取动作时，在全员沉默处，期望奖励对共享沉默概率的导数会将沉默的收益计算 k 次，而全员报告与全员沉默之间的比较则只计算一次。因此，即使报告是最优的，完全共享的策略在局部仍可能被沉默吸引。对于任意共享策略的分组方式，我们给出一个审计条件，该条件足以确保精确的策略梯度更新达到全员报告；除边界情形外，从接近全员沉默的状态出发，该条件也是必要的。在一个平衡的模型族中，要以指定裕度满足该条件，完全共享策略所需的成本是每个角色单独使用一个策略时的 k 倍。我们从已学习到沉默的状态出发，在 24 个目击者图上用 PPO 检验这些预测。目击者分组将共同目击者置于不同网络中；在相同审计条件下，与规模相同的打乱分组相比，这种分组使不安全任务完成率降低 33.59 个百分点（95% 图级 bootstrap 区间：21.03–45.13）。在 48 次目击者分组运行中，只有 9 次在保持至少 90% 合法任务完成率的同时，将不安全任务完成率降至 1% 以下。在相同审计预算下，完全共享网络在采用独立动作抽样时，48 次运行中有 0 次同时达到这两个阈值；采用共同抽样时则有 48 次达到。在另外 24 个固定了目击者分组的图上，与在相同预算下最大化静态联盟威慑比率的审计分配相比，按该条件分配审计使不安全任务完成率降低了 42.22 个百分点。

    Democratizing MoE inference on commodity GPUs with CoMoE

    CoMoE：让普通消费级 GPU 上的 MoE 推理普及化

    Ruwen Fan, Yuezhi Zu, Minhui Xie, Junru Li, Qingda Hu, Xinjun (Jimmy) Yang, Jiwu Shu, Youyou Lu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CoMoE introduces host-centric routing and token aggregation to reduce communication bottlenecks in MoE inference, with measured throughput gains on commodity GPUs. This is a substantial systems contribution, but the abstract offers no insight into internal representations, compositional generalization, or reasoning mechanisms.

    CoMoE 提出以主机为中心的路由和令牌聚合，以减少 MoE 推理中的通信瓶颈，并展示了在消费级 GPU 上测得的吞吐量提升。这是一项重要的系统贡献，但摘要没有提供关于内部表征、组合泛化或推理机制的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Deploying Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models relies heavily on Expert Parallelism, which generates intense inter-GPU communication. Consequently, state-of-the-art inference systems require high-bandwidth, P2P interconnects (e.g., NVLink) in datacenter GPUs to handle massive token routing, making deployment prohibitively expensive. Consumer GPUs offer comparable compute power at significantly lower cost, promising to democratize MoE inference for individuals and enable privacy-preserving local deployments. However, their bandwidth-limited (only weak PCIe bus bandwidth) and host-mediated interconnects (no P2P support) introduce severe communication bottlenecks. We present CoMoE, a communication-efficient MoE inference system that resolves this mismatch through novel host-centric routing. Our key insight is that the unique communication topology provides the opportunity to elevate the host to an active routing hub, which can fundamentally reduce communication volume and eliminate global synchronization-induced stalls. Specifically, for token dispatch, we introduce host-backed token multicast to write shared tokens to the host exactly once, eliminating outbound transmission redundancy. For token combine, we propose a fine-grained, token-level aggregation mechanism using host staging buffers, which replaces rigid global synchronization and mitigates straggler effects. Evaluation on RTX 5090 GPUs shows that CoMoE improves inference throughput by up to 1.46x, approaching the performance of NVLink-capable A800 GPUs at only 23.4% of the hardware cost.

    中文

    部署混合专家（MoE）模型高度依赖专家并行，这会产生大量 GPU 间通信。因此，最先进的推理系统需要数据中心 GPU 上的高带宽点对点（P2P）互连（例如 NVLink），以处理大量令牌路由，导致部署成本高得令人难以承受。消费级 GPU 以显著低得多的成本提供相近的计算能力，有望让个人也能使用 MoE 推理，并支持保护隐私的本地部署。然而，其带宽受限（PCIe 总线带宽较弱）且依赖主机中介的互连（不支持 P2P），会造成严重的通信瓶颈。我们提出 CoMoE，这是一种通信高效的 MoE 推理系统，通过新颖的以主机为中心的路由来解决这一不匹配问题。我们的关键洞见是，独特的通信拓扑提供了机会，可将主机提升为主动的路由枢纽，从根本上减少通信量，并消除由全局同步引起的停顿。具体而言，在令牌分发方面，我们提出由主机支持的令牌多播，将共享令牌写入主机一次，从而消除向外传输中的冗余。在令牌合并方面，我们提出一种使用主机暂存缓冲区的细粒度令牌级聚合机制，以取代僵化的全局同步并缓解落后者效应。在 RTX 5090 GPU 上的评测表明，CoMoE 将推理吞吐量最多提升 1.46 倍，性能接近支持 NVLink 的 A800 GPU，而硬件成本仅为其 23.4%。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models are increasingly contributing to mathematical research, where progress often depends on efficient proof search, incremental improvements and careful verification. We describe Bolzano, a multi-agent open-source system that uses parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. Initial manual use on expert-selected problems yielded 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Motivated by these case studies, we ran Bolzano without problem-specific human guidance on about 3,800 open problems extracted from four sets of papers, solving about 200 open problems. One experiment used papers accepted to STOC 2026, a top conference in theoretical computer science. There, we answered four questions raised in the papers, as confirmed by their authors.

    Decoupling Logic from Persona: Structural Immunity of Edge LLM Agents to Context Pollution

    将逻辑与角色设定解耦：边缘端 LLM 智能体对上下文污染的结构性免疫

    Masaaki Nakatsu (AO, Inc. / OrbLabs AG), Reno Wang (AO, Inc.)

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes and evaluates separating logical inference from persona rendering, with a structured intermediate state and hot-swappable adapters to improve robustness to context pollution. This substantially advances agent architecture and computation organization; its logic evaluation is relevant to reasoning, but it does not study reasoning mechanisms in depth, and the separation alone offers little compositional-generalization insight or interpretability.

    本文提出并评估了一种将逻辑推理与角色呈现分离的方法，通过结构化中间状态和可热切换的适配器来提升对上下文污染的鲁棒性。这显著推进了智能体架构和计算组织；其逻辑评估与推理相关，但没有深入研究推理机制，而单靠这种分离对组合泛化的启示或可解释性的贡献有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Edge language-model agents must hold a persona and reason correctly at once, in one context window that fills with history and persona instructions. We study what happens to the logical part of such an agent when that history is long, misleading and persona-heavy (persona-logic interference), and present a Decoupling Architecture (AO-DA) that separates logical inference ("What") from persona expression ("How") into two inference paths on one INT4 base model with hot-swappable LoRA adapters. The logic path receives only the core turn and emits a verifiable structured state (Micro-State); the persona path renders it in character with the full history. In same-base-model ablations on an Apple M2 laptop (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-3-4B-it, 4-bit; 480 runs: 2 bases x 4 pollution levels x 3 arms x 2 tasks x 2 personas x 5 seeds) we find: (i) the decoupled logic path is structurally invariant to pollution: its prompt stays at 180 (Llama) or 167 (Gemma) tokens while the mixed single-pass prompt grows from 242 to 1,203 on Llama, and its outputs are byte-identical across levels (40/40); (ii) the mixed single pass degrades monotonically (composite logic score 0.669 to 0.150 on Llama, 0.487 to 0.150 on Gemma), mostly by failing to emit the required structured output (80-95% of runs on Llama, 100% on Gemma at the two highest levels); (iii) with the same pollution fed into the logic path, the dedicated-adapter, dedicated-format path is still more robust than the single pass on the 8B model (failure 0-20% vs 25-95% at L2-L4; paired $\Delta$ +0.30 to +0.50, Cliff's $\delta$ 0.50-0.85, Holm-adjusted $p \le 0.03$) but not on the 4B model, where both collapse. Separation costs one extra decode on a topic's first turn (28.2 s vs 18.2 s on Llama) and buys persona hot-swapping in 1.7 ms (warm median) without re-running the logic path. Code, logic-path adapters, logs and analysis scripts are released.

    中文

    边缘端语言模型智能体必须在同一个不断被历史记录和角色设定指令填满的上下文窗口中，同时维持角色设定并正确推理。我们研究当这段历史冗长、具有误导性且充斥角色设定时，此类智能体的逻辑部分会发生什么（角色设定—逻辑干扰），并提出一种解耦架构（AO-DA），在一个支持热插拔 LoRA 适配器的 INT4 基础模型上，将逻辑推理（“做什么”）与角色表达（“如何表达”）分离为两条推理路径。逻辑路径仅接收当前轮次的核心内容，并输出可验证的结构化状态（Micro-State）；角色路径则结合完整历史，以角色身份呈现该状态。在 Apple M2 笔记本电脑上进行的同一基础模型消融实验中（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Gemma-3-4B-it，4 位量化；共 480 次运行：2 个基础模型 × 4 个污染等级 × 3 种方案 × 2 项任务 × 2 种角色设定 × 5 个随机种子），我们发现：(i) 解耦后的逻辑路径在结构上不受污染影响：其提示词长度保持为 180 个（Llama）或 167 个（Gemma）token，而混合式单次推理提示词在 Llama 上从 242 个增长到 1,203 个 token；且其输出在不同等级间逐字节完全相同（40/40）；(ii) 混合式单次推理的表现随污染程度单调下降（Llama 上综合逻辑得分从 0.669 降至 0.150，Gemma 上从 0.487 降至 0.150），主要原因是未能输出所要求的结构化结果（Llama 在最高两个等级下有 80–95% 的运行未能输出，Gemma 则为 100%）；(iii) 将相同污染输入逻辑路径时，在 8B 模型上，使用专用适配器和专用格式的路径仍比单次推理更稳健（在 L2–L4 下失败率为 0–20%，而单次推理为 25–95%；配对 $\Delta$ +0.30 至 +0.50，Cliff's $\delta$ 0.50–0.85，Holm 校正后的 $p \le 0.03$），但在 4B 模型上并非如此，因为两者都崩溃。解耦方案在某个主题的首轮需额外进行一次解码（Llama 上为 28.2 秒，而单次推理为 18.2 秒），但无需重新运行逻辑路径，即可在 1.7 毫秒内热切换角色设定（预热后的中位数）。代码、逻辑路径适配器、日志和分析脚本均已发布。

    Reasoning-Token Spikes Under Prompted Untruthful Responses in Large Language Models

    大语言模型在被提示给出不真实回答时的推理 token 激增

    Maverick Morales, Tom\'a\v{s} Dominik, Vermut Gao, Katrina Shirey, Paulius Rimkevi\v{c}ius, Aaron Schurger, Uri Maoz

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study tests whether reasoning-token counts distinguish truthful from prompted untruthful responses, finding consistent group-level differences across three models. This is a substantive empirical contribution to evaluating reasoning behavior, but it does not explain internal mechanisms; monitoring and model behavior are incidental connections to systems, while composition is not addressed.

    本研究检验推理 token 数量能否区分真实回答与被提示的不真实回答，并发现三个模型上都存在一致的群体层面差异。这是对推理行为评估的一项重要实证贡献，但没有解释内部机制；监测和模型行为与系统只有间接联系，本文也未涉及组合能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Monitoring the chain-of-thought of reasoning artificial intelligence (AI) models remains a key approach to detecting deception and other forms of misbehavior in such models. However, semantic chain-of-thought monitoring depends on reasoning traces being legible and sufficiently faithful to the underlying computations that produced the model's behavior, not to mention accessible. Moreover, there is increasing evidence that chain-of-thought outputs may soon become illegible or unfaithful, if they even remain accessible. Based on cognitive load theory, we investigate a lower-bandwidth signal--the number of reasoning tokens generated--which does not require access to the content of the reasoning trace. Three reasoning-capable large language models answered 210 multiple-choice questions--across analytic, descriptive, and normative reasoning types as well as moral and non-moral domains--under system prompts instructing them to respond truthfully, falsely, or without regard for truth. Across all three models, truth-directed responses elicited fewer reasoning tokens than both lie-directed and truth-indifferent responses. In addition, in one model, untruthful instructions increased the likelihood of reasoning at all. These findings show that explicitly prompted untruthful response policies can produce robust group-level differences in test-time reasoning-token use. While not yet establishing reasoning-token count as a detector of spontaneous deception or general misalignment, our results are a proof of concept that it can serve as a simple, content-independent black-box candidate signal for differentiating untruthful from truthful model behavior when raw reasoning traces are unavailable or unreliable. Future work should test instance-level detection rates, out-of-distribution generalization, learned deceptive policies, hidden objectives, and robustness under adversarial pressure.

    中文

    监测推理型人工智能（AI）模型的思维链，仍是检测模型欺骗及其他不当行为的主要方法。然而，基于语义的思维链监测依赖于推理轨迹清晰可读，并且足够忠实地反映产生模型行为的底层计算；这些轨迹还必须能够被访问。此外，越来越多的证据表明，思维链输出可能很快变得难以理解或不再忠实，即使它们届时仍可访问也是如此。基于认知负荷理论，我们研究一种信息带宽较低的信号——生成的推理 token 数量；这种信号无需访问推理轨迹的内容。三个具备推理能力的大语言模型回答了 210 道选择题，题目涵盖分析性、描述性和规范性推理类型，以及道德和非道德领域；系统提示要求模型如实作答、作假作答，或不考虑真假作答。在三个模型中，要求如实作答时生成的推理 token 均少于要求撒谎或不考虑真假时生成的数量。此外，在一个模型中，不真实作答指令提高了模型进行任何推理的可能性。这些发现表明，明确提示的不真实回答策略能够在测试时推理 token 用量上产生稳定的群体层面差异。我们的结果尚未证明推理 token 数量能够检测自发欺骗或一般性错位，但作为概念验证，它表明当原始推理轨迹不可用或不可靠时，推理 token 数量可作为一种简单、与内容无关的黑盒候选信号，用于区分模型的不真实行为与真实行为。未来工作应测试单个实例的检测率、分布外泛化、学习得到的欺骗策略、隐藏目标，以及在对抗压力下的稳健性。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PHRBench measures how LLMs respond to hallucinated premises during reasoning and finds that belief updates are associated with successful correction. This is a substantive behavioral evaluation of reasoning, while trajectory structure and multi-stage context alone do not establish compositional generalization or a systems contribution.

    PHRBench 衡量 LLM 在推理过程中如何响应幻觉前提，并发现信念更新与成功纠错相关。这是对推理行为的重要评估；仅凭轨迹结构和多阶段上下文本身，无法证明其涉及组合泛化或系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Hallucinated information can propagate through multi-stage LLM systems and become part of the context for subsequent reasoning. Existing studies of post-hallucination reasoning (PHR) mainly characterize changes in final outcomes and aggregate reasoning dynamics, leaving how models resolve hallucinated premises at the response level insufficiently understood. In this work, we introduce PHRBench, a controlled benchmark for behaviorally structured PHR across four domains and 18 large language models. PHRBench characterizes each reasoning trajectory independently of final-answer correctness through Hallucination Compliance, Hallucination Avoidance, and Heuristic Correction, and defines an insightful trajectory as successful correction that ultimately reaches the correct answer. Across 4820 controlled instances, we find that successful recovery remains relatively rare and is associated with more frequent belief updates along the reasoning trajectory. We further find that properties of the hallucinated prompt contain substantial predictive signal for successful recovery, with a lightweight predictor achieving an AUROC of 0.847. These findings provide a behavioral view of post-hallucination reasoning, characterizing how LLMs resolve erroneous context and when successful recovery is likely to occur.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    This paper studies the problem of learning disentangled representations of objects and their attributes from raw, unstructured image data. Slot-based methods have shown considerable success in unsupervised learning of object representations from images. Block-slot attention-based methods extend this framework to attribute representations by assuming a uniform factorization of object representations into attributes, which may be suboptimal and consequently limit the quality of the learned representations. We therefore investigate a framework for jointly discovering object and attribute representations. Our key contribution is leveraging the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which postulates that composable concepts can be represented as linearly additive subspaces in slot representations. Based on this insight, we propose a probabilistic model connecting images, slots (objects), and blocks (attributes). We present an architecture that leverages block attention to connect attribute representations to slots and incorporates LRH in both object and attribute representation spaces. This architecture effectively optimizes the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) of the proposed graphical model. Our experiments demonstrate (i) effective discovery of disentangled object and attribute representations, (ii) empirical evidence for LRH in slot space, and (iii) the ability to perform image editing owing to the disentangled and interpretable nature of the learned representations. Our experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate improvements in DCI scores over state-of-the-art methods.

    Liv G. d'Aliberti, Marwa Abdulhai, Sofiia Druchyna, Peter Henderson, and Manoel Horta Ribeiro

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures solution mode collapse during RLVR and proposes replay that preserves and uniformly trains on verified solution modes, improving success and diversity. This substantially advances training for problem solving; solution diversity is relevant to composition only indirectly, and the replay buffer is a limited systems contribution rather than a study of model internals or system design.

    本文衡量 RLVR 期间的解答模式坍缩，并提出重放方法来保留已验证的解答模式并对其进行均匀训练，从而提升成功率和多样性。这显著推进了问题求解训练；解答多样性与组合的相关性只是间接的，而重放缓冲区仅构成有限的系统贡献，并非对模型内部机制或系统设计的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A language model (LM) can usually answer the same question in more than one way, but reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is indifferent to which correct answer a model produces. A solution will earn the same reward whether it is the thousandth copy of a familiar answer or one the model has never produced before. Yet, there is potential value in having the model retain multiple correct solutions as it is trained. For instance, multiple modes may give users a choice and provide problem-solving strategies that improve overall model performance. Here, we introduce ModeBench, a benchmark of multi-solution tasks in which the verifier returns both correctness and mode discovered. We then use ModeBench to measure how solution diversity changes under RLVR post-training. We find that RLVR post-training concentrates probability onto fewer correct modes even as accuracy holds or improves, and moreover, that frontier models are already highly concentrated. We then introduce our solution, Re:Max, which stores one verified example per discovered mode in a replay buffer and trains on those stored modes uniformly. A solution found once is, therefore, practiced as often as one found repeatedly. Across three model scales, two RL objectives, and harder task constructions, replay improves both how often a policy succeeds and how many different ways it can succeed.

    中文

    语言模型（LM）通常能以不止一种方式回答同一个问题，但带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）并不区分模型给出的正确答案。一种解法无论是熟悉答案的第一千次重复，还是模型从未给出过的答案，都会获得相同奖励。然而，在训练过程中让模型保留多种正确解法可能是有价值的。例如，多种模式可以为用户提供选择，并提供能够提升模型整体性能的问题求解策略。在这里，我们提出 ModeBench，这是一个多解任务基准，其验证器会同时返回正确性和发现的模式。随后，我们使用 ModeBench 衡量 RLVR 后训练如何改变解答多样性。我们发现，即使准确率保持不变或有所提升，RLVR 后训练仍会将概率集中到更少的正确模式上；此外，前沿模型的概率分布本身已经高度集中。接着，我们提出 Re:Max：它在重放缓冲区中为每个发现的模式存储一个已验证示例，并对这些存储模式进行均匀训练。因此，一个只发现过一次的解法，会和被反复发现的解法一样频繁地得到练习。在三种模型规模、两种 RL 目标以及更难的任务构造上，重放既提高了策略成功的频率，也增加了策略成功解题的方式数量。

    Fan Gao, Wei Su, Juntong Fan, Renfeng Peng, Hongyu Liu, Jinqiao Duan, Feng-Lei Fan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops and analyzes dynamic-system-based weight compression, including a bound connecting trajectory length to coverage of weight space and decompression error. This is a substantial contribution to model computation and storage efficiency, but it does not address the other directions.

    本文开发并分析了基于动力系统的权重压缩方法，包括一个将轨迹长度与权重空间覆盖范围及解压缩误差联系起来的界。这对模型计算和存储效率做出了重要贡献，但没有涉及其他方向。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The escalating size of pretrained neural networks has rendered model compression a prerequisite for deployment under stringent memory and compute constraints. With the irrational winding as an example, earlier work introduced a dynamic system (DS) paradigm that reconceptualizes compression as compact weight representation: high-dimensional parameters are encoded by the index of a trajectory produced by a dynamic system, from which the vector is recovered during decompression. This mechanism is fundamentally distinct from pruning, quantization, knowledge distillation, and low-rank decomposition. Along this direction, we prove that under a Diophantine condition, a finite trajectory of \(M = O(\epsilon^{-(d+\nu)})\) states in the irrational winding constitutes an \(\epsilon\)-net over the \(d\)-dimensional weight space, thereby linking state resolution, decompression error, and compression ratio in a predictable manner. Furthermore, we propose a generalized DS-based model compression framework by unifying four DS families---space-filling curves (Hilbert, Peano, Morton/Z-order, Snake), chaotic systems (Lorenz), congruential and pseudo-random generators (LCG, PCG), and low-discrepancy sequences (Halton). Also, we introduce the KD-tree and coordinate-template acceleration to scale to large models as well as outlier identification to control the error. Experiments on ResNet-18 and Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B validate that DS-based compression achieves competitive compression ratios without post-hoc retraining, with controllable decompression error and flexible state-space design, establishing it as a principled and practical compression approach.

    预训练神经网络规模不断扩大，使模型压缩成为在严格内存和计算约束下部署模型的先决条件。以无理绕线为例，早期工作提出了动力系统（DS）范式，将压缩重新构想为紧凑的权重表示：高维参数由动力系统生成的轨迹索引进行编码，并在解压缩时据此恢复向量。这种机制与剪枝、量化、知识蒸馏和低秩分解有根本区别。沿着这一方向，我们证明，在丢番图条件下，无理绕线中的一条有限轨迹，其包含 \(M = O(\epsilon^{-(d+\nu)})\) 个状态，并构成权重空间上的一个 \(\epsilon\)-网；该权重空间的维度为 \(d\)，从而以可预测的方式将状态分辨率、解压缩误差和压缩率联系起来。此外，我们提出一个通用的基于 DS 的模型压缩框架，将四类 DS 统一起来——空间填充曲线（Hilbert、Peano、Morton/Z-order、Snake）、混沌系统（Lorenz）、同余和伪随机数生成器（LCG、PCG），以及低差异序列（Halton）。此外，我们引入 KD 树和坐标模板加速方法以扩展到大型模型，并通过异常值识别来控制误差。在 ResNet-18 和 Qwen2.5-1.5B/Qwen1.5-7B 上的实验验证，基于 DS 的压缩无需事后再训练即可达到有竞争力的压缩率，同时具有可控的解压缩误差和灵活的状态空间设计，表明这是一种有理论依据且实用的压缩方法。

    Representation structure is crucial for understanding Vision Transformer (ViT) architectures and their generalization behavior. However, prior studies neither isolate nor analyze module-level features nor investigate how their interactions contribute to performance estimation. In this work, we conduct the first rigorous analysis of feature information across diverse architectural scales, empirically uncover the relationship between ViT representation and generalization behavior, and leverage these insights to guide efficient ViT design. Our contributions are fivefold: Across diverse architectural scales, 1) We identify feature collapse at initialization, which leads to redundancy, and propose a reduction scheme to mitigate this issue. 2) We quantify feature information using entropy and the minimum eigenvalue, demonstrating that these metrics serve as reliable indicators for generalization prediction. 3) We show that feature in the token space provides a more faithful representation than those in embedding space. 4) We discover an unexpected finding: features produced by linear submodules within ViT layers are critical for the prediction of generalization performance. 5) Our proposed proxy improves the correlation ranking by 18-48% over prior baselines and can effectively identify ViT architectures that achieve higher accuracy at lower or comparable computational cost.

    Affective computing has progressed from categorical emotion recognition to open-ended affective analysis with large multimodal models. Yet affective science describes emotion as an unfolding process shaped by appraisal, regulation, and social interpretation, which remains underexplored computationally. We propose TRACE, a cognition-oriented framework that formalizes an affective episode through three interrelated stages: Condition, Affect, and Effect, integrating observable cues with cognitive factors such as internal stance and regulation of emotional display. Based on this formulation, TRACE-Bench evaluates multimodal models in real-world social scenes through five tasks spanning grounded affect recognition, regulation decoding, cause reasoning, effect reasoning, and full-chain reconstruction, with 3,746 structured question-answer pairs over 646 videos. A matched human-model comparison reveals a substantial performance gap, while affect-specialized models also generally lag behind general-purpose MLLMs. Model outputs show recurring failures, including treating displayed behavior as genuine feeling and fabricating unsupported events during long-chain generation. We further propose TRACER, a cognition-grounded structured reasoning method that couples each inference with explicit premises from factual observations, cognitive appraisals, and established upstream conclusions, forming a traceable graph of intermediate and target conclusions. TRACER outperforms all evaluated model baselines on each of the five tasks. Project page: https://cogaffc.github.io/TRACE

    Rehearse Everything, Remember Nothing: Attic-KV Rehearses What Will Be Read

    演练一切，记住无物：Attic-KV 演练将要读取的内容

    Zhiyun Shi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is Attic-KV, a training-free rehearsal strategy that improves KV-cache compression by using self-generated question-answer prompts and adaptive anchors; it also diagnoses why full-context rereading wastes a tight cache budget. This substantially advances memory compression and retrieval in model systems, while the abstract gives no substantive contribution to interpretability, compositional generalization, or reasoning capabilities.

    本文的主要贡献是 Attic-KV，一种免训练的演练策略；它通过使用自生成的问答提示和自适应锚点来改进 KV-cache 压缩，同时也诊断了为何完整上下文重读会浪费紧张的缓存预算。这显著推进了模型系统中的内存压缩和检索，而摘要未表明其对可解释性、组合泛化或推理能力有实质贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Many key-value (KV) caches are compressed before anyone knows what will be asked of them: a document cached for retrieval, a prompt prefix shared across requests, the memory of a long conversation. The prevailing approach scores KV entries by rehearsal: the model rereads the context and keeps the entries it attends to, assuming that the more completely a cache rehearses its context, the better it remembers it. We show that under tight budgets this assumption backfires: rehearse everything, remember nothing. At a 3% keep ratio, rereading the whole context keeps 31.5 of 96.5 points on RULER, and on LongBench's natural-text tasks it falls below methods that rehearse nothing at all. The cause is that a cache keeps what it rehearses: rereading spreads the budget across the whole context, so the answer's own entries survive at little more than chance. Like a student before an exam, a cache remembers more by testing itself than by rereading. Two principles follow: rehearse what will be read, and rehearse as much as there is. We instantiate them as Attic-KV (Attic for short), a training-free rehearsal in which the model quizzes itself with question-answer pairs that quote the context, alongside anchor tokens in a content-adaptive amount. Changing only the rehearsal lifts three hosts that score it in three different ways: Attic alone is the best training-free method in all eight settings we test on RULER and LongBench's natural-text tasks, and plugged into the gradient-based KVgrad and the trained RestoreKV+, it raises them by up to 17.1 and 28.1 points. Its advantage grows as the budget shrinks, reaching 41.9 points over full rereading at a 3% keep ratio, and on long documents it compresses faster than rereading them.

    中文

    许多键值（KV）缓存会在尚无人知道将要询问什么时就被压缩：例如为检索缓存的文档、供多个请求共享的提示词前缀，或长对话的记忆。主流方法通过演练来评估 KV 条目：模型重读上下文并保留它所关注的条目，假定缓存对上下文演练得越全面，记住的内容就越多。我们表明，在预算紧张时，这种假设适得其反：演练一切，记住无物。当保留率为 3% 时，重读整个上下文在 RULER 上只能保住 96.5 分中的 31.5 分；在 LongBench 的自然文本任务上，其表现还低于完全不演练的方法。原因在于缓存会保留它所演练的内容：重读会将预算分散到整个上下文中，因此答案本身对应的条目存活的概率仅略高于随机水平。就像考前的学生一样，缓存通过自我测验比反复阅读记住更多。由此得到两个原则：演练将要读取的内容，并尽可能充分地演练。我们将这两个原则落实为 Attic-KV（简称 Attic），这是一种免训练的演练方法：模型用引用上下文的问答对来测验自己，同时根据内容自适应地使用一定数量的锚点 token。只改变演练方式，就能提升三个以不同方式对其评分的宿主方法：在 RULER 和 LongBench 自然文本任务的全部八种测试设置中，Attic 单独使用时都是最佳免训练方法；将它接入基于梯度的方法 KVgrad 和经过训练的 RestoreKV+ 后，可使二者分别最多提升 17.1 和 28.1 分。预算越小，Attic 的优势越大；在 3% 保留率下，它比完整重读高 41.9 分，而且处理长文档时比重读压缩得更快。

    Algebraic Integer Quantization for Machine Learning Applications

    面向机器学习应用的代数整数数量化

    Anthony Kostal-Vazquez, Vassil Dimitrov, Branden Butler

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops algebraic-integer formats and quantization for accurate compressed computation, including an LLM inference evaluation. Its number-format and hardware-computation contributions substantially concern efficient model systems, while competitive benchmark accuracy alone does not establish advances in interpretability, composition, or reasoning.

    本文开发了代数整数格式与量化方法，以实现精确的压缩计算，并对其进行了 LLM 推理评估。其数制和硬件计算方面的贡献主要涉及高效模型系统；仅凭基准准确率具有竞争力，不能证明其在可解释性、组合能力或推理方面取得进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In this article, we propose algebraic integer number formats (AINF) as a framework for highly configurable and accurate compressed computation. A key property of AINF is its straightforward reduction to purely integer arithmetic, enabling error-free multiply-accumulate operations. We develop a matrix multiplication engine that exploits this property, obtaining performance within a predictable factor of the most efficient numerical counterparts on modern hardware accelerators. Another key advantage of AIQ is the freedom to select algebraic integers tailored to the numerical characteristics of a given use case, offering optimization opportunities that are fundamentally unavailable in floating-point or fixed-point formats. Motivated by these properties, we introduce algebraic integer quantization (AIQ), a lossy compression format for large language model (LLM) inference, and provide results demonstrating that AIQ achieves competitive accuracy compared to the industry-standard MX format across a diverse set of models and benchmarks at equivalent bit-per-parameter budgets. The experiments presented in this article employ algebraic integers of degree two (quadratic integers); generalizations to higher-order and, in particular, multidimensional algebraic integers promise even greater computational advantages and remain a promising direction for future work.

    中文

    本文提出代数整数数制（AINF），将其作为一种高度可配置且精确的压缩计算框架。AINF 的一个关键性质是能够直接化简为纯整数算术，从而实现无误差的乘加运算。我们开发了一种利用这一性质的矩阵乘法引擎，使其在现代硬件加速器上的性能与最高效的数值计算方案相比保持在可预测的差距范围内。AIQ 的另一项关键优势是可以根据特定应用场景的数值特征选择相应的代数整数，从而提供浮点或定点数制根本无法实现的优化机会。基于这些性质，我们提出代数整数数量化（AIQ），这是一种用于大语言模型（LLM）推理的有损压缩格式，并提供实验结果，表明在相同的每参数比特预算下，AIQ 在多种模型和基准上的准确率与业界标准 MX 格式相比具有竞争力。本文所述实验采用二次代数整数（即二次整数）；推广到更高阶，特别是多维代数整数，有望带来更大的计算优势，是未来值得探索的方向。

    An Input-Dependent Readout Phase for Resonant Sequence Models

    用于谐振序列模型的输入依赖型读出相位

    Shivesh Rane

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper makes sequence-model memory reads input-dependent while retaining exact convolution, and analyzes the long-context failure mechanism with empirical gains in length generalization. This is a substantial architectural contribution to model computation and memory; its analysis does not investigate internal representations or reasoning.

    该论文使序列模型的记忆读取具备输入依赖性，同时保留精确卷积，并通过实证表明其改善了长度泛化，同时分析了长上下文失效机制。这是对模型计算与记忆架构的重要贡献；其分析并未研究内部表征或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sequence models with a fixed-size state avoid the quadratic cost of attention, but face a design choice. An input-dependent state transition gives content-dependent memory at the cost of FFT-based training, while a fixed transition keeps the O(T log T) convolutional path but reads memory the same way for every input. ResonatorLM, a recent model of the second kind, reads a bank of damped complex oscillators through a fixed learned phase per head. We make that readout phase a function of the current token, which adds input dependence to the read only, keeps the convolution exact, and costs 0.2 percent more parameters. An analysis of the untrained bank shows that phase does encode elapsed time, but an ordinary token falls below the background within 2-8 steps and no choice of damping extends linear reconstruction beyond about 16 tokens. In 6M-parameter character-level models on WikiText-2, the input-dependent phase matches the original at the training length and removes its failure beyond it: trained on 256 tokens and tested on 1024, perplexity falls from 12.81 to 3.76. We trace the failure to long-memory heads that accumulate more history than training exposed them to. The learned phase tracks the current character rather than distance and does not improve retrieval.

    中文

    具有固定大小状态的序列模型避免了注意力机制的二次复杂度，但也面临设计取舍。输入依赖的状态转移能够实现内容依赖的记忆，但代价是基于 FFT 的训练；固定转移则保留了 O(T log T) 的卷积路径，却对每个输入都以相同方式读取记忆。近期提出的同类模型 ResonatorLM 通过每个注意力头固定学习到的相位读取一组阻尼复振荡器。我们将该读出相位设为当前词元的函数，使读出本身具备输入依赖性，同时保持卷积精确，参数量仅增加 0.2%。对未训练振荡器组的分析表明，相位确实编码了经过的时间，但普通词元在 2–8 步内便会降至背景信号以下，而且无论如何选择阻尼，都无法将线性重建能力延伸到约 16 个词元以上。在 WikiText-2 上训练的 600 万参数字符级模型中，输入依赖相位在训练长度上达到与原模型相当的效果，并消除了原模型在更长长度上的失效：用 256 个词元训练、用 1024 个词元测试时，困惑度从 12.81 降至 3.76。我们将这一失效归因于长记忆注意力头累积的历史信息超出了训练时接触的范围。学习到的相位追踪的是当前字符，而非距离，并未改善检索。

    CORAL-KV: Compact Cross-Layer Prediction and Residual Coding for Autoregressive Video KV Caches

    CORAL-KV：用于自回归视频 KV 缓存的紧凑跨层预测与残差编码

    Albert Ge, Akash Haridas, Utkarsh Saxena, Ruijing Yang, Ian Colbert, Frederic Sala, Vikram Appia, Emad Barsoum

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CORAL-KV introduces cross-layer predictors and residual coding to reduce video diffusion KV-cache memory while preserving generation fidelity, a substantial contribution to model memory systems. Its analysis of dependencies across cache layers offers limited representation insight, but the abstract does not establish a mechanistic account of how model information is represented or used.

    CORAL-KV 引入跨层预测器和残差编码，在保持视频扩散生成保真度的同时减少 KV 缓存内存，是对模型内存系统的重要贡献。其对缓存层间依赖关系的分析提供了有限的表征见解，但摘要并未建立模型信息如何表征或使用的机制解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autoregressive video diffusion models maintain a growing attention key-value (KV) cache, making memory a key bottleneck for long video generation. Recently, clustering-based quantization has emerged as an effective method to compress video KV caches by grouping similar key and value vectors then quantizing residual errors. However, when later frames attend to the compressed history, small reconstruction errors can compound as the video grows. Beyond the within-layer similarity exploited by clustering, we find strong dependencies across cache layers in video models. This motivates Coral-KV - Calibrated Offline, Residual-coded, and Adapted Locally - a KV-cache compression framework that uses cache states in each layer to predict keys and values in subsequent layers, then quantizes the remaining prediction residuals. We construct compact block-diagonal-plus-low-rank (block-DPLR) predictors: block-diagonal components model channel relationships within each attention head, while a global low-rank term models dependencies between heads. Coral-KV exposes a flexible fidelity-memory trade-off: it can reuse its predictors across videos or refit lightweight block-diagonal predictors to the current video for higher fidelity. Across extensive evaluations on both HY-WorldPlay and MAGI-1, our reusable configuration improves PSNR over QVG-4 by 0.32 dB and 4.95 dB, respectively, while using 48% and 37% less cache memory. Against QVG-Pro, our video-adapted configuration improves MAGI-1 PSNR by 3.77 dB while using 33.7% less cache memory. Coral-KV also maintains higher reconstruction fidelity over extended generation and reduces temporal discontinuities while retaining comparable generation latency.

    中文

    自回归视频扩散模型会维护不断增长的注意力键值（KV）缓存，使内存成为长视频生成的关键瓶颈。近期，基于聚类的量化已成为压缩视频 KV 缓存的有效方法：它将相似的键向量和值向量分组，然后量化残差误差。然而，后续帧关注压缩后的历史信息时，微小的重建误差会随着视频增长而累积。除了聚类所利用的层内相似性，我们还发现视频模型的缓存层之间存在很强的依赖关系。受此启发，我们提出 Coral-KV（Calibrated Offline, Residual-coded, and Adapted Locally），一种 KV 缓存压缩框架：它利用各层的缓存状态预测后续层中的键和值，再对剩余的预测残差进行量化。我们构建了紧凑的块对角加低秩（block-DPLR）预测器：块对角分量用于建模每个注意力头内部的通道关系，全局低秩项则用于建模注意力头之间的依赖关系。Coral-KV 提供灵活的保真度—内存权衡：既可以在不同视频间复用预测器，也可以为当前视频重新拟合轻量级块对角预测器，以提高保真度。在 HY-WorldPlay 和 MAGI-1 上的大量评估中，可复用配置相较于 QVG-4 的 PSNR 分别提高 0.32 dB 和 4.95 dB，同时缓存内存分别减少 48% 和 37%。与 QVG-Pro 相比，适配视频的配置使 MAGI-1 的 PSNR 提高 3.77 dB，同时缓存内存减少 33.7%。此外，Coral-KV 在延长生成过程中仍保持较高的重建保真度，并减少时间不连续，同时保持相近的生成延迟。

    MolP2SBench: Do LLMs Really Reason from Molecular Properties to Structure?

    MolP2SBench：LLM 真的能从分子性质推理出结构吗？

    Yuhang Xie, Zhiyi Shi, Zeyi Zhang, Zhisheng Qi, Yushun Dong, Yu Wang, Xiongye Xiao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MolP2SBench tests whether LLMs use molecular properties, including through shuffled and counterfactual inputs, to reason about structure. This is a substantial reasoning evaluation contribution, but the abstract does not analyze internal mechanisms or compositional generalization; the molecular application alone does not support higher scores there.

    MolP2SBench 通过打乱和反事实输入等方式，检验 LLM 是否会利用分子性质推理结构。这是对推理评估的重要贡献，但摘要没有分析内部机制或组合泛化；仅有分子应用不足以支持在这些方面给出更高评价。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in molecular discovery and structure elucidation, where decisions depend on physical observations. Existing evaluations primarily focus on end-to-end molecular reconstruction, where correct predictions do not necessarily indicate reliance on the supplied properties. We introduce MolP2SBench, a benchmark for molecular property-to-structure (P2S) reasoning in LLMs. Each task presents a masked molecular scaffold with given properties and asks the model to select the missing structure from plausible candidates. We shuffle or replace properties to test reliance on correct property-structure pairing and responsiveness to counterfactual property changes. A channel-wise leaderboard uses Property-Grounded Recovery (PGR), giving equal weight to source and counterfactual recovery. Evaluating seven models, we find that LLMs can use physical properties for structure prediction, but performance varies substantially across property types. Higher accuracy with a property does not necessarily imply greater responsiveness to it: a model may benefit more from $^1$H NMR than from $^{13}$C NMR, yet be less likely to change its prediction when the $^1$H data is replaced. LLM performance also need not reflect the relative difficulty of these properties for human chemists. Although UV-Vis spectra provide less direct structural information than NMR spectra, Astra achieves higher accuracy with UV-Vis data than with NMR peaks. MolP2SBench supports studying how LLMs extract and use physical-property information, revealing patterns that may differ from conventional chemical intuition and providing a foundation for more reliably property-grounded models for molecular and quantum-chemical inference. Code and dataset: https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/MolP2SBench.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于分子发现和结构解析，而这些任务中的判断取决于物理观测。现有评估主要关注端到端的分子重建，但预测正确并不一定表明模型依赖了给定性质。我们提出 MolP2SBench，这是一个用于评估 LLM 分子性质到结构（P2S）推理的基准。每项任务都会给出一个带有掩码的分子骨架及其性质，并要求模型从合理候选项中选出缺失结构。我们会打乱或替换性质，以测试模型是否依赖正确的性质—结构对应关系，以及能否响应反事实性质变化。按谱图类型划分的排行榜使用性质依据恢复率（PGR），对原始条件与反事实条件下的恢复给予同等权重。我们评估了七个模型，发现 LLM 能够利用物理性质预测结构，但表现会随性质类型而显著不同。对于某种性质预测准确率更高，并不一定意味着模型对该性质的响应更强：模型可能从$^1$H NMR 中获得的收益大于从$^{13}$C NMR 中获得的收益，却更不容易在替换$^1$H 数据后改变预测结果。LLM 的表现也未必反映这些性质对人类化学家的相对难度。尽管 UV-Vis 光谱提供的直接结构信息少于 NMR 光谱，Astra 使用 UV-Vis 数据时的准确率却高于使用 NMR 峰时的准确率。MolP2SBench 支持研究 LLM 如何提取和使用物理性质信息，揭示可能不同于传统化学直觉的模式，并为构建能更可靠地以性质为依据进行分子和量子化学推断的模型奠定基础。代码和数据集：https://github.com/DUAL-Xiao/MolP2SBench。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper trains representations with separated trait, state, and sensor bands, then tests whether projecting out the sensor band improves cross-cohort transfer; this is a substantial contribution to representation geometry and disentanglement. Cohort transfer involves distribution shift, but the abstract does not study compositional generalization, reasoning, or model and agent systems.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) foundation models encode each day as one vector that mixes who the person is, what happened that day and how the sensor measured it, so measurement differences travel with the representation into new cohorts. We ask whether pretraining can place the measurement component that harms transfer in known coordinates, so that deployment drops them with a fixed projection and no target data. GlucoPRISM supervises a GlucoFM backbone with response contracts, rules for how each part of the representation should change when only the day or only the sensor changes: a 64-dimensional Trait band should change with neither, a 48-dimensional State band only across days, and a 16-dimensional Sensor band should track the device. Synthetic sensor views calibrated on paired Dexcom and Libre recordings, different-day pairs and glucose-summary targets supply this supervision without clinical labels. Across twelve cross-cohort directions, dropping the Sensor band from the same frozen encoder raises mean transfer AUROC from 68.75 to 73.57, against 69.3 for GlucoFM. The gain has two parts. Into CGMacros, the one target cohort recorded with two sensor types, filtering adds 11 to 19 points, and this holds when the generator is recalibrated on half of the participants and scored on the other half. On the other eight directions filtering is neutral and the encoder itself exceeds GlucoFM by 3.5 points. The device remains linearly decodable after filtering, so the filter removes a device-related component that harms transfer rather than all measurement information. The retained bands improve window AUROC on thirteen of fourteen public task--cohort cells (Holm-adjusted p=0.031) and correlation on fourteen of fifteen clinical endpoints in an external cohort of 9,303 participants.

    连续血糖监测（CGM）基础模型将每天编码为一个向量，其中混合了个体身份、当天发生的情况以及传感器的测量方式，因此测量差异会随表征一起迁移到新队列。我们探讨能否通过预训练，将有害于迁移的测量成分置于已知坐标中，从而在部署时通过固定投影将其去除，而无需目标数据。GlucoPRISM 使用响应契约监督 GlucoFM 骨干网络；这些契约规定，当只有日期或只有传感器发生变化时，表征的各个部分应如何变化：64 维的 Trait 子空间两者变化时都不应改变，48 维的 State 子空间只应随日期变化，16 维的 Sensor 子空间则应追踪设备。经配对 Dexcom 和 Libre 记录校准的合成传感器视图、不同日期的配对数据以及血糖摘要目标，在没有临床标签的情况下提供了这种监督。在十二个跨队列迁移方向上，从同一个冻结编码器中去除 Sensor 子空间后，平均迁移 AUROC 从 68.75 提高到 73.57；相比之下，GlucoFM 的数值为 69.3。这一提升有两个来源。在唯一采用两种传感器类型记录的目标队列 CGMacros 中，筛选带来了 11 至 19 个百分点的提升；即使在一半参与者上重新校准生成器，并在另一半参与者上评分，这一结果依然成立。在其余八个方向上，筛选没有影响，而编码器本身比 GlucoFM 高 3.5 个百分点。筛选后仍可通过线性方式解码设备信息，因此该筛选去除的是有害于迁移的设备相关成分，而非全部测量信息。保留的子空间在十四个公开任务—队列单元中的十三个单元上提升了窗口 AUROC（经 Holm 校正的 p=0.031），并在外部队列的 15 项临床终点中有 14 项提升了相关性；该队列包含 9,303 名参与者。

    Qinhan Lyu, Jusheng Zhang, Zhixing Zhang, Hao Liu, Zijie Liang, Jin Jiang, Keze Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CacheScope uses normalized online probes to allocate exact denoising computation, making adaptive computation the main algorithmic contribution. Its feature-reuse setting has an incidental connection to internal representations, but the abstract focuses on inference allocation rather than interpreting model mechanisms; it does not address composition or reasoning.

    CacheScope 使用归一化的在线探针分配精确去噪计算，其主要算法贡献在于自适应计算。其特征复用场景与内部表征略有联系，但摘要关注的是推理计算分配，而非解释模型机制；也没有涉及组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Training-free feature reuse accelerates diffusion transformer inference by replacing full denoising computation at selected steps with cached approximations. Existing methods mainly improve the reconstruction of skipped features, but we find that once a stable first-order reconstructor is used, increasing reconstruction complexity brings limited gains, whereas the placement of exact-computation steps has a much larger effect on fidelity. More importantly, absolute shallow-probe variation is jointly affected by input-trajectory displacement and network response strength, and therefore does not directly reflect cache risk. We address this confounding by normalizing probe-output variation with the corresponding input displacement, yielding a directional gain per unit trajectory movement. Based on this signal, we propose CacheScope, which identifies high-risk reuse steps online and selectively falls back to full denoising computation while leaving the underlying cache reconstructor unchanged. CacheScope requires no additional training, gradients, auxiliary networks, or prompt-specific offline schedule optimization. Across FLUX.1-dev, Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, and Open-Sora 1.2, CacheScope achieves up to 3.57x acceleration and reduces median LPIPS by up to 70.1% over the strongest probe-based baseline.

    中文

    免训练的特征复用通过在选定步骤以缓存近似替代完整去噪计算，加速扩散 Transformer 推理。现有方法主要改进被跳过特征的重建，但我们发现，一旦采用稳定的一阶重建器，增加重建复杂度带来的收益就很有限；相比之下，精确计算步骤的安排对保真度影响更大。更重要的是，浅层探针的绝对变化同时受到输入轨迹位移和网络响应强度的影响，因此无法直接反映缓存风险。我们通过将探针输出变化除以相应的输入位移来消除这一混杂因素，从而得到每单位轨迹移动所对应的方向性增益。基于这一信号，我们提出 CacheScope：它在线识别高风险的复用步骤，并选择性地回退到完整去噪计算，同时保持底层缓存重建器不变。CacheScope 无需额外训练、梯度、辅助网络或针对特定提示词的离线调度优化。在 FLUX.1-dev、Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 和 Open-Sora 1.2 上，CacheScope 最多可实现 3.57 倍加速，并使中位 LPIPS 相较于最强的基于探针的基线最多降低 70.1%。

    AutoIndexer: Flexible-Order Decoding by Training Causal Models on Chains of Edits

    AutoIndexer：通过在编辑链上训练因果模型实现灵活顺序解码

    Shu Ishida, Aliasghar Khani, Tianyu Zhang, The Cong Luong, James Seale Smith, Adam Gaier

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AutoIndexer introduces edit-based training and decoding so causal models can insert, replace, or delete tokens in prior outputs, with evidence of robust post-generation editing. This advances flexible computation and revision in model systems; connections to composition and reasoning are present but secondary, and the abstract does not investigate internal mechanisms.

    AutoIndexer 引入基于编辑的训练和解码，使因果模型能够在先前输出中插入、替换或删除词元，并展示了稳健的生成后编辑能力。这推动了模型系统中的灵活计算与修订能力；它与组合和推理有一定联系，但属于次要方面，摘要也未研究内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autoregressive decoding is less suited to non-causally ordered data, e.g., cross-references or future dependencies, since their outputs cannot be revised post hoc, unlike iterative human reasoning. Diffusion LLMs partially mitigate this limitation but still cannot flexibly insert or remove arbitrary numbers of tokens from a pre-generated context. We design AutoIndexer as a generative model with a novel training and decoding mechanism that simulates a Chain of Edits, allowing the model to flexibly modify its prior outputs in hindsight via token insertions, substitutions, and deletions. The model learns to predict marker tokens for opening and closing edits, simultaneously moving a cursor to positions in the existing token sequence, analogous to a text editor. Training sequences are obtained by perturbing ground-truth labels with inverse chained edit operations, and the model learns to edit by undoing those inverses. The perturbation training allows AutoIndexer to be robust to erroneous context and adaptable to editing tasks such as code correction. We demonstrate that our method exhibits post-generation context-editing capabilities that most autoregressive and diffusion models lack without compromising performance on standard LLM benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/autoindexer.

    中文

    对于非因果顺序的数据（例如交叉引用或未来依赖），自回归解码不太适用，因为其输出无法事后修改，而人类的迭代推理则可以。扩散 LLM 在一定程度上缓解了这一局限，但仍无法灵活地在预先生成的上下文中插入或删除任意数量的词元。我们设计了 AutoIndexer，这是一种采用新型训练和解码机制的生成模型，用于模拟编辑链，使模型能够通过插入、替换和删除词元来回溯修改先前输出。模型会学习预测用于开启和关闭编辑的标记词元，同时将光标移至现有词元序列中的相应位置，类似文本编辑器。训练序列通过对真实标签施加逆向串联编辑操作来生成，模型则通过撤销这些逆操作来学习编辑。通过这种扰动训练，AutoIndexer 能够应对错误上下文，并适用于代码纠错等编辑任务。我们证明，AutoIndexer 具备多数自回归和扩散模型所缺乏的生成后上下文编辑能力，同时不损害其在标准 LLM 基准上的表现。代码见：https://github.com/AutodeskAILab/autoindexer。
