    Fly-by-Code: Embodied Coding Agents for Aerial Manipulation with Active Visual and Physical Feedback

    Fly-by-Code：借助主动视觉与物理反馈进行空中操作的具身编码智能体

    Jaewoo Lee, Jeongyeon Seo, Sihyun Cho, Gyeongrak Choe, Yutong Wang, Bavin Saravanan, Jia-Bin Huang, Furong Huang, Sebastian Scherer, Guanya Shi, H. Jin Kim, Seungjae Lee, Dongjae Lee

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Active Feedback adds diagnostic programs that use simulation views and targeted physical probes to resolve uncertainty and improve embodied coding-agent task execution. This is a substantial agent feedback and execution method; reasoning is involved in diagnosis, but the contribution is an application-specific system rather than a general reasoning mechanism, and it does not study model internals or compositional generalization.

    主动反馈加入了诊断程序，通过仿真视角和有针对性的物理探测来消除不确定性，并改善具身编码智能体的任务执行。这是对智能体反馈与执行方法的重要贡献；诊断过程涉及推理，但该贡献是面向特定应用的系统，而非通用推理机制，也未研究模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Embodied coding agents construct robot policies from natural-language instructions by generating executable programs and refining them from execution feedback. This refinement assumes that execution feedback reveals whether the task succeeded and, after a failure, provides sufficient evidence to guide program revision. Aerial manipulation violates this assumption in two ways. Payload constraints restrict onboard camera coverage and leave task-critical outcomes outside the robot's view (partial observability), while strong dynamic coupling and limited control margins make physical interactions fragile (limited interaction robustness) and leave failure causes unresolved. Re-examining the same feedback cannot recover observations that were never collected or separate failure causes that the available evidence does not distinguish. To acquire this missing evidence, we introduce Active Feedback (AF), an active "View and Probe" framework. When execution feedback leaves unresolved questions, the agent synthesizes a separate diagnostic program that runs in simulation to inspect unseen outcomes from informative viewpoints (View) or test hypotheses about failure causes through targeted physical interactions (Probe). Across six simulated aerial manipulation tasks with 60 trials per condition, AF reduces false completion declarations from 25 to 5 and raises final task success from 31.7% to 75% compared with terminal feedback under the same coding-agent configuration and task-execution limit. Using shared robot APIs, task programs refined with AF in simulation run on a physical aerial manipulator without task-program source-code modification and complete multi-stage manipulation tasks in the real world. These results show that executable diagnosis fills gaps in execution feedback for embodied coding agents, improving both completion assessment and program refinement in aerial manipulation.

    中文

    具身编码智能体通过生成可执行程序，并根据执行反馈进行改进，从自然语言指令构建机器人策略。这种改进方式假设执行反馈能够揭示任务是否成功，并且失败后能提供足够证据来指导程序修订。空中操作会以两种方式违背这一假设。载荷限制会约束机载摄像头的覆盖范围，使任务关键结果落在机器人视野之外（部分可观测性）；强动态耦合和有限的控制裕度则使物理交互十分脆弱（交互鲁棒性有限），并导致失败原因无法确定。反复检查相同反馈，无法获得从未采集的观测，也无法区分现有证据无法辨明的失败原因。为获取缺失证据，我们提出主动反馈（AF），一种主动式“观察与探测”框架。当执行反馈留下未解决的问题时，智能体会合成一个独立的诊断程序，并在仿真中运行：它可以从有信息量的视角检查不可见结果（观察），或通过有针对性的物理交互检验失败原因假设（探测）。在六项模拟空中操作任务中，每种条件进行了 60 次试验；与使用相同编码智能体配置和任务执行限制的终止反馈相比，AF 将错误的完成声明从 25 次降至 5 次，并将最终任务成功率从 31.7% 提高到 75%。借助共享机器人 API，在仿真中经 AF 改进的任务程序无需修改任务程序源代码，就能在实体空中操作机器人上运行，并在现实世界中完成多阶段操作任务。这些结果表明，可执行诊断能够弥补具身编码智能体执行反馈中的信息缺口，改善空中操作中的完成状态评估和程序改进。

    Michael C. Abbott and Benjamin B. Machta

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops transistor circuits and a physical-learning transformer that can learn a simple in-context task, with circuit design and local optimizer memory as the main contributions. In-context learning is an incidental capability demonstration; the abstract gives no substantive insight into model representations, compositional generalization, or reasoning mechanisms.

    该论文开发了晶体管电路和能够学习简单上下文任务的物理学习 Transformer，主要贡献是电路设计和局部优化器记忆。上下文学习只是附带展示的能力；摘要未提供关于模型表征、组合泛化或推理机制的实质性见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Most systems trained by equilibrium propagation or coupled learning are in the same class as multi-layer perceptrons: while they may be universal function approximators, they struggle to learn associative tasks which are easy for transformers. Equilibrium propagation relies on a bidirectional flow of information through the physical system between input and output. The reverse flow is broken by more complex nonlinear systems, such as those performing multiplication which is needed to express dot-product attention. Here we explicitly restore this bidirectional flow by introducing extra circuit elements for this purpose into a double or dyadic circuit. We then use these ideas to construct an attention mechanism exploiting the exponential current law of sub-threshold MOSFET devices. We show that in simulations this circuit can be trained to perform a simple in-context learning task, despite using realistic reverse components which transmit only an approximate gradient. For this training to succeed we need cross-entropy loss (not mean squared error). We generate nudges appropriate for this loss using a novel floating circuit element, based on the same MOSFET sub-circuit used for softmax. We train the resistors in this circuit using the Lion optimiser, which can be implemented using one capacitor per parameter to store local memory of past gradient estimates.

    中文

    大多数通过平衡传播或耦合学习训练的系统都属于与多层感知机相同的类别：它们虽然可能是通用函数逼近器，却难以学习 Transformer 擅长的关联任务。平衡传播依赖信息在物理系统中于输入和输出之间双向流动。在更复杂的非线性系统中，例如执行点积注意力所需的乘法系统，这种反向信息流会中断。本文通过在双重或二元电路中加入专用电路元件，明确恢复了这种双向信息流。随后，我们利用亚阈值 MOSFET 器件的指数电流定律构建注意力机制。我们通过仿真表明，尽管使用的实际反向分量只能传递近似梯度，该电路仍可训练来执行简单的上下文学习任务。要使训练成功，必须使用交叉熵损失（而非均方误差）。我们基于用于 softmax 的同一 MOSFET 子电路，设计了一种新型浮动电路元件，用它生成适用于该损失的微扰信号。我们使用 Lion 优化器训练该电路中的电阻器；该优化器可以通过每个参数配置一个电容器来实现，以保存过去梯度估计的局部记忆。

    One Model to Loop Them All: Elastic Latent Recurrence for Language Models

    一个模型，循环万次：面向语言模型的弹性潜在递归

    Faisal Ladhak, Shantanu Acharya, Santiago Akle Serano, Simeng Sun, Boris Ginsburg, Krishna C Puvvada

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ELR trains shared-layer recurrent language models to trade inference compute for accuracy, with loop-conditioned training and KV-cache and expert-routing optimizations. This substantially advances adaptive computation in model systems; accuracy gains alone provide only a partial connection to reasoning, with no explicit reasoning mechanism or compositional generalization contribution.

    ELR 通过循环条件化训练以及 KV 缓存和专家路由优化，训练共享层的递归语言模型，使其能在推理计算量与准确率之间进行权衡。这显著推进了模型系统中的自适应计算；单凭准确率提升只能说明它与推理能力有部分关联，而该方法没有明确的推理机制或组合泛化贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A latent recurrent language model applies a shared block of layers repeatedly, so one checkpoint can trade inference compute for accuracy by changing the loop count. At one loop, however, such models typically fall well short of a non-recurrent model of the same size, a one-loop tax that makes a separate non-recurrent model the better choice whenever latency matters. We present Elastic Latent Recurrence (ELR), a recipe for training looped language models without this tax. At one loop, an ELR model costs the same to serve as a non-recurrent model of the same size and, trained on the same data, reaches similar accuracy. Each additional loop then buys more accuracy for more inference compute. Three choices make this work: a gated state update with a learned step size, loop counts mixed within each optimizer update, and conditioning each pass on its loop index and budget. The first two preserve one-loop accuracy, and the third lowers loss at every additional loop. Mixed depths can be introduced late in pretraining to limit the added training cost, and with zero-initialized conditioning added at the switch, this late schedule reaches lower loss than mixed-depth training from scratch. In MoE models, reusing first-loop expert routes on later loops cuts mixed-depth update time by 11.7% with no measurable change in accuracy. At inference, keeping only the last loop's attention KV cache holds attention KV memory at its one-loop level while retaining most of the gain from additional loops. On 4B dense and 30B-A3B MoE hybrid models, ELR at one loop is 0.52 points below and 1.04 points above its matched baseline on a ten-task average, and four loops add 7.25 and 4.75 points. Carried through post-training, the recipe yields Koi-4B, a single checkpoint that scores an estimated 18 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at one loop, matching Qwen3.5-4B, and 29 at four loops.

    中文

    潜在递归语言模型会反复应用一个共享层块，因此只需改变循环次数，同一个检查点就能在推理计算量与准确率之间进行权衡。然而，只循环一次时，这类模型的表现通常远逊于同等规模的非递归模型；这种“单循环税”使得只要延迟重要，单独使用非递归模型就成了更好的选择。我们提出弹性潜在递归（ELR），这是一种训练循环语言模型而不产生这种代价的方法。循环一次时，ELR 模型的服务成本与同等规模的非递归模型相同，并且在使用相同数据训练时能达到相近的准确率。此后，每增加一次循环，都可以用更多推理计算换取更高准确率。这一方法依靠三个设计：采用可学习步长的门控状态更新；在每次优化器更新中混合不同循环次数；以及根据循环索引和预算对每一轮进行条件化。前两项设计保留单循环准确率，第三项则使每增加一次循环都能降低损失。可以在预训练后期引入混合深度，以限制额外训练成本；在切换时加入零初始化的条件化后，这种后期安排比从头开始进行混合深度训练达到更低的损失。在 MoE 模型中，后续循环复用第一轮的专家路由，使混合深度更新耗时减少 11.7%，且准确率没有可测量的变化。推理时只保留最后一轮的注意力 KV 缓存，可将注意力 KV 内存维持在单循环水平，同时保留增加循环带来的大部分收益。在 4B 稠密模型和 30B-A3B MoE 混合模型上，ELR 单循环时的十项任务平均分分别比匹配基线低 0.52 分和高 1.04 分；循环四次则分别增加 7.25 分和 4.75 分。将这一方法延续到后训练阶段后，得到 Koi-4B：单个检查点在循环一次时，Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 估计得分为 18，与 Qwen3.5-4B 持平；循环四次时得分为 29。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. Experiments on $\tau^2$-Bench and CAR-Bench show that EvoSyn improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest synthesis baseline, while producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience and discovering controllable factors missed without learner feedback.

    Agentic large language models now tackle complex tasks, yet strategic reasoning over long horizons is under-studied: most agentic benchmarks are short and episodic, and performance on long tasks is hard to dissect into stored knowledge, reasoning and luck. We introduce SpireBench, in which models play the complete commercial deck-builder Slay the Spire (StS), where early decisions decide long-term success. Across 20 large language models (LLMs) at the game's highest difficulty, frontier models beat heuristic baselines and match the average human player but remain far behind experts. This gap widens as the run lengthens: the strongest models win the first act as often as experts, then fall behind. What separates strong models from weak is how well they play each fight; all of them misjudge risk over a run, preserving health rather than spending it to grow stronger. A comprehensive, self-consistent renaming of every game term shows that part of their performance rests on prior knowledge of the game, and models do not improve from the memories they write across runs, which are often wrong and overly cautious. Our harness is the first to give a model the complete original game, and we compare it with existing harnesses. Overall, SpireBench offers an unsaturated long-horizon benchmark with tools to locate where and why agents fail.

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable supervision for software engineering agents through executable tests, but binary rewards fail to distinguish trajectories with substantially different debugging quality. We investigate whether the current policy can judge its own trajectories and use these judgments to improve task performance without a separately trained reward model. To this end, we introduce Behavioral Self-Rewarding (BSR), a reward-refinement method that reuses the policy to compare observable debugging behavior among trajectories from the same task with the same verifier outcome. BSR aggregates pairwise preferences into task-local scores and converts them into bounded auxiliary rewards, introducing reward contrast while preserving the verifier-defined pass/fail ordering. This provides additional supervision from already-collected trajectories without requiring new environment interactions.     Sparse computation can scale the parametric capacity of LLMs without proportionally increasing active computation, but pretraining sparse architectures remains expensive and data-hungry. Existing sparse upcycling methods mainly target Mixture-of-Experts models, where expert homogeneity, sample inefficiency, and system overheads can limit practical scalability. Static sparse memory offers predictable access and token-specific updates that can help address these challenges, but naively integrating it into pretrained computation yields poor returns. In this work, we introduce STAPLE, a recipe built upon STEM for integrating static sparse memory into pretrained models. Whereas STEM replaces FFN up-projections with token-indexed embeddings, STAPLE retains them and adds the embeddings as a residual pathway, preserving pretrained computation while learning complementary token-specific information in a scalable manner. On OLMo-2 1B, STAPLE improves over continued dense training by 4.27 points on HumanEval, 2.80 on MBPP, 2.27 on GSM8K, and 1.65 on DROP. Average performance increases with static capacity, and improvements persist on the larger OLMo-2 7B backbone. STAPLE also outperforms static sparse baselines such as STEM and an Engram-style model, and achieves a higher average score than an MoE upcycling baseline while decoding 2x faster with less than half its GPU model memory and measured GPU energy per token in our throughput-oriented decoding evaluation. Importantly, despite introducing billions of parameters late in training, our host-offloaded implementation keeps generation throughput within 1.5% and training throughput within 3% of the dense baseline, while caching only the ~5% most frequent embeddings on GPU. These results show that static sparse memory can provide a sample-efficient, scalable, and sustainable path for expanding pretrained models without sparse pretraining from scratch.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SynAct allocates expert feedback to consequential agent decisions using rollout-based mutual information, then distills corrections into reusable rules; it also proves a finite-sample separation result and evaluates inference-time routing. Its main contribution advances agent feedback and routing systems, with partial relevance to reusable composition and problem-solving, but the abstract does not focus on internal representations or reasoning mechanisms.

    SynAct 利用基于 rollout 的互信息，将专家反馈分配给会影响结果的智能体决策，随后将修正提炼为可复用规则；它还证明了一个有限样本下的区分结果，并评估了推理时路由。其主要贡献在于推进智能体反馈和路由系统，与可复用组合及问题求解有部分关联，但摘要并未聚焦于内部表征或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents executing multi-step workflows fail in two fundamentally different ways: recoverable slips, which further attempts can repair, and knowledge gaps, which retrying cannot resolve. Expert feedback can address the latter, but expert attention is scarce. The key challenge is therefore not whether to ask for feedback, but where feedback can change the outcome. Existing approaches either avoid expert feedback, allowing agents to reinforce their own errors, or allocate feedback at the task level without identifying consequential decisions. We present SynAct, an active learning framework that treats expert attention as the binding constraint and allocates feedback at the level of individual decisions. SynAct ranks decisions by the mutual information between the selected action and the terminal outcome across repeated rollouts, queries an expert at the highest-value decisions, and distills the resulting corrections into transferable rules that the agent can reuse without expert access at deployment. We theoretically characterize what this signal identifies under finite repeated sampling: with k rollouts and at least m observations per action, outcome-constant decisions have zero mutual information, while outcome-separating decisions have mutual information at least H2(m/k) bits, yielding exact separation for any threshold t in (0,H2(m/k)). This also explains why success-based acquisition can be blind when all rollouts fail: success is constant even when failed runs reach different outcomes. Across four agent benchmarks and four models spanning three families, SynAct improves held-out accuracy in all 16 evaluated settings, by +11.7pp on average. The same signal transfers to inference-time routing, where SynAct outperforms budget-matched cascade, uncertainty, and expert-judge routers in 15 of 16 settings, while a single targeted correction outperforms seven additional unaimed retries.

    中文

    执行多步工作流的 LLM 智能体会以两种本质不同的方式失败：可恢复的失误可以通过进一步尝试修正，而知识缺口则无法通过重试弥补。专家反馈可以解决后者，但专家的注意力十分有限。因此，关键挑战不在于是否请求反馈，而在于反馈能在哪些地方改变结果。现有方法要么不寻求专家反馈，导致智能体不断强化自身错误；要么在任务层面分配反馈，却无法识别哪些决策会产生重要影响。我们提出 SynAct，这是一种主动学习框架，将专家注意力视为关键约束，并在单个决策层面分配反馈。SynAct 根据多次重复 rollout 中所选动作与最终结果之间的互信息对决策排序，在价值最高的决策点征询专家意见，并将得到的修正提炼为可迁移规则，使智能体在部署时无需专家参与也能复用这些规则。我们从理论上刻画了这一信号在有限次重复采样下能够识别什么：对于 k 次 rollout，且每个动作至少有 m 条观测时，结果恒定的决策具有零互信息，而能区分结果的决策其互信息至少为 H2(m/k) 比特，因此对于区间 (0,H2(m/k)) 内的任意阈值 t，都能实现精确区分。这也解释了为何当所有 rollout 都失败时，基于成功与否的采集可能无法识别有价值的决策：即使失败的运行到达了不同结果，成功与否仍保持不变。在四个智能体基准和涵盖三个模型系列的四个模型上，SynAct 在全部 16 个评估设置中都提高了留出集准确率，平均提升 +11.7 个百分点。同一信号还可用于推理时路由；在 16 个设置中的 15 个设置里，SynAct 优于预算匹配的级联式、不确定性式和专家评判式路由器；此外，一次有针对性的修正胜过额外进行七次无目标重试。

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents can execute increasingly complex tasks, but effective assistance also requires aligning their actions with goals and constraints that users may leave unstated. We study this problem as interactive intent alignment through clarification. Yet clarification is useful only when the agent can turn the answer into better decisions. As training changes how the agent handles incomplete information and uses additional answers, the same clarification can become more or less useful. We introduce CLEAT (CLarification through valuE-guided Agent co-Training), a framework that co-trains a clarification-value controller and the task policy from shared interaction outcomes. We formulate residual query value to measure the task utility gained by asking rather than proceeding under the current policy, and estimate it through paired rollouts from the same interaction history. These paired returns train the controller to predict clarification value and the task policy to select useful questions and act on the answers. The controller guides subsequent rollout collection, while outcomes from the updated agent provide new value labels that allow clarification guidance to adapt as the agent learns. With Qwen3-4B, CLEAT achieves the highest mean score in all ten evaluation settings across four benchmarks. Gains over the strongest baseline reach 13.2 and 6.5 percentage points on UserGym Travel and IN3 underspecification judgment accuracy, respectively. Ablations show that co-training improves the task policy even when the controller is removed at inference, while adapting clarification guidance to the evolving policy yields further gains.

    该论文提出用于 KV 缓存压缩的结构化 Kronecker 因子分解以及与之相匹配的位置编码，并通过实验展示压缩与准确率之间的权衡。其因子分解是一种用于提高模型计算效率的架构设计，对应 Systems 4；仅有结构化因子并不能证明实现了组合泛化，因此 CompGen 仍属附带关联（2）。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Efficient autoregressive generation is increasingly limited by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, which grows linearly with sequence length, batch size, and model depth. Existing approaches such as Multi-Query Attention (MQA), Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), and Tensor Product Attention (TPA) reduce this cost through different trade-offs, but often sacrifice expressivity, require additional positional-encoding machinery, or impose restrictive low-rank structure. We propose Kronecker Product Attention (KPA), which represents key and value activations as sums of Kronecker products of compact, token-dependent matrix factors. KPA strictly generalizes TPA: rank-one vector-outer-product factorization arises as a degenerate Kronecker split, while non-degenerate matrix factors can represent richer block-structured patterns. We further show that a structured rotary embedding operator matched to the Kronecker representation preserves the relative-position property of RoPE while rotating only the compact factors, removing the need for a decoupled RoPE branch as in MLA. Empirically, KPA matches or exceeds TPA, MHA, MQA, GQA, and MLA across four model scales and nine downstream benchmarks under identical training conditions, while achieving up to 10x KV cache compression. The Kronecker head split is a tuneable hyperparameter that allows practitioners to navigate the compression-accuracy trade-off at design time without architectural changes.

Unlike conventional RAG systems, relying on static Knowledge Bases (KBs), our proposal addresses settings where the KB is initially empty and is progressively populated through human decisions. The system stores previous decisions as retrievable precedents and moves from silent observation to evidence-grounded contestation and, finally, to autonomous handling with abstention. Against an independent baseline, iRAG matches final-decision error under 10% drift without retrieval decay and reduces it under 40% drift across all configurations. Retrieval decay improves performance on changed knowledge while increasing error on stable knowledge, evidencing a stability--plasticity trade-off rather than a general advantage.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct scenes from unposed images, but the quadratic cost of global attention limits their scalability to large view sets. We present Zebra3D, a layerwise sparse-linear hybrid attention framework that improves the efficiency of pretrained 3D foundation models without training from scratch. Across VGGT, HunyuanWorld-Mirror, and $\pi^3$, we observe a broadly consistent depth-wise pattern: early stages are relatively tolerant to linear replacement, while sensitive middle-to-late stages tend to exhibit more concentrated attention. Zebra3D exploits this structure by assigning linear-centered attention to tolerant stages and tile-sparse attention to sensitive stages, using landmark summaries to preserve unselected context. Closed-form affine fitting enables training-free conversion, while optional post-conversion training combines task supervision with output and relational feature distillation. Across all three backbones, Zebra3D achieves strong reconstruction and camera-pose accuracy at high attention sparsity, with training-free variants remaining close to their dense counterparts. End-to-end speedups increase with input view count, reaching up to $7.1\times$ at 1,024 views. After post-conversion training, Zebra3D-VGGT reaches 80.5\% RealEstate10K AUC@30 at 94\% mean attention sparsity, within 1.1 percentage points of dense VGGT fine-tuned on the same data and schedule.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    KPSA provides a kernel method with theoretical recovery bounds for amortizing input-dependent parameter sensitivity, and its experiments identify sparse sensitivity circuits and feature attribution patterns. This substantially advances scalable interpretability, while its use of kernel retrieval and throughput gains alone offers only incidental connections to composition, reasoning, or systems.

    KPSA 提供了一种带有理论恢复界的核方法，用于摊销依赖输入的参数敏感度计算；其实验还识别出稀疏敏感度回路和特征归因模式。这显著推动了可扩展可解释性的发展，而核检索的使用和吞吐量的提升本身与组合性、推理或系统的关联较为间接。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Gradient-based attribution provides input-specific information about model parameters, but computing it via backpropagation for many samples is expensive, while static importance scores discard input dependence. We derive KPSA (Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlas) from a block decomposition of the empirical neural tangent kernel. It measures normalized parameter-group sensitivity, embeds those sources in an explicit query space, and uses a lightweight kernel to estimate sensitivities for unseen inputs. We derive bounds that separate finite-source from irreducible representation error and give margin-based top-$k$ recovery. This paper studies two interpretability applications. Firstly, KPSA identifies parameter groups with high susceptibility to perturbations across vision, forecasting, and protein-modeling setups. Across a fivefold range of parameter budgets ($0.02$-$0.1\%$), its selected groups attain $39$-$85\%$ of the perturbation susceptibility of a first-order backpropagation oracle. In vision and forecasting, these parameter groups form sparse sensitivity circuits that extend across depth and vary systematically with the input. Secondly, we use KPSA on an activation-attribution problem for MLP features in transformers. It retains $81\%$ of the gap between a backpropagation oracle and a constant-sensitivity baseline on vision while increasing batched query-time throughput from 551 to 2,041 images/s and reducing peak GPU memory from 4.55 to 0.44GB. On the protein-modeling task, it recovers $68\%$ of this gap. An ablation of KPSA's kernel aggregation shows that nearest-neighbor retrieval in KPSA space can remain competitive. The empirics show that compact kernel atlases can store useful input-dependent parameter sensitivity while amortizing repeated gradient attribution, a step toward scalable conditional interpretability. Code can be found at https://github.com/Axym-Labs/kpsa .

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper interprets Transformer layers as approximate belief propagation and EM, with attention encoding structural affinities and layer transitions acting as implicit parameter updates; this offers substantial mechanistic insight relevant to interpretability and model computation. Its broader inference and instance-specific parameter framework touches composition and reasoning, but the abstract does not make either a central capability contribution.

    本文将 Transformer 层解释为近似的置信传播和 EM，其中注意力编码结构亲和性，层间转换则充当隐式参数更新；这为可解释性和模型计算提供了重要的机制性见解。其更广泛的推断和实例特定参数框架涉及组合性和推理，但摘要并未将二者作为核心能力贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We interpret Transformer networks as learned approximations to a hybrid probabilistic-inference procedure that combines max-product Loopy Belief Propagation (LBP) with Expectation--Maximization (EM). In this view, a Transformer performs inference in partially observed Markov Random Fields (MRFs) whose structure and parameters are not given a priori but are inferred from data. We show that self-attention implements a differentiable approximation to max-product LBP on an input-conditioned, dynamically structured MRF, with attention weights encoding learned structural affinities. We further establish an EM correspondence at the level of depth: each layer updates latent representations in an E-step-like forward pass, while the transition $\theta^{(l)} \to \theta^{(l+1)}$ across layers acts as an implicit M-step. Building on this interpretation, we introduce \emph{meta-models}, a design paradigm in which inputs generate instance-specific parameters, unifying mechanisms such as self-attention, mixture-of-experts, and gated units within a single framework. Empirical results support the proposed perspective.

    Large Language Model (LLM)-guided evolutionary optimization has successfully improved prompts, programs, and even entire AI systems. Most optimization methods select a candidate from the search frontier, then mutate it in one LLM pass based only on its failures. This focus on the frontier can stall on production AI systems, where isolated failures reveal little about complex, hidden interactions. We introduce CoCoEvolve (Cortex Code Evolve), an evolutionary optimizer built around what we call meta-reflection, wherein an agentic mutator (Cortex Code) selectively retrieves evidence from the entire evolutionary history and probes the live system before verifying and proposing mutations. We apply CoCoEvolve to optimize three classes of production AI systems: data agents, LLM-powered data pipelines, and data engineering workflows. On DABStep, CoCoEvolve tops the public leaderboard, reaching 92.8% held-out hard accuracy compared to 78.4% for Meta-Harness and 30.4% for GEPA under matched conditions. Across six LLM data pipeline workloads, it outperforms every evaluated baseline. On data-eng-bench, CoCoEvolve lifts test-set solve rate from 59.1% to 77.4%, past the best baseline of 73.6%. It also has 11 percentage points higher accuracy than GEPA on HotpotQA while remaining competitive with specialized optimizers on established mathematical and systems benchmarks. Matched ablations confirm that each component of CoCoEvolve contributes to these gains, demonstrating the value of meta-reflection for optimizing production AI systems.

    ENGLISH

    We study byte-level autoregressive language models whose hidden state is a small quantum register, whose transitions are learned token-conditioned quantum channels, and whose next-byte probabilities come directly from Born-rule measurements without a learned classical vocabulary projection or softmax. In the fixed-width recurrent setting, unitary dynamics cannot contract or reset stored distinctions; experimentally, unitary recurrence loses to its retrained one-token control in every tested variant. Introducing learned dissipation, then token-conditioned dissipative gating, yields useful memory beyond one token. The gated model improves test negative log-likelihood by 0.20 +/- 0.03 nats/byte over retrained parameter-matched one-token controls at context length 12, and by 0.29-0.33 at longer contexts, but never beats retrained two-token controls. A key-value recall benchmark shows a width-dependent threshold: one stored pair meets the pre-registered accuracy bar at 4-5 memory qubits, two pairs at 6-7, and three pairs remain unsolved. This is consistent with, but does not establish, a capacity explanation for the short effective memory horizon. As a secondary result, one-qubit models reach lower stationary memory entropy than a heuristically optimized classical predictive frontier at matched error in 9/9 seeds. On IBM Heron hardware, computational-basis memory-register distributions show signal against a uniform null in 12/12 circuits across prefixes of up to 12 tokens, next-bit probabilities pass pre-registered accuracy bars at four-token prefixes, and bytes are generated autoregressively by sampling physically measured bit probabilities. The tested models are classically simulable and substantially worse than classical n-gram baselines. We claim no computational quantum advantage.

    中文

    我们研究字节级自回归语言模型：其隐藏状态是一个小型量子寄存器，转移由学习得到的、以词元为条件的量子通道实现，下一个字节的概率则直接来自 Born 规则测量，无需学习经典词表投影或 softmax。在固定宽度的循环设置中，幺正动力学无法收缩或重置已存储的差异；实验上，在每一种测试变体中，幺正循环模型的表现都不如重新训练的一词元对照模型。引入学习得到的耗散，再引入以词元为条件的耗散门控后，模型便能获得超越一个词元的有效记忆。在上下文长度为 12 时，门控模型的测试负对数似然比参数量匹配的重新训练一词元对照模型低 0.20 +/- 0.03 纳特/字节；在更长上下文下则低 0.29-0.33，但始终不及重新训练的两词元对照模型。键值回忆基准显示出与宽度相关的阈值：存储一对键值时，4-5 个记忆量子比特即可达到预注册的准确率标准；存储两对时需要 6-7 个量子比特；三对仍未能解决。这与短有效记忆跨度可能由容量所致的解释相符，但尚不足以证明该解释。作为次要结果，在匹配误差的情况下，单量子比特模型在 9/9 个随机种子上的稳态记忆熵均低于通过启发式优化得到的经典预测前沿。在 IBM Heron 硬件上，对于最长 12 个词元的前缀，12/12 个电路的计算基记忆寄存器分布均显示出相对于均匀零假设的信号；下一个比特的概率在四词元前缀上通过了预注册的准确率标准，且字节是通过对物理测得的比特概率采样而自回归生成的。所测试的模型可由经典计算模拟，且表现显著不及经典 n-gram 基线。我们不声称获得了计算量子优势。

    The Expressive Power of Random-Feature MPNNs Across Graph Sizes

    随机特征 MPNN 在不同图规模下的表达能力

    Robert R. Nerem, Mitchell Black, Antonis Vasileiou, Christopher Morris, Yusu Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a theoretical framework for size-uniform approximation by random-feature MPNNs, proves expressivity limits, and analyzes color and trial effects, with constructions for graph tasks. Its core contribution concerns the expressive capacity of compositional graph architectures, while it does not study model internals, reasoning, or agent systems.

    本文建立了随机特征 MPNN 进行规模一致逼近的理论框架，证明其表达能力存在局限，并分析颜色和试验次数的影响，同时给出了针对图任务的构造。其核心贡献关乎组合式图架构的表达能力；本文不研究模型内部机制、推理或智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Continuous random node features increase the expressivity of message-passing neural networks (MPNNs), but existing theoretical analyses are not fine-grained enough to capture their limitations, particularly in approximating functions across graph sizes or under a fixed number of random bits. We develop a population-level framework for size-uniform approximation. For MPNNs with a graph-size-independent Lipschitz bound in their initial features, including standard mean, max, and order-normalized sum architectures, we show that continuous random features can be quantized to finitely many colors with arbitrarily small uniform error in expected output. This reduction lets us transfer limitations on finite-color distinguishability to limitations on size-uniform approximation with continuous random features. We use this framework to prove that these MPNNs are not size-uniformly universal, analyze the expressivity gains from colors and independent trials, and establish incomparability between random-color MPNNs and higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman methods. We also give finite-color MPNN constructions for tree subgraph isomorphism via color coding and a local MST task.

    中文

    连续随机节点特征能够增强消息传递神经网络（MPNN）的表达能力，但现有理论分析的细致程度不足以刻画其局限，尤其是在跨图规模逼近函数或随机比特数固定时的局限。我们建立了一个总体层面的规模一致逼近框架。对于初始特征上的 Lipschitz 界与图规模无关的 MPNN（包括标准均值、最大值和阶数归一化求和架构），我们证明，连续随机特征可以量化为有限种颜色，同时使期望输出的统一误差任意小。这一归约使我们能够将有限颜色可区分性的局限转化为连续随机特征下规模一致逼近能力的局限。我们利用该框架证明这些 MPNN 不具备规模一致的通用逼近能力，分析颜色和独立试验带来的表达能力增益，并确立随机颜色 MPNN 与高阶 Weisfeiler-Leman 方法之间不存在支配关系。我们还给出了通过颜色编码实现树子图同构的有限颜色 MPNN 构造，以及一个局部 MST 任务的构造。

    VEPA: Verified Evolving Formal Policy for Lifelong LLM Agent Guardrails

    VEPA：面向终身 LLM 智能体防护机制的经验证演化形式化策略

    Duy Nguyen, Lesly Miculicich, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Shuo Li, Krishnamurthy Dj Dvijotham, Mohit Bansal, Tomas Pfister, Long T. Le

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VEPA’s main contribution is a formal, deterministic guardrail that evolves through verified policy patches and evidence-aware activation, advancing adaptive agent safety systems. The LLM proposes updates, but the abstract does not show a substantive contribution to model reasoning or internal interpretability; symbolic rules alone do not establish compositional generalization.

    VEPA 的主要贡献是一种形式化、确定性的防护机制，可通过经过验证的策略补丁和具备证据感知能力的启用机制持续演化，从而推动自适应智能体安全系统的发展。LLM 负责提出更新，但摘要未显示其对模型推理或内部可解释性有实质贡献；仅有符号规则不足以证明存在组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents increasingly operate over sensitive resources, such as private documents and mutable system states, which can create serious safety and security risks. Runtime guardrails should therefore make inspectable, reproducible, and deterministic allow or refuse decisions before potentially irreversible agent actions are executed. However, safety and security requirements are rarely complete before deployment, so guardrails need to keep adapting as new risks emerge. Existing adaptive guardrails learn from deployment experience, but they usually apply safety policies through LLM inference, which can lead to inconsistent decisions and ambiguous policy interpretations. Formal guardrails, on the other hand, enforce policies deterministically, but they usually rely on pre-deployment or task-specific policies and have no mechanism to adapt to newly observed risks. We introduce VEPA, a framework for the verified evolution of formal agent guardrails. VEPA represents the guardrail as a formal policy of executable symbolic rules over typed agent events. During deployment, we use an LLM guided by deployment feedback to propose policy patches that fix newly observed failures while preserving previously correct behavior. Then, a deterministic verifier only accepts policies that are structurally valid and conflict-free. Finally, an evidence-aware authority layer activates a verified rule only when it has enough supporting evidence, so uncertain updates cannot directly affect guardrail decisions. Across ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security, and ATBench, VEPA consistently outperforms baselines while expanding the scope of deterministic formal-policy enforcement. These gains also hold under more challenging deployment conditions, including mixed streams, corrupted feedback, and longer horizons.

    中文

    LLM 智能体日益需要操作私有文档和可变系统状态等敏感资源，这可能带来严重的安全与安保风险。因此，运行时防护机制应在执行可能不可逆的智能体操作之前，作出可检查、可复现且确定性的允许或拒绝决策。然而，安全和安保要求在部署前很少能够完全确定，因此防护机制需要随着新风险出现而持续适应。现有自适应防护机制会从部署经验中学习，但通常通过 LLM 推理来应用安全策略，这可能导致决策不一致和策略解释含糊。另一方面，形式化防护机制能够确定性地执行策略，但通常依赖部署前制定或针对特定任务的策略，也没有适应新观察到风险的机制。我们提出 VEPA，这是一种用于经验证演化形式化智能体防护机制的框架。VEPA 将防护机制表示为一套形式化策略，其中包含针对带类型智能体事件的可执行符号规则。在部署期间，我们使用由部署反馈引导的 LLM 提出策略补丁，以修复新观察到的失败，同时保留此前正确的行为。随后，确定性验证器只接受结构有效且无冲突的策略。最后，具备证据感知能力的授权层仅在有足够支持证据时才启用经过验证的规则，从而避免不确定的更新直接影响防护决策。在 ASSEBench-Safety、ASSEBench-Security 和 ATBench 上，VEPA 始终优于基线，同时扩大了确定性形式化策略执行的范围。在更具挑战性的部署条件下，包括混合流、受污染反馈和更长运行周期，这些提升依然成立。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LeWAM jointly learns latent world dynamics and action generation for direct control and faster planning, with evidence of useful control representations.     LeWAM 联合学习潜在世界动态和动作生成，以支持直接控制并加快规划，同时有证据显示它学到了有用的控制表征。这显著推动了规划和基于模型的智能体系统；其可解释性分析范围有限，摘要也未证明存在组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn compact latent world models without pixel reconstruction. Existing JEPA pipelines typically train visual representations and action-conditioned dynamics before adding a control policy or solver. We introduce LeWAM, an end-to-end JEPA for control with: (1) a joint training objective over next latent state prediction and action flow matching, and (2) an isotropic Gaussian constraint on the latent state, enabling a single model to support direct policy execution and efficient planning by evaluating sampled actions with its learned latent dynamics. Compared with prior JEPAs in visual planning, LeWAM improves success rate from 28.6% to 89.7% on contact-rich tasks and from 10.9% to 46.2% on long-horizon tasks, and plans 32.3 times faster. On behavior cloning tasks in simulation and physical robots, LeWAM is also competitive with established methods. Interpretability analyses show that LeWAM learns control-relevant representations and action distributions effectively guiding test-time planning and control.

    中文

    联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）无需重建像素即可学习紧凑的潜在世界模型。现有 JEPA 流水线通常先训练视觉表征和以动作为条件的动态模型，再添加控制策略或求解器。我们提出 LeWAM，这是一种用于控制的端到端 JEPA，具有：(1) 联合训练目标，同时优化下一潜在状态预测和动作流匹配；(2) 对潜在状态施加各向同性高斯约束，使单个模型既支持直接执行策略，也能通过使用其学习到的潜在动态评估采样动作来高效规划。与以往用于视觉规划的 JEPA 相比，LeWAM 在接触密集型任务上的成功率从 28.6% 提高到 89.7%，在长时程任务上从 10.9% 提高到 46.2%，规划速度则提高了 32.3 倍。在仿真和实体机器人上的行为克隆任务中，LeWAM 也能与成熟方法相竞争。可解释性分析表明，LeWAM 学到了与控制相关的表征，而其动作分布能有效指导测试时的规划与控制。

    TreeHCA: Hindsight-Guided Exploration and Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn LLM Agents

    TreeHCA：面向多轮 LLM 智能体的后见引导探索与信用分配

    Debajoy Mukherjee, Jeremy Carleton, Sushil Vemuri, Srinivas Shakkottai, Dileep Kalathil

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TreeHCA develops hindsight-guided exploration and turn-level credit assignment for training multi-turn LLM agents, with an importance correction and tree backup. Its reasoning and agent-training contributions are substantial; tree structure alone does not establish compositional generalization, and the abstract offers no interpretability contribution.

    TreeHCA 为多轮 LLM 智能体训练开发了后见引导探索和轮级信用分配，并采用重要性校正与树备份。它在推理和智能体训练方面贡献显著；仅有树结构并不能证明组合泛化，摘要也没有提出可解释性方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Outcome-supervised group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) assigns the same advantage to every token in an LLM agent trajectory, leaving useful and unhelpful decisions undifferentiated. Hindsight credit assignment (HCA) can refine this feedback, but its estimates rely on trajectories containing informative alternatives at consequential histories. We introduce TreeHCA, which couples hindsight-guided exploration with hindsight credit assignment. TreeHCA uses changes in reference-answer likelihood to revisit intermediate histories and sample alternative continuations, forming a tree of reasoning and tool interactions. Because this exploration changes the distribution of sampled continuations, we derive the corresponding inverse-hindsight importance correction, including an exact finite-pool identity. We use this structure in a normalized tree backup that propagates terminal outcomes into turn-level advantages. This shared hindsight structure is TreeHCA's central design principle, linking informative exploration with hindsight-guided credit assignment. Across seven question-answering benchmarks and three Qwen backbones, TreeHCA outperforms all baselines in aggregate exact match, validating the effectiveness of paired exploration and credit assignment for multi-turn LLM agent training. Our code is available at github.com/TheBlackCat22/TreeHCA.

    中文

    结果监督的组相对策略优化（GRPO）会为 LLM 智能体轨迹中的每个词元分配相同的优势值，因而无法区分有用和无用的决策。后见信用分配（HCA）可以细化这种反馈，但其估计依赖于这样的轨迹：在关键历史节点上包含有信息量的替代方案。我们提出 TreeHCA，将后见引导探索与后见信用分配结合起来。TreeHCA 利用参考答案似然的变化重新访问中间历史，并采样替代续写，从而形成一棵推理与工具交互树。由于这种探索会改变采样续写的分布，我们推导出相应的逆后见重要性校正，其中包括一个精确的有限样本池恒等式。我们利用这一结构进行归一化树备份，将终端结果传播为轮级优势值。这种共享的后见结构是 TreeHCA 的核心设计原则，它将信息性探索与后见引导的信用分配联系起来。在七个问答基准和三个 Qwen 骨干模型上，TreeHCA 的汇总精确匹配表现优于所有基线，验证了将探索与信用分配配对用于多轮 LLM 智能体训练的有效性。代码见 github.com/TheBlackCat22/TreeHCA。

    Du Cheng, Junyu Lu, Jingfan Zhang, Yuzhuo Zhang, Haoxuan Jia, Shichao Weng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CBPO proposes a shared regression objective and replay buffer for training reasoning models from demonstrations and on- and off-policy rollouts, with gains on mathematical benchmarks.     CBPO 提出共享回归目标和回放缓冲区，以利用示范以及在线和离线策略轨迹训练推理模型，并在数学基准上取得提升。该训练方法对推理能力发展有显著作用；回放与系统中的数据复用有关，但文中没有描述记忆机制或更广泛的系统架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning post-training draws on offline demonstrations and policy-generated rollouts, yet conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL) separates their objectives and limits continued reuse of collected responses. We propose \textbf{Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization} (CBPO), which makes these sources compatible with one regression loss through a fixed-reference target. Because the generating policy does not enter this target, positive and negative offline completions, reference responses, and current and historical rollouts can share a common reward-labeled record format and replay buffer. As new responses enter the buffer, optimization retains the same regression objective without coordinating separate SFT and RL objectives or requiring stored behavior-policy probabilities, importance weighting, or a learned critic. Restricting the available sources gives offline, on-policy, and off-policy variants, while CBPO-Unified combines them. Across two model scales and four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CBPO delivers leading \texttt{avg@32} and \texttt{pass@32} performance across benchmarks and data regimes. On Qwen3-1.7B, CBPO-Unified improves benchmark-averaged \texttt{avg@32} and \texttt{pass@32} over SFT DAPO by 2.33 and 4.44 percentage points, respectively. In the replay ablation, retaining historical rollouts improves these metrics by 1.87 and 3.72 percentage points over the no-history configuration.

    中文

    推理后训练会用到离线示范和策略生成的轨迹，但传统的监督微调（SFT）后接强化学习（RL）将两者的目标分开，限制了对已收集响应的持续复用。我们提出\textbf{跨行为策略优化}（CBPO），通过固定参考目标，使这些来源能够兼容于同一个回归损失。由于生成策略不参与该目标，正面和负面的离线补全、参考响应以及当前和历史轨迹，都可以采用统一的带奖励标签记录格式和回放缓冲区。随着新响应进入缓冲区，优化过程仍保留相同的回归目标，无需协调彼此独立的 SFT 和 RL 目标，也无需存储行为策略概率、进行重要性加权或使用学习得到的评论器。限制可用数据来源即可得到离线、在线策略和离线策略变体，而 CBPO-Unified 则将这些来源结合起来。在两个模型规模和四个数学推理基准上，CBPO 在不同基准和数据设定下均取得领先的\texttt{avg@32}和\texttt{pass@32}表现。在 Qwen3-1.7B 上，与 SFT DAPO 相比，CBPO-Unified 的基准平均\texttt{avg@32}和\texttt{pass@32}分别提高了 2.33 和 4.44 个百分点。在回放消融实验中，与不保留历史的配置相比，保留历史轨迹使这两项指标分别提高了 1.87 和 3.72 个百分点。

    Jiaqi Tian, Ting Long

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper links capability degradation during self-distillation to changes in hidden-representation geometry and proposes regularization to preserve that geometry. This is a substantial representation-geometry contribution, while capability improvement is a training context rather than a study of reasoning mechanisms or composition.

    本文将自蒸馏过程中的能力退化与隐藏表征几何变化联系起来，并提出正则化方法以保留这种几何结构。这是对表征几何的显著贡献；能力提升属于训练背景，而非对推理机制或组合的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-Policy Self-distillation is a self-improvement paradigm that enables large language models (LLMs) to improve their capabilities by leveraging the same model as both teacher and student under different conditioning contexts. However, we find that OPSD methods can progressively degrade previously acquired capabilities: queries that are correctly responded at earlier training stages may become incorrectly responded as optimization proceeds, even the overall performance continues to improve. Further analysis reveals that this degradation coincides with a deterioration of the geometry of hidden representations, characterized by reduced intra-cluster compactness and diminished inter-cluster separation. Motivated by this observation, we propose Representation Geometry Regularization (RGR), which preserves representation geometry during post-training by encouraging compactness within cluster and separation across cluster. RGR can be seamlessly integrated into existing OPSD methods without altering their core optimization procedures. Extensive experiments on multiple OPSD methods and benchmarks show that RGR generally alleviates capability degradation while retaining capability improvements. Our code is available in https://github.com/supermachinelearner/RGR.

    Fanzhi Zeng, Anubrata Das, Maytal Saar-Tsechansky, Liu Leqi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CToM trains models to predict user replies and revise responses, improving collaborative task performance and interaction efficiency. Its optimization advances reasoning behavior and agent interaction, while anticipated replies do not establish compositional generalization or reveal internal representations.

    CToM 训练模型预测用户回复并修订自身响应，从而提升协作任务表现和交互效率。其优化推进了推理行为和智能体交互；而预判回复并不能证明组合泛化，也无法揭示内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate strong individual task performance, yet still struggle to collaborate with users over extended, multi-turn interactions, for example by attempting solutions before understanding the user's needs or by failing to revise mistaken assumptions after receiving feedback. We propose Collaborative Theory of Mind (CToM), a framework that addresses these challenges by explicitly training LLMs to anticipate user responses and to use those predictions to improve their own behavior. CToM drafts a response, predicts how the user will respond, and uses this prediction to guide internal revision before presenting a response. During training, the user's reply to each draft serves as the target for predicting the next turn, and we train the assistant to minimize the negative log-likelihood of that reply. We combine this prediction objective with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to optimize both task performance and interaction efficiency. Across mathematical reasoning, coding, and writing tasks, CToM achieves higher collaborative task performance than all baselines; for example, on a collaborative mathematical reasoning task, it improves final accuracy from 74.1% to 79.6% compared with naive GRPO. Ablations show that predicting user responses also makes collaboration more efficient: under the same reward, adding prediction supervision reduces the number of user replies by 8% on coding and 17% on writing while improving task performance. Behavioral analyses of interaction trajectories show that user-response predictions become more accurate after training, and that more accurate predictions are associated with larger improvements in collaborative task performance through self-revision.

    ENGLISH

    Non-autoregressive multi-step forecasting (NAF) enables time series foundation models to predict an entire future horizon in a single forward pass. Despite its strong sequence modeling capabilities, RWKV-7 exhibits long-horizon degradation in our NAF experiments. In this setup, future patches are represented as missing inputs, requiring the recurrent state to evolve across the prediction horizon without new observations. Our analysis of RWKV-7's generalized delta rule suggests a mechanism we term Placeholder Idling Decay (PID): repeated state transitions can attenuate historical information when placeholder-driven writes provide insufficient compensation. Layer-wise analysis reveals reduced state-injection norms in most layers, while transition-matrix norms remain similar between historical and prediction regions, consistent with PID. Motivated by this analysis, we propose HART, a Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time-series Foundation Model that alternates attention and RWKV blocks, combining direct access to historical tokens with recurrent temporal modeling. Controlled experiments on GIFT-Eval and TIME-Benchmark show that HART improves over pure RWKV at medium and long horizons while maintaining comparable short-horizon performance, and achieves better aggregate performance than a comparably sized pure Transformer. With 36M parameters, HART achieves long-horizon MASE comparable to Toto-2.0-1B on GIFT-Eval (0.752 vs. 0.754), using approximately 1/28 of its parameters.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper trains heterogeneous model collaborators with step-level supervision to reassess and improve multi-step reasoning, making reasoning improvement a substantial contribution. It also advances collaborative agent organization and reports efficiency gains; differentiated collaboration suggests partial compositional relevance, but no explicit composition mechanism is described.

    本文通过步骤级监督训练异质模型协作者，以重新评估并改进多步推理，因此推理能力提升是其重要贡献。本文还推进了协作式智能体组织并报告了效率提升；不同任务呈现不同协作模式，说明其与组合性有一定关联，但文中没有描述明确的组合机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) excel across diverse tasks, benefiting from knowledge priors, in-context reasoning, and test-time computation. Despite these strengths, single-model reasoning remains vulnerable to error propagation, as later steps depend on the model's earlier outputs, leaving reasoning blind spots difficult to independently reassess. To address this limitation, we develop \textit{collaborative learning}, encompassing the construction of heterogeneous collaborators and the learning of effective cross-model collaboration. Specifically, \textit{model slicing} replaces a large model with smaller, heterogeneous models under a comparable parameter budget, enabling prior reasoning to be reassessed across distinct model parameterizations. \textit{Pyramid supervision} combines protocol distillation with step-level supervision to refine reasoning and interaction decisions throughout collaboration. We evaluate our approach across four task categories: multi-hop question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and open-ended constrained generation. The trained heterogeneous models achieve comparable or better task performance than the original large model and established multi-agent baselines, including reinforcement-learning-based methods, while also achieving higher inference efficiency than the multi-agent baselines and exhibiting differentiated collaboration patterns across tasks. These findings show that learned collaboration turns model heterogeneity into complementary reasoning capabilities.

    SEEDS: Preview-Guided Evidence Admission for Search Agents

    Jiajin Liu and Chenxi Xu and Dongzhe Fan and Yuanfu Sun and Qiaoyu Tan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SEEDS lets search agents choose which retrieved evidence to admit into their reasoning context, with learning as an optional extension, and reports improved effectiveness with lower evidence consumption. This substantially advances agent information use and supports reasoning, while the abstract provides no evidence about internal representations or compositional generalization.

    SEEDS 让搜索智能体决定将哪些检索证据纳入推理上下文，并可选择通过学习进行扩展；实验表明，该方法能以更少的证据消耗提高效果。这显著推进了智能体的信息利用能力，并支持推理；摘要没有提供其涉及内部表征或组合泛化的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Search agents extend large reasoning models with multi-round access to external knowledge, yet most existing systems largely conflate retrieving evidence with consuming it. Retrieved documents are commonly incorporated according to fixed or rank-based policies, despite the fact that evidence utility is conditioned on the agent's current reasoning state. Consequently, a lower-ranked candidate may be critical for the current step, while a higher-ranked candidate may provide redundant, irrelevant, or misleading information. We formulate this overlooked problem as evidence admission, which asks, at each search step, which retrieved candidates should be allowed to enter the agent's evolving reasoning context. To enable such selective control, we introduce SEEDS (Selective Evidence Entry During Search), a preview-guided evidence admission framework for search agents. SEEDS first exposes lightweight previews of retrieved candidates and then lets the agent jointly determine which candidates and how many should be fully inspected, conditioned on its current reasoning state. Unlike fixed or adaptive prefix policies, SEEDS can select arbitrary subsets with flexible cardinality, and it can be instantiated directly with an existing reasoning agent or further optimized through learning. Across nine knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks under both local corpus and live web search, SEEDS consistently improves search effectiveness while substantially reducing full-evidence consumption. Experimental analyses show that SEEDS more effectively selects useful candidates beyond the corresponding retrieval prefix. These results establish evidence admission as a complementary dimension of agentic search, separating what information is retrieved from what information is ultimately allowed to shape reasoning.

    搜索智能体通过多轮访问外部知识来扩展大型推理模型的能力，但大多数现有系统基本上将证据检索与证据使用混为一谈。检索到的文档通常按固定策略或排名策略纳入上下文，尽管证据的效用取决于智能体当前的推理状态。因此，排名较低的候选项可能对当前步骤至关重要，而排名较高的候选项则可能提供冗余、无关或误导性信息。我们将这一被忽视的问题表述为证据接纳问题：在每个搜索步骤中，哪些检索到的候选项应被允许进入智能体不断演化的推理上下文？为实现这种选择性控制，我们提出 SEEDS（搜索期间的选择性证据输入），这是一种面向搜索智能体、由预览引导的证据接纳框架。SEEDS 首先展示检索候选项的轻量级预览，然后让智能体根据当前推理状态，同时决定要完整检查哪些候选项以及检查多少项。与固定或自适应前缀策略不同，SEEDS 可以选择任意子集，并灵活确定子集大小；它既可以直接与现有推理智能体结合，也可以通过学习进一步优化。在九个知识密集型问答基准上，无论使用本地语料库搜索还是实时网络搜索，SEEDS 都能持续提高搜索效果，同时大幅减少对完整证据的消耗。实验分析表明，SEEDS 能够比相应的检索前缀策略更有效地选出有用候选项。这些结果表明，证据接纳是智能体搜索的一个互补维度，它将检索到哪些信息与最终允许哪些信息影响推理区分开来。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Decoder hidden states from different layers of large language models (LLMs) often encode complementary information. However, existing speculative decoding methods typically rely on a small set of target-model layers chosen using fixed, position-based heuristics. Selecting an optimal subset of layers is inherently a combinatorial problem, making exhaustive evaluation infeasible even for moderately deep models. In this work, we present a principled framework for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding based on two complementary criteria: informativeness, measured through matrix-entropy analysis, and diversity, quantified using centered kernel alignment (CKA). We investigate layer-wise Shannon entropy, aggregate entropy under hidden-state concatenation, and pairwise CKA dynamics across depth, revealing distinct geometric and informational compartments within decoder representations. Motivated by these findings, we propose entropy and CKA-based layer selection algorithms that favor hidden-state sets that are both highly informative and minimally redundant. As part of this framework, we introduce token-entropy filtering, which removes hidden states associated with low predictive-entropy tokens, thereby improving the quality of layer-selection statistics. In EAGLE3-style speculative decoding, our selected sets outperform fixed baseline choices, including the default $[2, N//2, N-3]$ rule, while providing a clearer explanation of why some defaults can remain competitive. Our results provide a practical recipe for multi-layer hidden-state selection for speculative decoding, insights into the geometry and information in LLM decoder states, and a foundation for extending similar analysis to related applications.

    Embodied agents must translate multimodal observations and user requests into executable actions while adapting to product constraints, changing goals, and execution feedback. We present JoyInside-VLM-Agent, a ReAct-style multimodal agent developed through product-conditioned trajectory construction and staged policy learning for robotic platforms and smart hardware. A closed-loop sandbox generates multimodal interaction trajectories covering goal revisions and failure recovery, which are checked against execution outcomes and semantic criteria. Supervised fine-tuning and multi-teacher on-policy distillation precede reinforcement learning with DPER (Dual-Source Privileged On-Policy Self-Distillation with Token-Level Evidence Routing). DPER routes token-level evidence between a frozen privileged teacher and a privileged student sharing the rollout policy's parameters, modulating reward-derived token advantages while preserving their signs. Training rewards combine generative process evaluation, multi-judge rankings, and task-queue consistency. JoyInside-VLM-Agent achieves a BFCL v4 overall score of 77.44, exceeding the evaluated baselines; results on the other public benchmarks are mixed. On JoyInside-Devices and JoyInside-Robotics, the evaluated system, which includes domain-specific skill refinement, leads the baselines on all reported metrics.     We introduce MVGraph, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models (LVLMs) on multi-graph reasoning where the evidence required by a query is distributed across multiple interrelated visual graph views. Although such evidence commonly resides in source-specific graphs, temporal snapshots, or local observations, existing graph reasoning benchmarks remain confined to a single self-contained structure, assessing only graph perception and reasoning while leaving the alignment and composition of evidence across views underexplored. MVGraph comprises 8k instances spanning 8 \textit{graph-theoretic} tasks, abstracted from two multi-graph scenarios (partial and temporal graph views). Each problem is programmatically constructed and verified to be unsolvable from a single view. Beyond end-to-end evaluation, we decompose multi-graph reasoning into four complementary capabilities---Perception, Alignment, Composition, and Reasoning---and design 29 diagnostic tasks with 64k instances to probe each one, along with golden intermediate representations for evaluating the intermediate process.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures where visual-residual edits lose causal leverage across decoder layers and uses that finding to route interventions selectively, providing transferable evidence about intervention effects inside multimodal models.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Visual interventions provide a training-free way to reduce hallucinations in multimodal large language models. However, an intervention may have little leverage at some layers and may damage a correct answer even when it changes the output. We investigate where visual interventions retain leverage and when they improve predictions. First, we apply the same visual-residual edit at successive decoder layers, matching its RMS strength across depth. Across six checkpoints from three model families, we observe a persistent drop in intervention effect and define its operational onset for this edit as the \textbf{Evidence Anchoring Boundary (EAB)}. With boundaries fixed on calibration queries, held-out effects on disjoint evaluation queries before EAB are $13.78\times$--$26.10\times$ larger than those after it. Comparison with intermediate readouts shows that the edit can lose leverage before answer preferences stabilize. Second, we compare counterfactual subtraction across presence, attribute, and relation questions. Subtraction can correct a misleading preference, leave a decision unchanged, or remove a preference supporting the correct answer. Based on these observations, we develop calibrated selective routing, which preserves the original prediction unless calibration supports an intervention for the question type. It improves full-set attribute accuracy by $1.56$--$1.81$ percentage points across three checkpoints, while universal subtraction is neutral or harmful.

    Computer-use agents can perform increasingly complex GUI tasks, yet unfamiliar software and workflows requiring human domain knowledge remain challenging. We thus introduce Work2Skill, a framework that captures human GUI experience for reusable agent skill induction. WorkRecorder provides the framework's infrastructure for collecting this experience, aligning screen recordings, mouse and keyboard events, and available accessibility-tree information. Using WorkRecorder, we construct WorkDemo-350, the first synchronized multimodal dataset of human desktop GUI demonstrations for reusable agent skill induction and downstream evaluation.     SFT 应该学什么？面向可泛化后训练的条件信息增益

    Yuxuan Gu, Kequan Niu, Xiaocheng Feng, Yun Li, Yiqiao Yang, Bing Qin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CIG-SFT derives an information-based token weighting and equivalent objective for teaching task-specific decisions, with reported gains in mathematical reasoning and code generation generalization. Its connection to composition is incidental: the abstract does not study compositional representations or systematic recombination.

    CIG-SFT 推导出一种基于信息的 token 加权方法及等价目标，用于教授任务特定决策，并报告了数学推理和代码生成泛化方面的提升。它与组合性的联系仅属间接；摘要没有研究组合表征或系统化重组。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) remains a widely used approach for post-training large language models, because fixed demonstrations can directly introduce desired reasoning strategies and behavioral patterns. Yet forcing a model to imitate externally provided trajectories may also interfere with behaviors already supported by pretraining, limiting generalization beyond the training distribution. Recent dynamic SFT methods mitigate this issue by reweighting token-level supervision according to model-side signals such as predictive probability, prior support, or distributional compatibility. However, model compatibility is not equivalent to learning value: a token that is weakly supported by the current model may either be an undesirable mismatch or precisely the task-specific decision that the demonstration is intended to teach. We propose CIG-SFT, an information-theoretic framework that estimates the task-conditioned information carried by each demonstrated token. Under teacher forcing, we compare the token likelihood from a frozen reference model with and without access to the task input while keeping the gold solution prefix fixed. The resulting conditional information gain quantifies how much the task itself reduces uncertainty about the demonstrated decision. We then convert this information into a KL-regularized projection of the current policy and derive an equivalent scalar-weighted SFT objective whose logit gradient exactly matches that of the projected target. Across mathematical reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, CIG-SFT consistently outperforms standard SFT and recent adaptive fine-tuning baselines, with particularly strong improvements in generalization to challenging evaluation distributions, while requiring neither additional training data nor online rollouts.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language-model agents are used for specialized work such as financial research, healthcare and law. Such agents are often capable enough for a task but still miss its details. In finance, for example, these details include which filing reports a figure or how a company discloses a metric. Retraining the agent to learn these details is expensive, and often impossible when the agent is a closed or shared system. Writing the missing know-how into the agent's prompt makes the prompt long and identical for every input, although different inputs need different guidance. We propose to learn to generate this guidance instead. A small advisor model reads each input and writes structured advice, which is appended to the prompt of a frozen executor. The advisor is trained with hindsight, following work on distillation with privileged information. On a training pool with graded answers, we analyse the executor's failures, run it under several strategies to see which one worked on each input, and let a teacher that sees the grades and the traces write the advice that would have helped. The advisor then learns, by supervised fine-tuning, to write that advice from the input alone. Because the student is a separate small model rather than the executor, it is cheap to train and adds little latency. We call this approach hindsight structured advice distillation (HSAD). On FrontierFinance, a public benchmark of expert-written financial research queries, an 8B advisor raises the qualification rate of Samaya's proprietary research agent, which already leads the benchmark's leaderboard, from 52.9% to 56.6%. This is above the agent's own high-effort configuration, at 37% lower cost per query. We study the generalization of the proposed approach, and in particular show that HSAD also improves results on WebShop, BIRD text-to-SQL and ExpertLongBench.

    Empowerment measures the capacity of an agent to actively control its environment. In this work, we explain the connection between skill learning and empowerment. While skill learning is not empowerment, we introduce a simple scalable recipe for empowerment maximization: empowerment corresponds to the number of executable skills from a state, so maximizing empowerment corresponds to reaching states that are good starting points for many skills. Our recipe applies to arbitrary underlying skill learning methods. Whereas most prior work on empowerment looks at tabular settings, this recipe enables us to study empowerment at a scale where we can realize theoretically-predicted but empirically-elusive properties of empowerment (e.g., gathering resources, environment modification, survival). Experiments show that empowerment maximization unlocks interesting emergent properties, such as building a house in Crafter.     Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization: Unifying LLM RL Algorithms from the Perspective of Divergence

    广义近端策略优化：从散度视角统一 LLM 强化学习算法

    Zhicheng Cai, Xinyuan Guo, Hanlin Wu, Weinan Dai, Yuyan Zhou, Wei-Ying Ma, Ya-Qin Zhang, Hao Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a divergence-based theory and algorithmic framework for LLM reinforcement learning, with experiments on math and coding reasoning. Its policy optimization contributes substantially to reasoning capability development; the optimization framework alone does not establish a substantive model-systems contribution.

    本文提出基于散度的理论和算法框架，用于 LLM 强化学习，并在数学和编程推理任务上进行了实验。其策略优化对推理能力发展有重要贡献；仅凭优化框架本身，尚不足以构成实质性的模型系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning has become the foundational paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. Yet the dominant approach, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), relies on a geometrically degenerate clipping proxy that cannot adapt its resistance to policy shifts, leading to premature clipping and degraded exploration. Subsequent variants alleviate these issues through fragmented and heuristic modifications. We propose Generalized Proximal Policy Optimization (GPPO), a principled and unified framework for understanding and designing LLM RL algorithms through the lens of divergence. We establish a generalized $f$-divergence trust-region theory with a monotonic performance improvement guarantee, and show that different $f$-divergences induce distinct geometries and policy update dynamics. We further introduce novel estimator topologies that provide more faithful divergence estimates than the conventional single-sample Monte Carlo estimation. Under this framework, PPO and recent variants such as DAPO, DPPO, and RIPO emerge as special cases, establishing a principled two-dimensional design space of {Divergence $\times$ Estimator}. Extensive experiments on eight competition-level math and coding benchmarks show that both dimensions are critical. The best-performing GPPO instantiation surpasses standard GRPO by up to 50% and 14% on math and coding, delivering SOTA performance.

    中文

    强化学习已成为提升 LLM 推理能力的基础范式。然而，主流方法近端策略优化（PPO）依赖一种几何上退化的裁剪代理，无法根据策略变化调整其抵抗程度，导致过早裁剪并削弱探索。后续变体通过零散的启发式修改缓解了这些问题。我们提出广义近端策略优化（GPPO），这是一个原则化且统一的框架，通过散度视角理解和设计 LLM 强化学习算法。我们建立了一种广义$f$散度信赖域理论，并给出单调性能提升保证；同时表明，不同的$f$散度会产生不同的几何结构和策略更新动态。我们还提出了新颖的估计器拓扑，与传统的单样本蒙特卡洛估计相比，它们能更忠实地估计散度。在该框架下，PPO 以及 DAPO、DPPO 和 RIPO 等近期变体都成为特例，由此确立了一个原则化的二维设计空间：{散度$\times$估计器}。在八个竞赛级数学和编程基准上进行的大量实验表明，这两个维度都至关重要。表现最佳的 GPPO 实例在数学和编程任务上分别比标准 GRPO 高出最多 50% 和 14%，达到 SOTA 性能。

    Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization: Closing the State Distribution Gap in Long-Horizon LLM RL

    轨迹感知策略优化：弥合长时程 LLM 强化学习中的状态分布差距

    Zhicheng Cai, Weinan Dai, Yuyan Zhou, Wei-Ying Ma, Ya-Qin Zhang, Hao Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TAPO derives trajectory-level state-distribution correction and introduces estimators and clipping for more stable long-horizon LLM reinforcement learning, evaluated on reasoning and coding. This is a substantial training contribution to reasoning capability development; trajectory optimization is only an incidental connection to model systems.

    TAPO 推导了轨迹级状态分布校正，并引入估计器和裁剪方法，使长时程 LLM 强化学习更加稳定；其评测涵盖推理和编程任务。这是对推理能力发展有重要贡献的训练方法；轨迹优化与模型系统的联系则只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. Yet long-horizon autoregressive rollouts introduce a fundamental limitation: local policy mismatch can compound into severe state distribution shift over trajectories. Existing LLM RL methods, such as GRPO and GSPO, control policy mismatch at the token or sequence level, but overlook this trajectory-induced shift, causing training instability and eventual collapse as the horizon grows. To close the state distribution gap, we propose Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), a principled framework that theoretically derives the state-distribution correction from the off-policy policy gradient and incorporates it into the RL objective. TAPO further employs a geometric-mean estimator for variance reduction, together with a length-aware dynamic clipping that prevents overly deviated updates across the trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TAPO significantly surpasses existing LLM RL algorithms across eight competition-level benchmarks, achieving up to 48% and 12% improvement over GRPO on mathematical reasoning and algorithmic coding, with substantially enhanced training stability.

    中文

    强化学习（RL）已成为提升 LLM 推理能力的主流范式。然而，长时程自回归展开带来了一项根本性局限：局部策略失配会沿轨迹累积，造成严重的状态分布偏移。现有 LLM 强化学习方法（如 GRPO 和 GSPO）会在词元或序列层面控制策略失配，却忽略了这种由轨迹引起的偏移，导致训练不稳定，并且随着时程变长最终发生崩溃。为弥合状态分布差距，我们提出轨迹感知策略优化（TAPO），这是一个原则化框架，它从离策略策略梯度理论推导出状态分布校正，并将其纳入强化学习目标。TAPO 还采用几何平均估计器来降低方差，并结合长度感知的动态裁剪，防止沿轨迹出现偏离过大的更新。大量实验表明，TAPO 在八个竞赛级基准上显著优于现有 LLM 强化学习算法；在数学推理和算法编程任务上，相比 GRPO 的提升最高分别达到 48% 和 12%，训练稳定性也大幅增强。

    Jie Huang, Yanan Chen, Ruixun Liu, Kaichen He, Xinyi He, Rui Huang, Zilong Zheng, Zhenliang Zhang, Yiwu Zhong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The benchmark measures whether embodied agents can recombine learned skills to solve unseen tasks and reports findings about continual learning and experience use. Compositional generalization is its explicit evaluation principle, while agent evaluation gives a partial systems connection; it does not investigate internal mechanisms or reasoning processes.

    该基准衡量具身智能体能否重新组合已学技能以解决未见任务，并报告了有关持续学习和经验利用的发现。组合泛化是其明确的评测原则，而智能体评测与系统研究部分相关；本文并未探究内部机制或推理过程。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.

    中文

    持续学习要求模型累积过去的经验，并将其迁移到新任务中。尽管持续学习已得到大量研究，现有工作仍主要局限于非具身场景，尚未扩展到具身环境。为弥补这一空白，我们推出 EmbodiedCLBench，这是首个用于在具身模拟中评测自我进化智能体持续学习能力的基准。我们的基准以组合泛化为核心评测原则，考察智能体能否先从基础任务中学习，再重新组合所掌握的技能来解决复杂且未见过的高级任务。基于 EmbodiedCLBench，我们针对多种智能体运行框架和学习方法开展了大量实验，揭示了持续存在的局限和鲜明的行为差异。结果表明，尽管零样本设置下高级任务几乎难以解决，基础任务中的经验仍能带来持续提升。即便任务复杂度增加，这种经验带来的益处仍保持稳定。然而，这种提升并不会随学习样本数量相应增长，当前智能体也无法从额外经验中提取有意义的信息。总体而言，我们的研究结果凸显了持续学习这一基础但尚未充分探索的能力，而我们的基准则为设计具身环境中的有效自我进化智能体提供了宝贵资源。代码和数据集见 https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage。

    Evo$^2$: Evolving the Evolver through Weight-Harness Co-Evolution

    Evo$^2$：通过权重与运行框架协同进化来进化进化器

    Chejian Xu, Shujian Zhang, Wenxuan Zhou, John Lambert, Beck Chen, Bo Li, Andrew Hard and Rajiv Mathews

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Evo² co-trains model weights and agent harnesses, using execution feedback and a dual-role proposer/reflector pipeline to improve self-evolving coding agents, with transfer across tasks and models. This is a strong Systems contribution through agent organization and harness adaptation; training and feedback connect partially to Reasoning, while the abstract does not establish advances in internal interpretability or compositional generalization.

    Evo² 联合训练模型权重和智能体运行框架，利用执行反馈和双角色提议者／反思者流程来改进自我进化编程智能体，并实现跨任务和跨模型迁移。这是通过智能体组织方式和运行框架适配带来的重要系统贡献；训练和反馈与推理部分相关，但摘要并未证明其推进了内部可解释性或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Self-evolving agents are increasingly used to improve language model systems without human intervention through either weight updates or harness improvements. Existing approaches typically pursue these directions separately: some methods update model weights using self-generated experience, while others rewrite the harness that defines how an agent uses prompts, tools, context, and execution feedback. However, these approaches overlook the relationship between model weights and the agent harness. To connect these processes and ensure effective and smooth agent self-evolving, we propose Evo$^2$, a framework for weight-harness co-evolution. For harness updates, we design a unified dual-role pipeline that a single policy serves as both a Proposer, which writes harness edits, and a Reflector, which diagnoses their effects and guides revision. For weight updates, harness modifications and their execution outcomes guide the training of both the Proposer and the Reflector. We further develop EvoTIDE, a training pipeline that recovers usable trajectories through edit extraction and prefix continuation, then combines SFT with interleaved GRPO across the two roles. Extensive experiments across three coding benchmarks demonstrate that Evo$^2$ significantly outperforms existing self-evolution methods. It achieves 82.1% on Polyglot and 48.3% on SWE-bench Verified, compared with 62.6% and 41.0% for the strongest baseline, respectively. We also show that the evolved harnesses transfer to different tasks without further evolution and rank first in cross-benchmark evaluations. Our dual-role harness improvement framework is also able to extend to self-evolution with proprietary models, improving a GPT-5-mini agent's performance from 24.4% to 48.3%. These results demonstrate the applicability of the framework Evo$^2$ across domains and its broad transferability across models and tasks.

    中文

    人们日益通过更新权重或改进运行框架，在无需人工干预的情况下提升语言模型系统。现有方法通常分别探索这两个方向：有些方法利用自生成经验更新模型权重，另一些方法则重写运行框架，以定义智能体如何使用提示、工具、上下文和执行反馈。然而，这些方法忽略了模型权重与智能体运行框架之间的关系。为连接这两个过程并确保智能体有效、顺畅地自我进化，我们提出 Evo$^2$，这是一个用于权重与运行框架协同进化的框架。对于运行框架更新，我们设计了一个统一的双角色流程，由同一策略同时担任提议者和反思者：提议者负责编写运行框架修改，反思者负责诊断修改的影响并指导修订。对于权重更新，运行框架修改及其执行结果会指导提议者和反思者的训练。我们进一步开发了 EvoTIDE 训练流程，通过编辑提取和前缀续写恢复可用轨迹，然后在两个角色之间交替结合 SFT 与 GRPO。在三个编程基准上的大量实验表明，Evo$^2$显著优于现有自我进化方法。在 Polyglot 和 SWE-bench Verified 上，它分别达到 82.1% 和 48.3%，而最强基线对应的成绩分别为 62.6% 和 41.0%。我们还表明，进化后的运行框架无需进一步进化即可迁移到不同任务，并在跨基准评测中排名第一。我们的双角色运行框架改进框架还可扩展到使用专有模型进行自我进化，使 GPT-5-mini 智能体的性能从 24.4% 提升至 48.3%。这些结果表明，Evo$^2$框架适用于多个领域，并且能够广泛迁移到不同模型和任务。

    GeoGR: Spatial-Semantic Token Compression and Group Routing for Efficient 3D VLMs
