    Yongxin Zheng, Hao Wu, Fang Li, Hu Fu, Peiran Yin, Xudong Wang, Haozhe Hu, Xinghao Chen, Yunpu Ma, Wei Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GeoGR develops spatial-semantic token compression and adaptive group routing to reduce 3D VLM computation while retaining performance, a substantial systems contribution. Its relevance to interpretability is incidental: token relevance guides routing but the abstract does not investigate internal representations or mechanisms.

    GeoGR 提出空间语义词元压缩和自适应分组路由，在保持性能的同时降低 3D VLM 的计算量，是一项重要的系统贡献。它与可解释性的联系只是附带的：词元相关性用于指导路由，但摘要并未探究内部表示或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-view representations enable pretrained image and video vision-language models to understand 3D scenes, but their long visual token sequences make inference costly. Redundancy arises both from repeated observations of the same scene regions across views and from processing all visual tokens at every LLM layer, regardless of their relevance to the current computation. We propose GeoGR, a two-stage framework that jointly compresses scene representations and visual computation. At the projector level, GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens and combines semantic saliency with spatial coverage to construct a compact scene representation. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into contextual anchors to retain scene information that would otherwise be discarded. At the LLM level, we identify an effective visual computation window and observe that query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals. Guided by these findings, GroupRoute combines late entry and early exit with recoverable group-wise skipping. Low-relevance tokens bypass complete LLM layers while retaining their hidden states and can rejoin the active group at subsequent anchor layers selected under a computation budget. For compression-aware post-training, we construct a compact dataset of 67K samples by retaining 30% of the original training pool. With this protocol, GeoGR retains 95.2% and 96.8% of the dense post-trained models' performance on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B, respectively, while accelerating LLM prefill by $6.8\times$ and $6.1\times$. These results demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of GeoGR across 3D VLMs with and without explicit 3D spatial encoding, highlighting a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR.

    中文

    多视图表示使预训练图像和视频视觉语言模型能够理解 3D 场景，但冗长的视觉词元序列使推理成本高昂。冗余既来自不同视图中对相同场景区域的重复观测，也来自在每个 LLM 层处理所有视觉词元，而不考虑它们与当前计算的相关性。我们提出 GeoGR，这是一种联合压缩场景表示和视觉计算的两阶段框架。在投影器层面，GeoSemZip 将跨视图观测整合为 3D 体素词元，并结合语义显著性与空间覆盖度，构建紧凑的场景表示。未选中的体素特征会聚合为上下文锚点，以保留原本会被丢弃的场景信息。在 LLM 层面，我们确定了有效的视觉计算窗口，并观察到经查询条件化的词元相关性在局部保持稳定，但在较长的层间区间内会发生变化。受这些发现的启发，GroupRoute 将延迟进入和提前退出与可恢复的分组跳过相结合。相关性较低的词元会跳过完整的 LLM 层，同时保留其隐藏状态，并可在按计算预算选定的后续锚点层重新加入活跃组。对于压缩感知的后训练，我们构建了一个紧凑数据集：从原始训练池中保留 30%，共 67K 个样本。采用该流程后，GeoGR 在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 和 Video-3D LLM-7B 上分别保留了稠密后训练模型性能的 95.2% 和 96.8%，同时使 LLM 预填充加速 $6.8\times$ 倍和 $6.1\times$ 倍。这些结果表明，无论 3D VLM 是否采用显式 3D 空间编码，GeoGR 都持续有效，并体现出良好的性能与效率权衡。代码见 https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR。

    RAMP: Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision for Efficient Prefill in Recurrent-Depth Language Models

    RAMP：用于递归深度语言模型高效预填充的递归自适应混合精度

    Ke Wan and Chen Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes how quantization errors propagate through recurrent refinement and uses that finding to schedule mixed precision for faster prefill. This offers partial insight into latent iterative reasoning and strong algorithmic advances in computation allocation, but does not study internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文分析了量化误差如何在递归优化中传播，并据此安排混合精度计算，以加快预填充。这为潜在的迭代式推理提供了部分洞见，并在计算分配方面取得了显著的算法进展，但未研究内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recurrent-depth language models improve inference-time reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared network to refine internal representations, but the additional recurrent computation also increases inference cost. This overhead is particularly pronounced during long-context prefill, where the full input sequence is repeatedly processed across recurrent depth. Weight-and-activation quantization offers a natural way to accelerate this computation through lower-precision arithmetic, yet repeatedly applying quantized computation introduces numerical perturbations that accumulate along the recurrent trajectory. We systematically analyze how such errors propagate across recurrent depth and show that quantization errors introduced earlier are attenuated by more subsequent recurrent steps and therefore have a smaller effect on the final representation. Matched-budget experiments strongly support this prediction, showing that placing quantized computation earlier in recurrent depth consistently yields the best fidelity. Based on this insight, we introduce RAMP (Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision), which performs early recurrent refinement using low-precision weight-and-activation computation and restores high precision for terminal refinement. Across context lengths up to 4K, RAMP preserves near-full-precision prefill quality while achieving up to 1.16x end-to-end first-prefill speedup on an NVIDIA H100, corresponding to a 13.9% latency reduction.

    中文

    递归深度语言模型通过反复应用共享网络来优化内部表示，从而提升推理时的推理能力，但额外的递归计算也增加了推理成本。在长上下文预填充期间，这种开销尤为显著，因为整个输入序列会沿递归深度被反复处理。权重和激活量化通过采用低精度算术，为加速这类计算提供了自然的方法；然而，反复执行量化计算会引入数值扰动，并使其沿递归轨迹累积。我们系统地分析了这类误差如何沿递归深度传播，并表明，较早引入的量化误差会被更多后续递归步骤削弱，因此对最终表示的影响较小。等预算实验有力地支持了这一预测，表明在递归深度较早阶段进行量化计算，始终能获得最佳保真度。基于这一发现，我们提出 RAMP（递归自适应混合精度），在早期递归优化阶段使用低精度权重和激活计算，并在最终优化阶段恢复高精度。在最长达 4K 的上下文长度下，RAMP 保持了接近全精度的预填充质量，同时在 NVIDIA H100 上将端到端首次预填充速度最高提升至 1.16 倍，对应延迟降低 13.9%。

    CoBe: A Benchmark For Conversational Counterfactual Text Editing

    CoBe：对话式反事实文本编辑基准

    Arvind Raghavan, Inwoo Hwang, Shreyas Havaldar, Kai-Zhan Lee, Aurghya Maiti, Yushu Pan, Jeffrey Wu, Mingxuan Li, Elias Bareinboim

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CoBe benchmarks whether models preserve causal structure when editing scenarios under hypothetical changes, and finds frequent reliance on association instead. This directly evaluates counterfactual reasoning, but offers limited insight into internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    CoBe 评测模型在假设变化下编辑情境时能否保留其因果结构，并发现模型经常依赖关联式生成。该基准直接评测反事实推理，但对内部机制或组合泛化的洞见有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Counterfactual text editing is the ability to revise a given text in light of a hypothetical change while preserving facts not causally affected by that change. When asked what would have happened if a doctor had not recommended surgery, the model output should retain the patient's medical history and modify only the consequences of the decision. This requires causal understanding: a model must determine, without being explicitly instructed to, what events are affected by the hypothetical change and what should remain fixed. This skill is central to human reasoning, especially in safety-critical domains like healthcare or law. By contrast, the task of associational text generation merely generates text statistically associated with the altered condition. In the medical example, an associational response might make the patient's symptoms less severe because milder cases correlate with no surgery. Such responses produce a plausible scenario, but not the counterfactual version of the given one. Prior counterfactual-text datasets do not clearly separate these modes of reasoning. We introduce the Counterfactual Benchmark (CoBe), a testbed for models' zero-shot ability to counterfactually edit a given textual scenario when prompted to do so in a conversationally natural way. CoBe contains 2000 questions spanning healthcare, science and engineering, business, and everyday scenarios. We test a suite of frontier and smaller models, with frontier systems achieving an average score of $58.05\%$. Our findings indicate that models frequently default to associational generation rather than preserving the causal structure of the original scenario. Moreover, performance does not scale consistently with either model size or output token length, suggesting that the failure may reflect model training objectives rather than insufficient model capacity.

    中文

    反事实文本编辑是指根据假设的变化修订给定文本，同时保留未受该变化因果影响的事实。例如，当被问及“如果医生没有建议手术，会发生什么”时，模型输出应保留患者的病史，只修改该决定所带来的后果。这需要因果理解：模型必须在没有明确指示的情况下，判断哪些事件会受假设变化影响，以及哪些内容应保持不变。这项技能是人类推理的核心，尤其适用于医疗或法律等安全攸关领域。与此相对，关联式文本生成任务只是生成在统计上与变化后条件相关的文本。在上述医疗示例中，关联式回答可能会认为患者的症状较轻，因为较轻的病例与不做手术相关。这样的回答能构造出一个合理的情境，却不是给定情境的反事实版本。以往的反事实文本数据集未能清楚地区分这两种推理方式。我们推出反事实基准（CoBe），用于测试模型在以自然对话方式提示时，零样本地对给定文本情境进行反事实编辑的能力。CoBe 包含 2000 个问题，涵盖医疗保健、科学与工程、商业及日常情境。我们测试了一组前沿模型和较小模型，前沿系统的平均得分为 $58.05\%$。研究结果表明，模型经常默认采用关联式生成，而不是保留原情境的因果结构。此外，性能与模型规模或输出词元长度都不存在一致的正相关，这表明该缺陷可能反映了模型训练目标，而非模型容量不足。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    KV-cache reuse in large language model serving is commonly limited to exact prompt prefixes, preventing reuse when the same retrieved document appears after different system prompts, conversation histories, or dynamic metadata. We present KV-Repurpose, an open-source, vLLM-based system for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes. The system combines cache-aware segment scheduling, prompt construction, capacity management, workload generation, and runtime monitoring. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that naive segment reuse largely preserves output quality for single-document question answering and summarization, while exposing clear limitations in cross-document reasoning. Under a Zipfian RAG-style workload in which 20% of requests share a fixed prefix, KV-Repurpose achieves a substantially higher token-level cache hit rate than prefix caching at the same 30 GB cache capacity, 63.9% versus 3.3%, resulting in lower TTFT. Even with 1 TB of cache capacity, prefix caching reaches only a 17.9% hit rate in this workload. Source code is available under the Apache-2.0 license at https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose.

    大型语言模型服务中的 KV 缓存复用通常仅限于完全相同的提示前缀，因此当同一检索文档出现在不同系统提示、对话历史或动态元数据之后时，无法复用缓存。我们推出 KV-Repurpose，这是一个基于 vLLM 的开源系统，用于开发和评测超越精确前缀的分段式 KV 缓存复用。该系统结合了缓存感知的分段调度、提示构建、容量管理、工作负载生成和运行时监控。在长上下文基准上的实验表明，对于单文档问答和摘要任务，朴素的分段复用基本能够保持输出质量，同时也揭示了其在跨文档推理方面的明显局限。在一种 Zipf 分布的 RAG 式工作负载中，20% 的请求共享固定前缀；在相同的 30 GB 缓存容量下，KV-Repurpose 的词元级缓存命中率远高于前缀缓存，分别为 63.9% 和 3.3%，从而降低了 TTFT。即使缓存容量达到 1 TB，在该工作负载下，前缀缓存的命中率也仅为 17.9%。源代码基于 Apache-2.0 许可证发布，见 https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper adaptively selects agent workflows using contextual bandits, reducing feedback costs while improving benchmark performance.     本文使用上下文老虎机自适应地选择智能体工作流，在提升基准性能的同时降低反馈成本。这是一项重要的智能体系统贡献；MATH 上的结果证明了任务性能，但摘要未提出推理机制或能力发展方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tackling complex tasks through agentic workflows. However, manually designing these workflows is labor-intensive and lacks flexibility to adapt to diverse queries. While automated workflow optimization is a promising direction, existing methods often incur expensive API costs during training-phase feedback collection. Furthermore, they fail to adaptively reuse high-quality workflows, which creates a bottleneck for both performance and cost-effectiveness. To address these limitations, we propose CB-Orchestrator, an adaptive framework that decouples workflow generation from selection. In the first stage, we construct a diverse pool of candidate workflows via evolutionary search. In the second stage, we formulate workflow selection as a Contextual Bandit problem, which enables sample-efficient learning by balancing exploration and exploitation, thereby significantly reducing the feedback required for training. During inference, the model adaptively selects the optimal workflow tailored to each query. Evaluations across five diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CB-Orchestrator consistently outperforms all baselines. Notably, on the MATH dataset, CB-Orchestrator achieves better performance than strong recent baselines while reducing training-phase API token overhead by no less than 40.55% and total end-to-end training (including workflow pool generation) token overhead by no less than 29.73%.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体通过智能体工作流，已展现出处理复杂任务的卓越能力。然而，手动设计这些工作流既费时费力，也缺乏适应不同查询的灵活性。尽管自动化工作流优化前景广阔，现有方法在训练阶段收集反馈时往往产生高昂的 API 成本。此外，它们无法自适应地复用高质量工作流，成为性能和成本效益提升的瓶颈。为解决这些局限，我们提出 CB-Orchestrator，这是一个将工作流生成与选择分离的自适应框架。第一阶段通过进化搜索构建多样化的候选工作流集合。第二阶段将工作流选择建模为上下文老虎机问题，通过平衡探索与利用实现样本高效学习，从而大幅减少训练所需的反馈。推理期间，模型会针对每个查询自适应地选择最优工作流。在五个不同基准上的评测表明，CB-Orchestrator 始终优于所有基线。值得注意的是，在 MATH 数据集上，CB-Orchestrator 的性能超过了强劲的近期基线，同时将训练阶段的 API 词元开销至少降低 40.55%，并将端到端训练（包括工作流池生成）的总词元开销至少降低 29.73%。

    Double-Take: Improving Capacity, Binding, and Selectivity In Long-Context Within Bidirectional Memory

    Double-Take：提升双向记忆中的长上下文容量、绑定能力和选择性

    Vakul Raghavan, Utkarsh Grover, Mingyang Mao, Chengwen Wang, Xiaomin Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The work identifies distinct failures in fixed-size test-time memory and introduces multi-step, cross-position, and selective updates that improve long-context recall and transfer. This offers a substantial algorithmic contribution to memory systems; its binding mechanism is only an incidental connection to compositional generalization, with no focus on reasoning or internal model representations.

    这项工作指出固定大小测试时记忆中的不同失效，并引入多步、跨位置和选择性更新，以提升长上下文召回和迁移能力。这为记忆系统带来了重要的算法贡献；其绑定机制与组合泛化只有附带关联，研究重点并非推理或模型内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Processing a long sequence does not guarantee that distant information remains usable. As context grows, a fixed-size memory must retain many associations, connect information across positions, and preserve relevant structure without being overwhelmed by everything it observes. These are distinct requirements: a memory may store more information without representing the relationships needed for retrieval, and it may transport those relationships without preserving the ones that matter. Thus, the challenge is not simply extending context length, but constructing a memory that remains usable as context grows. We study this problem in large-chunk test-time training (TTT) and identify two basic failures: single-step writes accumulate interference, limiting capacity, while self-associative writes cannot form cross-position bindings. We introduce Double-Take (DT), which repairs these failures with multi-step unpinned updates and cross-position mixing, and adds bidirectional change-sensitive writes for selective retention. Capacity alone leaves end-to-end recall at the $0.10$ chance floor; adding binding raises it to $0.92$. Trained only on $32\,\mathrm{kb}$ genomic contexts, DT reaches $0.927$ AUROC at $131\,\mathrm{kb}$ and $0.856$ near $1\,\mathrm{Mb}$, while transferring zero-shot from human to mouse. Together, these results identify capacity, binding, and selectivity as three requirements for usable long-range memory.

    中文

    处理长序列并不意味着远处的信息仍然可用。随着上下文增长，固定大小的记忆必须保留大量关联、连接不同位置的信息，并维持相关结构，同时避免被观察到的一切内容淹没。这些是彼此不同的要求：记忆可以存储更多信息，却不表示检索所需的关系；也可以传递这些关系，却不保留其中真正重要的部分。因此，挑战并非只是延长上下文长度，而是构建一种能随着上下文增长仍保持可用的记忆。我们在大块测试时训练（TTT）中研究这一问题，并发现两种基本失效：单步写入会累积干扰，从而限制容量；而自关联写入无法形成跨位置绑定。我们提出 Double-Take（DT），通过多步无固定锚点更新和跨位置混合来修复这些失效，并加入双向、对变化敏感的写入以实现选择性保留。仅有容量时，端到端召回仍处于$0.10$随机猜测下限；加入绑定后则提升至$0.92$。DT 仅在$32\,\mathrm{kb}$基因组上下文上训练，便在$0.927$处达到$131\,\mathrm{kb}$AUROC，在$0.856$处则接近$1\,\mathrm{Mb}$，同时能够从人类零样本迁移到小鼠。这些结果共同表明，容量、绑定和选择性是实现可用长程记忆的三项要求。

    LongHarness: Advancing Agentic Reasoning over 100M-Token Corpora via Stateful Evidence Management

    LongHarness：通过有状态证据管理推进对 1 亿 token 语料的智能体推理

    Songtao Huang, Zhijie Zhong, Xiaohan He, Shuaiyu Zhang, Zhiyin Yu, Li Kang, Heng Zhou, Yutao Fan, Xiangchao Yan, Bo Zhang, Shiyang Feng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LongHarness explicitly manages evidence and evolving conclusions to guide retrieval and prevent state drift, with strong gains on corpus-level question answering. This is a substantial agent-system contribution and partly advances reasoning through evidence integration, but the abstract does not establish new internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    LongHarness 显式管理证据和不断演变的结论，以引导检索并防止状态漂移，在语料级问答任务上取得显著提升。这是一项重要的智能体系统贡献，并通过证据整合在一定程度上推进了推理；但摘要并未证明其提出了新的内部机制或组合泛化能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Corpus-level long-context reasoning requires agents to acquire and integrate evidence across document collections that exceed their context windows. Existing agent harnesses enable incremental access to these corpora, but acquired evidence and evolving conclusions often remain entangled in a growing interaction history. This implicit state management can lead to two coupled failure modes: unbounded exploration, where retrieval expands the interaction history without resolving decision-relevant information gaps, and evidence-state drift, where previously acquired evidence or subsequent corrections fail to inform the current conclusion. We present LongHarness, a model-agnostic harness that makes the interaction between acquired evidence and evolving conclusions explicit. Its core mechanism, Evidence-Conclusion Coevolution, uses unresolved conclusions to guide exploration toward missing information, while newly acquired evidence strengthens or revises the conclusions that directed the search. LongHarness couples this process with Evidence Lifecycle Management, which keeps accumulated evidence current and traceable throughout the interaction. Together, these mechanisms focus retrieval on remaining information needs and keep conclusions aligned with current evidence. We evaluate LongHarness on OfficeQA Pro V1 and V2, AA-LCR, and LongBench v2 using GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash. Compared with direct reasoning using the same backbone, LongHarness improves GLM-5.3-Flash exact match on OfficeQA Pro from 15.8% to 60.2% on V1 and from 4.4% to 61.1% on V2. Against state-of-the-art agent harnesses, it surpasses Claude Code by 12.0 percentage points on V1 and Codex by 18.9 points on V2. With Qwen3.8-Flash, LongHarness reaches 61.7% on V1, outperforming Claude Code by 8.3 points and Codex by 12.0 points.

    语料级长上下文推理要求智能体在超出其上下文窗口的文档集合中获取并整合证据。现有智能体框架支持逐步访问这些语料，但已获取的证据和不断演变的结论往往仍纠缠在不断增长的交互历史中。这种隐式状态管理可能导致两种相互关联的失效模式：无界探索，即检索不断扩展交互历史，却没有解决与决策相关的信息缺口；以及证据状态漂移，即先前获取的证据或后续修正未能影响当前结论。我们提出 LongHarness，这是一种与模型无关的框架，显式呈现已获取证据与不断演变结论之间的交互。其核心机制“证据—结论协同演化”利用尚未解决的结论引导探索缺失信息，同时利用新获取的证据强化或修订那些引导搜索的结论。LongHarness 将这一过程与“证据生命周期管理”结合起来，使累积的证据在整个交互过程中保持最新且可追溯。这些机制共同使检索聚焦于尚未满足的信息需求，并让结论与当前证据保持一致。我们使用 GLM-5.3-Flash 和 Qwen3.8-Flash，在 OfficeQA Pro V1 和 V2、AA-LCR 以及 LongBench v2 上评估 LongHarness。与使用同一骨干模型直接推理相比，LongHarness 将 GLM-5.3-Flash 在 OfficeQA Pro V1 上的精确匹配率从 15.8% 提升至 60.2%，在 V2 上从 4.4% 提升至 61.1%。与最先进的智能体框架相比，它在 V1 上比 Claude Code 高 12.0 个百分点，在 V2 上比 Codex 高 18.9 个百分点。使用 Qwen3.8-Flash 时，LongHarness 在 V1 上达到 61.7%，比 Claude Code 高 8.3 个百分点，比 Codex 高 12.0 个百分点。

    Can Failed Trajectories Reveal Where Agents Go Wrong? Agentic Failure Attribution Without Step-Level Labels

    Do Nguyen-Thanh, Junlin Fang, Bing Li, Zhen Fang, Sean Du

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SOAP uses model representations and attention patterns to trace downstream failure signals toward decisive upstream steps, offering a transferable mechanism for agent failure attribution. Its agent-debugging context is relevant to systems, but the abstract does not describe a broader agent architecture or task-execution contribution.

    SOAP 利用模型表征和注意力模式，将下游失败信号追溯至关键的上游步骤，为智能体失败归因提供了一种可迁移的机制。其智能体调试背景与系统研究相关，但摘要并未描述更广泛的智能体架构或任务执行方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Failure attribution for LLM agents aims to identify decisive steps responsible for task failure, which is critical for debugging and improving agentic systems. Existing methods rely on costly LLM prompting, step-level error annotations, or verified successful trajectories that lack failure signals for assistance. In this paper, we study failure attribution from step-unlabeled failure trajectories, where each trajectory is known to have failed but its decisive step is unknown. We propose SOAP (Spectral scOring with Attention-guided Propagation), an effective framework requiring neither step-level training labels nor a separate success-only reference set. SOAP first constructs a spectral reference space from LLM representations and assigns each step a base error score according to its projection behavior. Importantly, later steps may exhibit stronger failure signals because they inherit an earlier mistake, causing independent scorers to favor downstream consequences over the decisive error. To address this downstream contamination, SOAP derives soft step dependencies from attention patterns and propagates downstream error evidence toward its likely upstream sources. Extensive experiments show that SOAP consistently improves attribution performance over competitive baselines.

    Biological function in RNA is encoded across scales, from local sequence motifs to long-range structural dependencies. Conventional RNA foundation models couple parameter capacity and inference depth within a fixed architecture, prescribing a fixed computation graph for each inference. Here we present Eco-RNA, an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model that makes inference depth adjustable through learned iterative refinement. Its shared, input-conditioned Transformer core refines sequence representations through repeated application. The iteration count is selected after training and controls effective depth at fixed model parameters. We train across recurrent depths with masked reconstruction, state regularization, and a one-sided loss that anchors deeper reconstruction to a shallow reference. On the 70-assay RNAGym fitness benchmark, increasing refinement from one to four iterations raises aggregate absolute Spearman correlation from 0.242 to 0.286, with the gain retained through eight iterations. At four iterations, Eco-RNA surpasses the current SOTA Evo 2 40B on all three aggregate fitness metrics despite 500x fewer parameters. Its iteration configurations advance the compute-performance Pareto frontier among the evaluated models. It also outperforms the evaluated baselines in non-coding RNA family classification, RNA secondary-structure prediction, and chemical probing profile prediction. These results establish internal inference computation as an effective scaling dimension for RNA foundation models.

    LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing complex reasoning through role specialization and collaboration, yet a key challenge remains: how can collaboration be adapted to a backbone's competence on the current query? This problem matters because more collaboration is not always better--richer coordination may help on difficult cases, but it also incurs additional token cost and redundant interactions. We propose a two-stage competence-aware framework for automatic MAS orchestration. It first models the LLM backbone's task-conditioned competence for the current query, and then uses this signal to adapt role activation and the communication graph. Experiments with six LLM backbones of varying competence levels further show that our method adjusts collaboration according to the inferred competence: for higher-competence backbones, it improves average accuracy from 87.22 to 89.97 while reducing token cost by 36.26%; for lower-competence backbones, it yields a further average gain of 4.58 points over existing methods.     ENGLISH

    Open coding agents are commonly trained through supervised fine-tuning on interaction trajectories whose final patches pass the benchmark test suite. However, this outcome-level filtering criterion ignores process quality: trajectories that eventually succeed may still contain inefficient interaction patterns such as repetitive file inspection, unstable tool usage, or delayed modification behavior, all of which become part of the imitation target. We propose TQS (Trajectory Quality Score), a structural scoring framework for coding-agent trajectories that operates directly on trajectory structure, requires no LLM judge, and runs in linear time. TQS characterizes trajectory quality through structural signals organized around structured convergence: information focus, intent--action alignment, and policy dynamics. Using 155,144 successful trajectories from a public open-license corpus, we rank trajectories by TQS and fine-tune coding agents on filtered subsets. Models trained on top-ranked trajectories consistently outperform those trained on random or bottom-ranked subsets on SWE-Bench-Verified. Our results suggest that process-level trajectory quality is an important factor in coding-agent supervision and that structural trajectory filtering provides an effective and scalable alternative to LLM-based data selection.

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents often suffers from evidence fabrication, a failure mode where agents bypass external information ($E_{ext}$) and fabricate an incorrect answer. We argue that this fabrication arises from an over-reliance on unreliable internal knowledge ($E_{int}$) as shortcuts due to the inherent opacity of reasoning trajectories. To address this, we propose SOAR (SOurce-Aware Reinforcement learning), a paradigm that transforms monolithic reasoning into source-explicit trajectories. SOAR (i) disentangles $E_{ext}$ and $E_{int}$ into parallel, observable streams via a Source-Aware Workflow, and (ii) incorporates Source-Consistent Reward to guide the policy evolution. By making information-source attribution explicit, SOAR enables precise credit assignment between different knowledge streams. Evaluations show that SOAR outperforms baselines on 3B and 7B backbones by 7.3% and 5.4%, while reducing evidence fabrication by 74.8%.     ENGLISH

    Terminal agents are moving beyond local operations toward completing real-world professional tasks. Short trajectories can demonstrate commands and tool calls, but they do not fully show how agents accumulate evidence through exploration, use it to inform judgments, continually adjust strategies based on feedback, and turn intermediate results into final deliverables. High-quality long-horizon trajectories capture these agentic behavioral patterns and their connections within a single problem-solving process, providing richer experience for sustained autonomous work. However, environment synthesis may complete or simplify the key work underlying these patterns in advance and thus remove the need for exploration, implementation, and verification that the agent was meant to perform. To address this, we introduce TerminalHorizon, a fully automated data synthesis engine for long-horizon terminal agents. Starting from real-world professional work, it uses independent execution to identify key work omitted during construction and uses the resulting evidence to guide environment reconstruction. To extend these patterns across stages, it progressively expands tasks under the same goal, introducing new requirements that build on prior results and call for further exploration and improvement. Using this engine, we construct 1.5K task environments and perform supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on the resulting dataset to obtain TerminalHorizon-27B. We achieve substantial performance gains on all 12 benchmarks spanning coding-agent tasks, agentic tasks in real-world production settings, and general reasoning. Multiple RSI case studies, each with a 12-hour research budget, further demonstrate the model's ability to continue experimenting beyond an initial solution, improve its methods based on feedback, and retain effective improvements in its final deliverables.

    PreSTO: Predictive Subtree Prefetching for Fast LLM Power Sampling

    PreSTO：通过预测性子树预取加速 LLM Power Sampling

    Nan Jiang, Panagiotis Theodoropoulos, Wei Deng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PreSTO batches prefetched proposals to accelerate PowerMH while preserving its transition kernel, with experiments showing substantial speedups. Its tree traversal is incidental to composition, and the abstract offers no insight into model internals.

    PreSTO 通过批量预取提议来加速 PowerMH，同时保持其转移核不变，实验显示其带来了显著加速。树遍历与组合性的关系只是附带的，摘要也没有提供关于模型内部机制的见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Power sampling improves large language model (LLM) reasoning at test time by sampling from a sharpened version of the base model's distribution. Its sampler, PowerMH, is slow because its Metropolis--Hastings (MH) updates are sequential: each accept/reject decision sets the state from which the next proposal is generated. Prior work reduces this cost by changing the sampler or the model (e.g., sequential Monte Carlo, approximate lookahead, distillation). We propose Predictive SubTree Prefetching (PreSTO), which accelerates PowerMH by prefetching future proposals and provably leaves its MH transition kernel unchanged. PreSTO views future MH outcomes as a tree of accept/reject decisions: in each model call, it generates the proposals of a \textit{prefetched subtree} of this tree in one batch, then follows the realized path with the original MH acceptance rule. We also observe that MH reaches only a sparse, nearly unary part of each prefetched subtree, we further design a \textit{predictive traversal rule} that chooses the subtree to maximize the predicted number of completed transitions. Across seven datasets and five base LLMs, PreSTO achieves median speedups of $1.71\times$, $1.91\times$, and $2.33\times$ on PowerMH and its follow-ups EntropyCut and MultiTryMH, respectively; on the first two, it makes a median of $3.9\times$ fewer model calls, each only $2.1\times$ longer. On LCB V6 with Qwen3.5-9B, the predictive traversal rule is a further $1.25\times$--$1.37\times$ faster than the default breadth-first traversal.

    Power sampling 通过从基础模型分布的锐化版本中采样，提升大语言模型（LLM）在测试时的推理能力。其采样器 PowerMH 速度较慢，因为其 Metropolis--Hastings（MH）更新是顺序执行的：每次接受/拒绝决策都会设定状态，后续提议由该状态生成。先前工作通过改变采样器或模型来降低这一开销（例如序贯蒙特卡洛、近似前瞻、蒸馏）。我们提出预测性子树预取（PreSTO），通过预取未来提议来加速 PowerMH，并且可证明不会改变其 MH 转移核。PreSTO 将未来的 MH 结果视为由接受/拒绝决策构成的树：每次模型调用中，它以一次批处理生成该树中一个\textit{预取子树}的提议，然后按照原始 MH 接受规则沿实际实现的路径前进。我们还观察到，MH 在每个预取子树中只会到达稀疏且近乎单分支的部分，因此进一步设计了\textit{预测性遍历规则}，用于选择可最大化预测已完成转移次数的子树。在七个数据集和五个基础 LLM 上，PreSTO 在 PowerMH 及其后续方法 EntropyCut 和 MultiTryMH 上分别实现了中位加速比$1.71\times$、$1.91\times$和$2.33\times$；在前两种方法上，模型调用的中位数减少了$3.9\times$，且每次调用仅增加$2.1\times$的耗时。在 LCB V6 上使用 Qwen3.5-9B 时，预测性遍历规则相比默认的广度优先遍历进一步加速了$1.25\times$--$1.37\times$。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RoleWorld uses reusable functional roles and transition rules to transfer world-model knowledge across environments, with interaction refining role assignments and parameters.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    World models enable large language model (LLM) agents to anticipate action effects and make informed decisions. For generalization, it is desirable for such world models to transfer efficiently to new environments with similar interaction structure and underlying dynamics. Recent approaches encode world dynamics as symbolic rules or executable programs, whose compositional structure in principle affords transfer, but still organize such knowledge around environment-specific objects. To address this limitation, we introduce RoleWorld, a symbolic world modeling approach which uses reusable prototypes and environment-specific parameter values as functional role abstractions to represent how objects behave in interactions. From interaction trajectories, a teacher LLM extracts role prototypes and executable transition rules defined over role instances, together with a skill that guides the actor LLM to use role information in decision making. In a target world, without the teacher, the actor uses this skill together with its current role assignments and parameter estimates, and actively tests a role instance hypothesis through interaction when its uncertainty affects the current decision. Feedback from each action refines role assignments and estimates parameter values online, with no LLM parameter updates and the transition rules held fixed. Experiments on MARS benchmark show that RoleWorld enables robust generalization across environments with significantly altered object behavior, suggesting that functional role abstractions can serve as an effective component for knowledge transfer in world modeling.     ENGLISH

    While reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models, its efficacy in long-horizon multimodal tasks remains underexplored. Visual Sudoku puzzles pose a representative challenge, requiring multi-step deductive reasoning over both local constraints and global dependency chains. To this end, we introduce FG-Sudoku, a fine-grained benchmark categorized by grid size and required deductive steps. Evaluations reveal that frontier MLLMs fail on complex long-range dependencies (e.g., 9*9 puzzles). During post-training, this near-zero success rate causes severe reward sparsity, halting standard RLVR. We propose Adaptive Curriculum Group Relative Policy Optimization (AdaC-GRPO) to overcome this. Unlike rigid or prior-based schedules, AdaC-GRPO dynamically constructs training batches by tracking the model's "Zone of Proximal Development" via online rollout accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that AdaC-GRPO enables Qwen2.5-VL-7B to approach the performance of Gemini-2.5-Flash while bridging 62.2% of the overall accuracy gap to Gemini-2.5-Pro, with its generalizability further validated across InternVL-3.5 and Qwen3-VL.

    JANUS: Enhancing Long-Horizon Autonomous Research with Co-Evolving World Models

    JANUS：通过共同演化的世界模型增强长时程自主研究

    Mengdi Liu, Chenghao Jia, Hong Chang, Mingjie He, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    JANUS uses a co-evolving world model to forecast candidate outcomes, guide exploration, and distill skills for long-horizon autonomous research. This substantially advances agent planning and adaptation, with some compositional relevance from hierarchical skills and coordination protocols, but the abstract does not directly study internal representations or their mechanisms.

    JANUS 利用共同演化的世界模型预测候选结果、引导探索，并为长时程自主研究提炼技能。这项工作显著推进了智能体规划和适应能力；分层技能和协调协议也与组合性有一定关联，但摘要未直接研究内部表征或其机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon autonomous research has shown promise in accelerating scientific progress through sustained cycles of hypothesis generation, implementation, and validation. However, this Generate-Execute-Feedback paradigm relies on reactive trial-and-error, where costly and time-consuming executions introduce severe feedback delays, throttling evolutionary progress under explosively expanding search space. To address this challenge, we propose JANUS, a framework that unifies future outcomes forecasting and past experience reflection through a Predict-Verify-Evolve loop driven by a co-evolving world model. Within an evolving graph, the research agent proposes candidates while world model scores them by forecasting value improvement, information gain, and exploration utility, then accordingly selects, refines, or prunes branches prior to execution. After receiving ground-truth feedback, JANUS distills experience into evolving skills: hierarchical skills for research agent, exploration-strategy skills for world model, and their coordination protocols. This mechanism enables continual co-evolution: the research agent sharpens candidate generation while the world model refines its predictive judgment over extended horizons. Extensive evaluations on MLS-Bench-Lite and real research tasks demonstrate that JANUS significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving both higher evolving efficiency and ceiling.

    长时程自主研究有望通过持续进行假设生成、实施和验证的循环来加速科学进展。然而，这种“生成—执行—反馈”范式依赖反应式试错；代价高昂且耗时的执行会造成严重的反馈延迟，在搜索空间迅速扩大的情况下抑制演进进程。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 JANUS，这是一个由共同演化世界模型驱动的框架，通过“预测—验证—演化”循环统一对未来结果的预测和对过去经验的反思。在不断演化的图中，研究智能体提出候选方案，而世界模型通过预测价值提升、信息增益和探索效用来为候选方案评分，随后据此在执行前选择、优化或剪枝分支。收到真实反馈后，JANUS 将经验提炼为不断演化的技能：供研究智能体使用的分层技能、供世界模型使用的探索策略技能，以及二者的协调协议。这一机制实现了持续共同演化：研究智能体不断改进候选方案生成，而世界模型则在更长时程中完善其预测判断。在 MLS-Bench-Lite 和真实研究任务上的广泛评估表明，JANUS 显著优于最先进的基线，在演化效率和性能上限方面均取得更好的结果。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning (RL) under partial observability typically re- lies on recurrent networks to encode temporal information, with the recurrent module trained jointly with the policy or value function. This raises a natural question: is learning the recurrent network actually necessary? In this paper, we investigate whether a frozen recurrent network can provide sufficient memory for solving par- tially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). Motivated by the theoretical foundations of Reservoir Computing (RC) and Generalized Reservoir Computing (GRC), we study a simple archi- tecture that combines a fixed recurrent network with a trainable nonlinear output module. We evaluate this approach across tasks with varying memory demands, observation modalities, and action spaces. Surprisingly, frozen recurrent networks support recall over hundreds of steps and achieve competitive control performance across diverse POMDPs, while using less than half the number of trainable parameters required by their fully trainable counterparts. These results suggest that learning the recurrent memory module is not always necessary for solving POMDPs. Frozen recurrent networks therefore provide a simple, parameter-efficient, and sur- prisingly strong baseline for partially observable RL. Our source code is available at https://github.com/Aphlios/FRN-POMDP

    ENGLISH

    Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization. In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. Drafting and verification share the same policy parameter, eliminating the need to train or update a separate drafter. The resulting response groups follow the dense-policy distribution. Under S$^3$R, we characterize speedup conditions and the costs of drafting and verification. We found that dense verification still requires the complete historical KV cache. A KV-aware scheduler therefore limits KV-cache repeated offloading and restoration while maintaining rollout parallelism. % OR thrashing In a matched ablation with an aggressive sparse drafting budget, S$^3$R maintains stable training while direct sparse sampling with training-side correction becomes unstable. On long-context mathematical reasoning, S$^3$R achieves $1.39\times~1.35\times$ the end-to-end training throughput of autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3 model, with comparable task performance.

    Rong Wu, Daocheng Fu, Yu Yang, Xuemeng Yang, Siqi Li, Shu Zou, Yao Zhu, Botian Shi, Bo Zhang, Cong Zhang, Pinlong Cai, Jianbiao Mei

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper frames relative policy differences as implicit rewards for on-policy optimization and empirically identifies when such supervision transfers between models, advancing training methods for policy improvement. Its analysis of policy differences does not examine internal representations or mechanisms, and transfer across models alone provides only an incidental connection to composition or systems.

    本文将相对策略差异表述为在线策略优化的隐式奖励，并通过实证确定这类监督在模型间迁移的条件，从而推进策略改进的训练方法。其对策略差异的分析并未考察内部表征或机制，而模型间迁移与组合性或系统的联系也只是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a target policy on its own rollouts using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, but typically relies on the teacher being substantially more capable than the target. Recent work relaxes this requirement by transferring the relative policy difference between an expert and a reference policy rather than the expert's absolute distribution. Yet it remains unclear which differences provide useful supervision and which targets can benefit from them. We develop a unified view in which the log-probability ratio between a proxy expert and a proxy reference defines an implicit reward for KL-regularized policy optimization. This formulation induces an on-policy update for the target, recovers conventional OPD as a special case, and enables any-to-any transfer across models that differ in scale, training stage or generation. Our systematic experiments yield three findings. First, a stronger expert is not necessarily a better source of supervision: differences induced by task-specific training, including reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning, transfer consistently, whereas those arising from model scale alone transfer weakly or not at all. Second, the expert and reference serve complementary roles: the expert provides the capability to be transferred, while the reference filters out shared behavior and isolates the relevant residual. Third, even a useful difference does not transfer to every target: success requires the induced update to move the target toward the expert and generalize beyond sampled rollouts. Raw policy distance does not predict transferability, whereas an appropriate reference can rescue otherwise unsuccessful transfer. These results characterize when relative policy differences provide effective supervision for OPD.

    中文

    在线策略蒸馏（OPD）使用更强教师模型提供的 token 级监督，在目标策略自身生成的 rollout 上对其进行训练，但通常要求教师模型的能力显著强于目标模型。近期研究通过迁移专家策略与参考策略之间的相对策略差异，而非专家策略的绝对分布，放宽了这一要求。然而，目前仍不清楚哪些差异能提供有效监督，以及哪些目标模型能从中受益。我们提出一种统一视角：代理专家与代理参考策略之间的对数概率比，定义了用于 KL 正则化策略优化的隐式奖励。该表述导出针对目标模型的在线策略更新，将传统 OPD 作为一个特例纳入其中，并实现了在规模、训练阶段或生成方式不同的模型之间进行任意方向的迁移。系统实验得出三项发现。第一，更强的专家不一定是更好的监督来源：由包括强化学习和监督微调在内的特定任务训练所产生的差异能够稳定迁移，而仅由模型规模造成的差异迁移效果较弱或完全无法迁移。第二，专家和参考策略发挥互补作用：专家提供待迁移的能力，而参考策略则过滤掉共享行为并分离出相关残差。第三，即便某种差异有用，也并非能迁移到每个目标模型：成功迁移要求所诱导的更新使目标模型趋近专家，并且能够泛化到采样的 rollout 之外。原始策略距离无法预测迁移性，而恰当的参考策略可以挽救原本不成功的迁移。这些结果刻画了相对策略差异何时能为 OPD 提供有效监督。

At moderate sparsity, Chronos-Bolt with 7/11 candidate blocks and TimesFM with 16/20 blocks show little change in mean relative forecasting quality across datasets while reducing median A100 batch-1 latency by 11.2% and 13.4%. More aggressive TimesFM skipping accelerates inference further but substantially harms Traffic and Weather. Across both models, different equal-budget masks win on different windows, and a retrospective oracle significantly improves over the best static mask on every dataset. However, dataset-specific masks transfer inconsistently, and Chronos representations do not support reliable unseen-domain routing. These results establish cross-architecture structured redundancy and input-dependent opportunity, but not a deployable dynamic inference method.

    Monarch-MoE introduces block-structured LoRA experts with gradient isolation to reduce forgetting and adapter cost in multimodal continual tuning, alongside implementation optimizations for memory-limited hardware.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    Learning new tasks in multimodal continual instruction tuning can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired knowledge. Although multi-expert LoRA distributes learning across experts, updates to a dense low-rank expert can still affect many output features. We introduce Monarch-MoE, which replaces the dense factors in LoRA experts with block-diagonal factors connected by a fixed permutation. This structure provides blockwise gradient isolation: individual block-pair updates affect only one output block, while connections between all input and output blocks are maintained. To make these compact experts practical on memory-limited hardware, we combine batched computation, fused forward operators, and an optimized backward pass. Across three continual-learning methods evaluated on MLLM-DCL and UCIT with LLaVA-1.5-7B, Monarch-MoE improves first-task retention while reducing adapter parameters by approximately 75% and 50%, respectively. In the main comparison, first-task forgetting is as low as 0.52 percentage points on MLLM-DCL and 0.10 on UCIT, with method-dependent trade-offs in final performance. Our implementation supports fine-tuning and inference on a single 24 GB RTX 4090, with lower measured memory use and competitive runtime in the evaluated settings. Together, these algorithmic and systems improvements make structured experts a practical option for continual adaptation on memory-limited hardware.

    The Predictability Bias of Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning in Medical Imaging

    医学影像中联合嵌入预测学习的可预测性偏差

    Fabian Drexel, Bernhard Kainz, Jakob N. Kather, Daniel Rueckert, Lisa C. Adams, Keno K. Bressem, Cosmin I. Bercea

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper audits how a JEPA’s predictive pathway shifts pathology representations toward controls and tests their downstream importance, offering mechanistic evidence about learned representations. Its medical imaging setting and classification results do not address composition, reasoning, or system design.

    论文审查了 JEPA 的预测路径如何使病理表示向对照表示偏移，并测试了这些表示对下游任务的重要性，为学习到的表示提供了机制层面的证据。其医学影像场景和分类结果并未涉及组合性、推理或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn by predicting teacher representations of masked regions from visible context. Point prediction summarizes the conditional target distribution and cannot reproduce variation that the context does not resolve. We call this constraint predictability bias. In computed tomography (CT), recurrent anatomy is predictable from context, whereas the sporadic, localized pathology that determines clinical interpretation often is not. We introduce TAP-JEPA, a ViT-B/3D trained on 113,611 CT volumes that is competitive with state-of-the-art encoders (COLIPRI, Merlin, VoxelFM) in scan-level classification. We then audit the learned predictive pathway by replaying the exact masking, teacher, and predictor computations used during training. Prediction lowers the mean Skill (prevalence-normalized average precision) from 0.388 to 0.271 for pathology, but only from 0.921 to 0.873 for anatomy. Along the teacher direction, separating pathology from matched control regions in the same organ, prediction moves pathology 34.7% toward the controls and controls 13.6% toward pathology, with larger shifts farther from visible context. Replacing visible matched-control representations increases surrounding-target prediction loss more than fully replacing pathology representations across four pathology categories. Downstream, removing all final-layer pathology tokens reduces the decision margin by at most 0.45% in four of seven scan-level probes. Together, these results show that contextual predictability is not a sufficient proxy for clinical relevance in medical representation learning. Training objectives should therefore retain diagnostic features regardless of their predictability from surrounding anatomy.

    中文

    联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）通过根据可见上下文预测被掩蔽区域的教师表示来学习。点预测概括了条件目标分布，无法复现上下文无法确定的变化。我们将这一限制称为可预测性偏差。在计算机断层扫描（CT）中，反复出现的解剖结构可以根据上下文预测，而决定临床解读的偶发、局部病理往往无法如此预测。我们提出 TAP-JEPA，这是一种在 113,611 个 CT 体积上训练的 ViT-B/3D，在扫描级分类任务上达到与最先进编码器（COLIPRI、Merlin、VoxelFM）相当的水平。随后，我们通过重放训练时使用的精确掩蔽、教师和预测器计算过程，审查学习到的预测路径。对于病理，预测使平均 Skill（按患病率归一化的平均精度）从 0.388 降至 0.271；而对于解剖结构，仅从 0.921 降至 0.873。沿着教师方向，在同一器官中将病理与匹配的对照区域区分开来时，预测使病理向对照区域移动了 34.7%，并使对照区域向病理移动了 13.6%；离可见上下文越远，移动幅度越大。在四类病理中，替换可见的匹配对照表示，比完全替换病理表示更能提高周围目标的预测损失。在下游任务中，移除所有最后一层病理 token 后，在七种扫描级探测中的四种里，决策边际最多降低 0.45%。总之，这些结果表明，在医学表示学习中，上下文可预测性并不足以作为临床相关性的替代指标。因此，训练目标应保留诊断特征，无论这些特征能否根据周围解剖结构预测。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Can a vision model learn what words mean from pixels alone? We show that the two largest DINOv3 vision transformers organize words rendered in images by word meaning, despite being pretrained using self-supervision on images only, without paired captions, class labels, or other language supervision. We derive word representations from embedding differences between word images and matched controls, then test whether semantically related words are neighbors within each model's embedding space, while controlling for spelling similarity. We find that brand names in the same industry group together, as do nouns from the same semantic domain. Country-capital pairs exhibit consistent vector offsets, similarly to word embeddings trained on text. These word representations also align with the representations of the visual object categories they name. DINOv3-H and DINOv3-7B are, to our knowledge, the first self-supervised vision models to show substantial semantic structure for rendered words. Comparisons with text and speech encoders reveal shared structure among representations of the same words. Contrastive alignment with either encoder further strengthened DINOv3-H's word-level semantic structure, while leaving the other finetuned vision models largely unchanged. Image-only training can therefore teach vision models not just what words look like, but also how their meanings relate.

    Irene Cannistraci, Julia E. Vogt

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses block replacement to reveal where tabular transformers concentrate computation and shows that much of their depth can be removed with little performance loss, yielding faster, smaller models. This provides substantial architectural and computational insight, but it does not directly analyze internal representations or reasoning.

    论文通过替换块揭示了表格 Transformer 将计算集中在何处，并表明移除大部分深度只会造成很小的性能损失，从而得到更快、更小的模型。这提供了重要的架构和计算洞见，但并未直接分析内部表示或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In-context-learning Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) are uniquely suited to scenarios with limited resources or privacy constraints, as they solve new tasks without additional training. However, their architecture consists of multiple transformer blocks, resulting in high computational and memory footprints. Meanwhile, traditional alternatives like Gradient-Boosted Decision Trees (GBDTs) remain highly competitive and run efficiently on CPUs, suggesting that tabular tasks may not inherently require deep architectures. This contrast raises a fundamental question: can TFMs be simplified by removing architectural redundancies without sacrificing performance? To answer this, we introduce a closed-form, label-free affine translator that replaces a contiguous window of up to 96% of the blocks, leaving the rest unchanged. Evaluating eight frontier TFMs on 171 classification datasets, we reveal that tabular transformers are vastly overparameterized: replacing half of a model's blocks costs at most $0.002$ median AUROC across all architectures, with the half-depth TabFM still outperforming every other full-depth TFMs and tuned GBDTs. Furthermore, different model families are overparameterized in different ways: TabPFN-3 relies on its encoders, maintaining performance regardless of which single block is retained. Other single-axis models spread computation thinly, needing only their first block, while dual-axis models concentrate it in one critical block. Ultimately, removing depth saves up to 1.5B parameters, speeds up GPU inference by up to $6\times$ at a median cost of $0.03$ AUROC, while a single-block TabPFN-3 serves cached queries $2.4\times$ faster using $6\times$ less memory at negligible cost.

    中文

    基于上下文学习的表格基础模型（TFM）特别适用于资源有限或受到隐私约束的场景，因为它们无需额外训练即可解决新任务。然而，其架构由多个 Transformer 块组成，导致计算和内存开销高。与此同时，梯度提升决策树（GBDT）等传统替代方法仍具有很强的竞争力，并能在 CPU 上高效运行，这表明表格任务未必需要深层架构。这种反差引出了一个根本问题：能否在不牺牲性能的情况下，通过移除架构冗余来简化 TFM？为回答这一问题，我们提出一种闭式、无标签的仿射转换器，可替换连续窗口中最多 96% 的块，并保持其余部分不变。我们在 171 个分类数据集上评估了八种前沿 TFM，结果显示表格 Transformer 存在大量过参数化：在所有架构中，将模型一半的块替换掉所付出的代价最高为 $0.002$ 个百分点的中位 AUROC；深度减半的 TabFM 仍优于所有其他完整深度的 TFM 和经过调优的 GBDT。此外，不同模型家族的过参数化方式各不相同：TabPFN-3 依赖其编码器，无论保留哪个单独的块，都能维持性能。其他单轴模型将计算分散在各处，只需保留第一个块；而双轴模型则将计算集中在一个关键块中。最终，移除深度最多可节省 1.5B 个参数，使 GPU 推理速度最高提升 $6\times$，中位 AUROC 代价为 $0.03$ 个百分点；而单块 TabPFN-3 处理缓存查询的速度提高 $2.4\times$ 倍，同时内存用量减少 $6\times$，代价可以忽略不计。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CAST introduces a KL-regularized method for distributing distillation credit across student tokens and anchoring positions without teacher supervision, with gains on reasoning-related benchmarks. Its focus is training credit assignment rather than internal mechanisms, composition, or system organization.

    CAST 提出了一种经 KL 正则化的方法，将蒸馏信用分配给学生 token，并锚定缺乏教师监督的位置；该方法在与推理相关的基准上取得了提升。其重点是训练中的信用分配，而非内部机制、组合性或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Cross-tokenizer on-policy distillation (OPD) requires aligning teacher and student sequences before their scores can be compared. Decoded-text alignment provides such correspondence at the chunk level, but leaves a distinct problem unresolved: credit alignment. A chunk-level signal specifies how much a span should change, but not how that signal should be distributed across student tokens, while tokens without teacher correspondence remain unconstrained. We propose CAST (Chunk-aware credit Assignment with Selective Token Anchoring), a shift-or-stay framework that addresses both issues. For aligned chunks, CAST redistributes each chunk's advantage across student tokens using predictive uncertainty and local teacher-signal smoothness, emphasizing learning opportunities supported by locally consistent teacher feedback while preserving the chunk's total advantage. The resulting weights exactly solve a KL-regularized credit-allocation problem. For unaligned positions, CAST selectively anchors the student to its initial policy through a KL penalty, limiting drift where teacher supervision is unavailable. Because credit assignment is separated from chunk construction, CAST also applies to punctuation-defined or fixed-length chunks under shared tokenization. Across six mathematics, science, and code benchmarks, CAST improves the average over the strongest evaluated baseline by $2.45$ and $1.32$ points for cross-tokenizer transfer from Qwen3-8B to Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B, respectively, and by $2.10$ points for shared-tokenizer transfer to Qwen3-1.7B.

    中文

    跨分词器在线策略蒸馏（OPD）要求先对齐教师和学生序列，才能比较它们的分数。基于解码文本的对齐能在块级建立这种对应关系，但仍留下一个独立问题：信用对齐。块级信号说明某个片段应改变多少，却没有说明该信号应如何分配给学生 token；而没有教师对应关系的 token 则不受约束。我们提出 CAST（基于块的信用分配与选择性 token 锚定），这是一种同时解决这两个问题的“改变或保持”框架。对于已对齐的块，CAST 利用预测不确定性和教师信号的局部平滑性，将每个块的优势重新分配给学生 token；它强调由局部一致的教师反馈支持的学习机会，同时保留该块的总优势。由此得到的权重精确求解一个经 KL 正则化的信用分配问题。对于未对齐的位置，CAST 通过 KL 惩罚有选择地将学生锚定到其初始策略，从而限制缺少教师监督时的偏移。由于信用分配与块的构造相分离，CAST 也适用于共享分词器下由标点定义或固定长度的块。在六项数学、科学和代码基准上，相较于所评估的最强基线，CAST 在从 Qwen3-8B 向 Mistral-7B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 进行跨分词器迁移时，平均分分别提升 $2.45$ 和 $1.32$ 个百分点；在共享分词器迁移到 Qwen3-1.7B 时，提升 $2.10$ 个百分点。

    DREAM 使用激活模式诊断以及动态抑制或强化来检测并选择性修复中毒的智能体记忆，并报告了鲁棒性和效率提升。其记忆干预是一项重要的系统贡献，而神经科学启发本身并不能证明其揭示了模型表示的机制。

    Large language model (LLM) agents are highly vulnerable to memory-poisoning attacks. Existing defenses primarily rely on external modules for either static memory isolation or continuous online auditing, resulting in low memory efficiency and high computational overhead. To address these limitations, inspired by neuroscientific mechanisms that weak reactivation can destabilize memories and induce decay in the absence of reinforcement, we propose an agent-intrinsic training-free memory repair framework, DREAM (Dynamic Reactivation for Engram Attenuation in Memory), that enables selective functional forgetting of poisoned memories. Specifically, DREAM implements a three-stage pipeline: perturbation-induced implicit reactivation to reveal the structural fragility of malicious memories, adaptive anomaly diagnosis based on multi-dimensional activation patterns to detect topological anomalies, and a dynamic memory repair module that selectively suppresses harmful memories while reinforcing benign ones. Extensive experiments across diverse attackers and real-world tasks demonstrate that DREAM reduces attack success rates by over 95\% against backdoor poisoning while preserving strong benign utility. DREAM also achieves competitive robustness against injection attacks. In terms of runtime and token consumption, DREAM achieves up to a 2.13$\times$ speedup and a 37.7\% reduction in token consumption compared with A-MemGuard. Furthermore, DREAM also achieves a task success rate of 92.96\% on poisoned multi-agent systems.

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体极易受到记忆投毒攻击。现有防御主要依赖外部模块进行静态记忆隔离或持续在线审计，导致记忆效率低、计算开销高。为解决这些局限，受神经科学机制启发——弱再激活会使记忆变得不稳定，并在缺乏强化时诱发衰减——我们提出一种智能体内置、无需训练的记忆修复框架 DREAM（记忆中的印迹衰减动态再激活），使智能体能够选择性地对中毒记忆进行功能性遗忘。具体而言，DREAM 实现了一个三阶段流程：通过扰动诱发隐式再激活，以揭示恶意记忆的结构脆弱性；基于多维激活模式进行自适应异常诊断，以检测拓扑异常；以及通过动态记忆修复模块，有选择地抑制有害记忆，同时强化良性记忆。在不同攻击者和真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，DREAM 在抵御后门投毒时将攻击成功率降低了 95\% 以上，同时保持了较强的良性效用。DREAM 对注入攻击也实现了有竞争力的鲁棒性。在运行时间和 token 消耗方面，与 A-MemGuard 相比，DREAM 的速度最高提升 2.13$\times$ 倍，token 消耗减少 37.7\%。此外，DREAM 在受投毒的多智能体系统上也实现了 92.96\% 的任务成功率。

    Pretrained vision transformers learn structured image representations spanning spatial patch tokens and non-spatial tokens. Recent analyses suggest that non-spatial register tokens encode global scene properties such as illumination, blur, and style. Yet patch-based image decoders discard these outputs, leaving the decoder to recover image appearance from patches alone. We investigate whether retaining register features improves decoding when the complete spatial patch representation is already available. We study this question using representation autoencoders (RAEs) with frozen register-equipped encoders. Our decoder processes four register tokens together with all patch tokens through joint self-attention. Appearance probes, paired reconstruction-error analysis, and fixed-decoder register substitutions examine which global image properties are accessible from registers and how their values affect reconstructed pixels. For generation, we train a multi-head attention pooling (MHAP) predictor to recover register features from sampled patches, keeping the pretrained diffusion model and its samples unchanged. On ImageNet-1K, our ViT-B decoders achieve mean reconstruction FIDs of 0.472 with DINOv2 and 0.442 with DINOv3, reductions of 9.5% and 5.2% relative to their respective patch-only baselines. The corresponding PSNRs are 19.73 and 20.54 dB. For generation, our DINOv2 models achieve a mean FID of 1.641, 9.8% below the patch-only baseline on identical sampled patches.

    论文提出一种 GPU 分词器，旨在降低智能体式 LLM 服务中的分词延迟和前端容量瓶颈，并在吞吐量和 TTFT 方面取得显著提升。这是一项突出的模型系统贡献，而智能体场景并未提供有关智能体行为、推理、组合性或内部机制的证据。

    ENGLISH

    Agentic workloads resend long contexts that barely change between calls. Prefix caching now skips most of their prefill, yet every request must still be tokenized in full before the cache can even be consulted. Tokenization, a CPU stage long treated as negligible, becomes the largest part of time-to-first-token (TTFT), and a frontend that tokenizes for a whole GPU fleet limits how many GPUs it can feed. We present GraphTok, a GPU tokenizer that runs the entire encoding pipeline, from pre-tokenization through byte-pair encoding (BPE) merging to token-ID assembly, as one replayable CUDA graph. GraphTok reproduces the reference token IDs bit-for-bit on GPT-2, Llama 3, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemma 3, hands short inputs to a CPU engine where the GPU cannot win, and plugs into unmodified vLLM and NVIDIA Dynamo. GraphTok encodes one million GPT-2 tokens in 1.7-3.2 ms including data transfers, and on Llama 3 it is 4.7-6.0x faster than gigatoken, the strongest CPU tokenizer. On TokTier's own single-request benchmark, it is 2.6-3.9x faster than gigatoken and up to 18.1x faster than TokTier. In vLLM with a cached prefix, it lowers mean TTFT by 2.1-2.4x. The largest gain is capacity. Within a 2 s P99 target, one Dynamo frontend with GraphTok sustains 518 requests/s of 121k-token traffic, the busiest-hour load of 56 GPUs, against 296 with gigatoken and 18.5 with the default tokenizer. Across 121k to one million tokens, this is 1.75-2.5x the load gigatoken sustains, with a P99 up to 64x lower where gigatoken's tail breaks.

    Mengqi Guo, Zhe Wei, Yuan Yuan, Jiunn Bin Lim, Boyi Pan, Michael Bi Mi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a rate-distortion method for allocating per-expert precision across storage and workload-specific decoding, with a lightweight online solve and serving evidence. Its MoE routing and compute allocation are relevant to Systems, but the contribution concerns quantized serving rather than routing or adaptive computation itself.

    本文提出一种速率—失真方法，用于在存储和特定工作负载的解码之间分配逐专家精度，并提供轻量级在线求解方法和服务效果证据。其 MoE 路由和计算分配与 Systems 相关，但其贡献聚焦于量化服务，而非路由或自适应计算本身。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Serving a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model pays for expert precision twice: the resident footprint pays for every expert the router can reach, while each batch-one decode step pays only for the experts it selects. These are two different rate functionals over the same per-expert widths, yet published per-expert MoE allocators constrain only the first. We call the difference the store-read gap; in the released BitsMoE checkpoint, 2.54 bits per weight (bpw) of storage become 7.50 bpw of decode traffic. We propose DuoRate, which stores once and reads per workload. Offline, it stores one uniform tier of a prefix-readable weight stream and bakes a distortion tensor. Online, it profiles a workload's own prefill without labels and solves a Lagrangian rate-distortion allocation under the decode functional; routing frequency provably cancels from every per-expert decision, and the solve costs one dot product per expert and a bisection. A deployment therefore keeps a single artifact that prefill reads at the stored rate and decode reads at the workload's own rate. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, DuoRate reading 2.3 bpw exceeds every 2-bit-class baseline by 6.3 to 47.0 points of average accuracy, and at 2.9 bpw it matches 4-bit formats that read 1.4-1.6 bpw more. The advantage is largest under long decoding: on GSM8K, DuoRate at 2.9 bpw matches or exceeds every 4-bit format and trails BF16 by only 0.25 points, and at 2.6 bpw it still matches or exceeds the 4.5-bit NF4 and FP4. Against controls in its own format, the allocation alone is worth 0.07-0.11 bpw of read rate. Code will be released upon publication.

    中文

    服务混合专家（MoE）模型需要为专家精度付出两次代价：常驻存储占用要容纳路由器可能访问的每个专家，而批量大小为 1 的每个解码步骤只需为其选中的专家付费。这是针对同一组逐专家位宽的两种不同速率函数，但已发表的逐专家 MoE 分配器只约束第一种。我们将两者之差称为存储—读取差距；在已发布的 BitsMoE 检查点中，存储所需的每权重 2.54 比特（bpw）会转化为 7.50 bpw 的解码流量。我们提出 DuoRate，它只存储一次，并按工作负载读取。离线时，它以统一精度层存储一条可按前缀读取的权重流，并预先生成失真张量。在线时，它在无标签的情况下分析工作负载自身的预填充阶段，并依据解码速率函数求解拉格朗日速率—失真分配；路由频率可证明会从每个逐专家决策中抵消，求解只需每个专家一次点积和一次二分搜索。因此，部署时只需保留一个制品：预填充阶段按存储速率读取，解码阶段则按工作负载自身的速率读取。在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，DuoRate 以 2.3 bpw 读取时，平均准确率比所有 2 比特级基线高 6.3 至 47.0 个百分点；以 2.9 bpw 读取时，则可匹配读取速率高出 1.4–1.6 bpw 的 4 比特格式。在长解码场景下优势最大：在 GSM8K 上，DuoRate 以 2.9 bpw 读取时可匹配或超过所有 4 比特格式，且比 BF16 仅低 0.25 个百分点；以 2.6 bpw 读取时，仍可匹配或超过 4.5 比特的 NF4 和 FP4。与自身格式的对照方法相比，仅分配策略就带来了 0.07–0.11 bpw 的读取速率收益。代码将在论文发表后发布。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ChemDiffAgent uses iterative denoising over reasoning and tool-use trajectories, with post-training methods and a benchmark for chemical agent tasks. This substantially advances reasoning and tool-integrated agent systems; molecular coordination offers only incidental compositional relevance, with no explicit compositional generalization contribution.

    ChemDiffAgent 对交错的推理与工具使用轨迹进行迭代去噪，并结合后训练方法和化学智能体任务基准。它显著推进了推理和工具集成智能体系统；分子协调仅带来附带的组合性相关性，并未明确涉及组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Designing tool-integrated reasoning agent systems for complex chemical tasks remains a fundamental challenge. Although recent chemical agents have demonstrated promising performance through the integration of external tools, they are still built on the autoregressive paradigm, which is inherently constrained by causal attention and left-to-right generation. As a result, they often struggle with bidirectional molecular understanding, global coordinated tool planning and multi-source evidence integration. To address this challenge, we introduce ChemDiffAgent, the first masked diffusion language agent for tool-integrated chemical reasoning. It reformulates chemical reasoning as iterative denoising over interleaved reasoning and tool-use trajectories, enabling tool-use decisions to be jointly determined under full-trajectory context and thereby better aligning the agent's decision boundary with its knowledge boundary. We further analyze how this paradigm benefits agentic reasoning through harder infilling subproblems during training and flexible arbitrary-order decoding during inference. Then we develop a two-stage post-training framework, comprising agentic supervised fine-tuning and variance-reduced preference optimization, to enhance tool-use and reasoning capabilities. We also construct a comprehensive benchmark covering six chemistry tasks across both single-turn and multi-turn tool-use scenarios. Under matched budgets and evaluation, ChemDiffAgent consistently outperforms autoregressive agents, achieving an overall improvement of approximately 20%. Notably, our 8B model achieves performance comparable to, in some cases surpassing, significantly larger frontier models, such as GPT 5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7. Code is available at https://github.com/bilemond/ChemDiffAgent.

    为复杂化学任务设计集成工具的推理智能体系统仍是一项根本性挑战。尽管近期的化学智能体通过集成外部工具展现出良好性能，但它们仍建立在自回归范式之上，天然受因果注意力和从左到右生成的限制。因此，它们往往难以实现双向分子理解、全局协调的工具规划以及多源证据整合。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 ChemDiffAgent，这是首个用于工具集成化学推理的掩码扩散语言智能体。它将化学推理重新表述为对交错的推理与工具使用轨迹进行迭代去噪，使工具使用决策能够在完整轨迹上下文中联合确定，从而更好地使智能体的决策边界与其知识边界对齐。我们进一步分析了这一范式如何通过训练期间更困难的填空子问题，以及推理期间灵活的任意顺序解码，提升智能体推理能力。随后，我们开发了一个两阶段后训练框架，包括智能体监督微调和降方差偏好优化，以增强工具使用和推理能力。我们还构建了一个全面的基准，涵盖六项化学任务，包括单轮和多轮工具使用场景。在预算和评估条件匹配时，ChemDiffAgent 的表现持续优于自回归智能体，整体提升约 20%。值得注意的是，我们的 8B 模型达到了与规模大得多的前沿模型相当的性能，有时甚至超过它们，例如 GPT 5.5 和 Claude Opus 4.7。代码见 https://github.com/bilemond/ChemDiffAgent。

    Tool-using agents increasingly require a common substrate for building, training, evaluating, distilling, and maintaining agentic systems, yet existing tooling typically addresses these stages in isolation. We present AgentTune, a source-available Python library that provides a unified framework for developing and optimizing tool-using agents. At its core, AgentTune introduces a two-tier EventLog representation that preserves agent trajectories while supporting consistent projections for training, evaluation, and auditing. Building on this substrate, the library provides a shared agent runtime, tool-calling reinforcement learning, agentic distillation, retrieval-augmented generation, decision workflows, evaluation utilities, and a designed path toward self-healing agents. These components are exposed through composable interfaces so that agent strategies, training methods, evaluation procedures, and recovery mechanisms can be combined without requiring separate representations or pipelines.     The NIST Assembly Task Board #1 remains a challenging benchmark for learning-based methods in robotic manipulation. Over short horizons, it demands precise, contact-rich control of small, tight-fitting parts. Over long horizons, it requires recovery and coordination across extended action sequences. Demonstrations, task decomposition, and dense progress rewards have enabled research advances by providing guidance on how to assemble. But how much of the strategy must be specified? The progression from AlphaGo to AlphaGo Zero showed that RL at scale can discover superhuman strategies without prescribing how to win. AlphaNIST asks whether a sparse binary task reward and task diversity admitted by this task-agnostic reward can similarly let a robot discover how to assemble. In simulation, we train a single policy from scratch across all 20 assembly tasks on the NIST Assembly Task Board #1, reaching 98.2% overall training success without demonstrations, progress shaping, scripted primitives, or per-task tuning. The framework also trains policies to complete ten assembly pairs in a single episode without a prescribed order, with task success rewarded only when all ten pairs are simultaneously complete. The learned policies discover dexterous and planning-like behaviors: choosing grasps for later assembly, using surrounding geometry to reorient parts, and preparing one part, assembling another, then returning to finish the first without an explicit planner.     Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the standard architecture for frontier LLMs. The multiple parallel experts in each transformer block theoretically enable expert specialization according to categories such as domains, languages, or modalities during pretraining. However, when data is imbalanced across categories, minority categories can become concentrated in a small fraction of the expert pool or spread inefficiently across them, effectively limiting their available capacity. In this work, we demonstrate that category-conditioned expert-selection biases can preferentially route tokens from different categories toward specialized expert pools. By applying biases based on input category, we provide a simple way to induce soft category-aligned specialization. This intervention encourages categories toward distinct expert subsets while retaining cross-category sharing when useful. More importantly, it enables the over-allocation of expert capacity to categories that would otherwise be disadvantaged by data scarcity. We observe performance improvements across modalities, low-resource languages, and code in models up to 10.6B parameters. At our smallest and largest model scales, these gains are equivalent to allocating 18.5% and 2.7% additional baseline training tokens, respectively. Overall, our results show that expert biases can serve as a lightweight control for category-level expert allocation, making room for low-resource categories while retaining standard MoE inference.

    Coding agents are increasingly used to build programs from scratch as software engineers do rather than to resolve issues within a repository or to generate a repository from a given requirements document. Moreover, existing agent workflows also cannot sustain long-horizon development in which the agent explores the reference program before implementation. To address these challenges, we introduce ProgramGym, a framework consisting of Program-Env and Program-Agent for scalable training environments of long-horizon program reproduction agents. Specifically, Program-Env constructs verifiable training environments from repositories through a feedback-driven loop that repairs runtime sandbox builds and the quality of black-box tests. Using this novel pipeline, we obtain 1,648 training environments spanning C, C++, Go, and Rust. Program-Agent combines a role-isolated workflow of analysis, implementation, and review with revision management for compilation checks and failure recovery.     Long-term personalized tutoring requires language models to translate a learner's evolving history into appropriate instructional support. Existing LLM-based tutoring systems use memory and retrieval to personalize responses, but the pedagogical rationale linking historical evidence to teaching strategies is not always explicit. We introduce RegulaTutor, a theory-informed framework for long-term personalized tutoring that connects historical evidence, learner interpretation, and learner-facing instruction. Guided by self-regulated learning (SRL) research, its tutoring harness operationalizes a cognitive, affective, metacognitive, and motivational (CAMM) framework for deriving evidence-supported learner interpretations and teaching policies. The resulting policies retain links to their supporting evidence and are updated as new observations arrive. This staged workflow also supports systematic refinement through PairRoute, an offline procedure that uses intermediate execution records to distinguish harness, model, and mixed failures. PairRoute proposes and evaluates targeted harness revisions, then constructs reviewed stage-level supervision for confirmed model failures remaining under the selected harness. We focus this refinement on historical evidence acquisition, which underpins personalized instruction and allows outputs to be checked against learning records and reference answers. RegulaTutor improves historical-evidence accuracy, learner diagnosis, and judged teaching quality on average across evaluated model configurations. PairRoute results show an endpoint improvement in standalone-model historical-evidence accuracy over the refinement trajectory. Together, these results highlight RegulaTutor's potential to support lifelong personalized education through instructional policies that evolve with learner histories and targeted improvements to the tutoring system.

    Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming direct users of the open web. As they take on increasingly complex and information-intensive tasks, effective web access is becoming a core capability for agentic problem solving. Existing approaches have advanced agentic web access through different access models, including search-augmented agents, browser-based agents, and, more recently, filesystem-based agents. Nevertheless, as users expect agents to complete long-horizon, end-to-end tasks, they increasingly need to conduct broad information gathering, perform browser actions, and revisit acquired evidence within a single trajectory. Yet our preliminary analyses reveal that existing access models struggle to meet these demands. They primarily support either information gathering or browser interaction, while combining their capabilities can involve substantial costs or performance trade-offs. To this end, we present Web\$hell, an interface that unifies web access under a single access model. Using a common schema defined by WebContract, WebCompiler compiles live webpages into addressable information and action objects. These objects are maintained in WebCache and handled through a shared set of operations, providing agents with consistent, operable, and persistent web access. Through extensive experiments across web search, web navigation, and deep research benchmarks, we show that Web\$hell achieves strong task performance at lower cost. Our results further indicate the importance of interface design for effective web access, with Web\$hell opening new possibilities for more capable and efficient LLM agents on the web.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper builds a saturation-resilient benchmark for mathematical capability using machine-checked bounds and reports agent submissions that improve records. It substantively advances reasoning evaluation, while agents and formal tools are incidental to the benchmark contribution and no compositional or internal-mechanism insight is described.

    本文构建了一个面向数学能力的抗饱和基准，利用机器检查的界，并报告了改进记录的智能体提交。它实质性地推进了推理评测；智能体和形式化工具只是基准贡献中的附带部分，且文中未描述组合性或内部机制方面的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI systems are making rapid progress in mathematics, but this progress is hard to measure. Benchmarks of solved problems saturate, and in benchmarks of open problems each problem can be resolved for the first time only once. We present SqueezeBench, a benchmark that is resilient to saturation: a success raises the bar instead of removing the problem. Each problem fixes an integer function $f(n)$ whose values are known only for small $n$, and the benchmark keeps a lower and an upper record on it. A record is a computable Lean function with a machine-checked proof that it bounds $f$. A submission proposes a new function and proves that it bounds $f$, that it is no worse than the current record at any $n$, and that it is strictly better at some $n$. Once accepted, it becomes the record that the next submission has to beat. The system thus chooses the bound as well as its proof, and it may improve the record at a single $n$ or its growth rate. At every $n$, the gap between the two records shows how far the certified bounds are from determining $f(n)$. Every proof is checked by two independent Lean kernels, so no referee needs to check the mathematics. The checks also reject a function that computes $f$ by exhaustive search at small $n$, and a maintainer only reads the submitter's report and looks for such a search at larger $n$. We release ten problems from extremal combinatorics with twenty proved initial records and the admission tools. As a baseline, agents based on a frontier language model, with at most one hour per record, had 82 submissions accepted and improved every record, without going beyond the published literature. Agents based on two newer models then started from these records, had 60 more submissions accepted and improved 19 of the 20 records again. For eight of the ten problems, at least one record is still asymptotically behind the best published bound.

    中文

    AI 系统在数学方面正迅速进步，但这种进步难以衡量。已解决问题的基准会趋于饱和，而在开放问题基准中，每个问题只能首次解决一次。我们提出 SqueezeBench，这是一种抗饱和基准：一次成功会提高门槛，而不是移除该问题。每个问题都确定一个整数函数 $f(n)$，其取值仅在较小的 $n$ 时已知；该基准为它维护一个下界记录和一个上界记录。记录是一个可计算的 Lean 函数，并附有机器检查的证明，证明它界定了 $f$。提交者提出一个新函数，并证明它界定了 $f$，在任意 $n$ 处都不劣于当前记录，并且在某个 $n$ 处严格更优。提交一经接受，就成为下一次提交必须超越的记录。因此，该系统既选择界，也选择其证明；它可以在单个 $n$ 处改进记录，也可以改善其增长率。在每个 $n$ 处，两个记录之间的差距显示，经过认证的界距离确定 $f(n)$ 还有多远。每个证明都由两个独立的 Lean 内核检查，因此无需裁判核验数学内容。这些检查还会拒绝通过穷举搜索在较小 $f$ 时计算 $n$ 的函数；维护者只需阅读提交者的报告，并查找其是否在较大的 $n$ 时进行了此类搜索。我们发布了十个极值组合学问题、二十个已证明的初始记录以及准入工具。作为基线，基于一个前沿语言模型的智能体每条记录最多用时一小时，共有 82 次提交获接受，并改进了每条记录，且没有超出已发表文献的范围。随后，基于两个更新模型的智能体从这些记录出发，又有 60 次提交获接受，并再次改进了 20 条记录中的 19 条。对于十个问题中的八个，至少有一条记录在渐近意义上仍落后于已发表的最佳界。

    本文诊断了一种 MLLM 识读失败，并通过隐藏状态分析表明，文字身份的表征较弱，而空间选择是一个主要瓶颈，随后训练学生模型以提升识别能力。表征和机制方面的发现具有可迁移性，但其应用、训练方法和性能提升并未实质性涉及组合能力、推理或模型系统。

    Multimodal LLMs can fail to read text embedded in an image's coarse structure (text a human recovers by squinting) and report that no text is present. We name this class Squint Text and study it as a recognition deficiency, motivated by cases from a production moderation pipeline. We introduce SquintBench, comprising 1076 production-derived moderation images, and SquintCtrl, a controlled synthetic suite for mechanism diagnosis. Frozen-weight analysis shows that hidden text leaves a coarse signal while glyph identity is weakly represented; identity becomes substantially more accessible when the correct spatial regions are supplied, implicating spatial selection as a major bottleneck. Suppressing high-frequency content also improves reading at a fixed visual-token budget, while visual token count may also contribute. These findings motivate Squint OPSD: a frozen teacher receives a downscaled view and the ground-truth transcription as privileged context, and its token-level distributions supervise a student along on-policy trajectories. At inference, the student reads the original image alone. Squint OPSD reaches 88.61 ANLS on SquintBench, versus 26.50 for the unadapted backbone, 24.44 for the best general-purpose model on the original view, and 68.60 at best for an off-the-shelf model under a downscaled view. These results substantially narrow the gap between available visual evidence and its generated read-out without auxiliary views at inference.

    BranchOPD improves teacher supervision by branching from uncertain or disagreeing student decisions, with analyses showing expanded behavior coverage and gains on math and agent tasks.
