    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) provides teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories, but a single trajectory realizes only one continuation at each decision, limiting supervision coverage under a finite sampling budget. We propose BranchOPD (Branching On-Policy Distillation), which selects informative decision points using student uncertainty and teacher-student disagreement, resamples student-policy continuations from shared prefixes, and applies token-level teacher supervision to both main trajectories and branches. BranchOPD operates at token-level decisions in mathematics and within-turn decisions in agent tasks. Shared-prefix reuse reduces student-generated token costs by approximately 19% on ALFWorld and 31% on WebShop relative to seven independent trajectories. We also introduce protocol-boundary repair (PBR), which uses targeted supervision under protocol constraints to mitigate repetition and wasted generation. BranchOPD outperforms Vanilla OPD and Multi-Rollout OPD (n=7) across all evaluated benchmarks, with gains over Vanilla OPD of 18.55 percentage points in mean mathematics accuracy over 16 sampled answers (avg@16) and 13.8 points in mean ALFWorld ID/OOD success. Mechanistic analyses and selection ablations show that branching at uncertain decisions expands subsequent behavior coverage and outperforms random selection and turn-initial branching.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Generative Recommenders increasingly use Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize outcomes that may appear hundreds or thousands of interactions after a decision. Standard RL propagates reward according to temporal proximity rather than explicit relevance, attenuating the signal assigned to distant but important actions and creating a source of sample inefficiency. We introduce Explanatory World Models (EWM), an attribution framework that uses explanations to identify the earlier events that plausibly contributed to a realized outcome. We instantiate EWM with a frontier language model and use its explanations as learning signals using a conservative hierarchical operator that recursively redistributes reward while preserving the undiscounted episode return. To investigate what constitutes a useful explanation, we operationalize three complementary variants inspired by Halpern's actual causation, Lombrozo's explanatory simplicity, and Deutsch's hard-to-vary explanations. We evaluate EWM on two controlled long-horizon RL benchmarks, a public sequential-recommendation benchmark, and an industry-scale generative recommender. On Crafter and WordCraft, EWM substantially outperforms PPO and LaRe, with its largest gains when rewards are most delayed. On KuaiRand, EWM outperforms SFT and LaRe offline and A2C online. Finally, in an offline evaluation of an industry generative recommender, EWM considerably improves Recall and increases behavioral proxies. These results suggest that explanations can provide structured and reusable credit for learning from delayed outcomes.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper classifies equilibria and analyzes stability in discrete-time self-attention dynamics, identifying consensus and bipartite attractors and relating the results to learned weights. This gives substantial insight into transformer representation dynamics, but the abstract does not address compositionality, reasoning, or broader systems design.

    本文对离散时间自注意力动力学的平衡点进行分类并分析其稳定性，识别出共识吸引子和二部吸引子，并将结果与学到的权重联系起来。这为理解 Transformer 的表征动力学提供了重要洞见，但摘要没有涉及组合性、推理或更广泛的系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In machine learning, a self-attention dynamics describes the attention mechanism of transformers, and is obtained treating the layer index of a transformer as time index. Even though naturally discrete-time, this dynamical system is most often studied in continuous-time. Scope of this paper is to provide a thorough investigation of the discrete-time version of the self-attention dynamics: a complete classification of its equilibria is given, and their stability properties are studied, in both the single-head and the multihead case. We show that in both cases the main attractor of the dynamics is a consensus equilibrium aligned with the principal eigenvector of the value matrix (in the single-head case, a corresponding matrix of weights in the multihead case), even though other locally asymptotically stable bipartite equilibria can be show to exist at least in the single-head situation. The behavior is confirmed by looking at the learned weight matrices of a real transformer.

    ENGLISH

    When a language model is distilled from a teacher that shares its base parameters, the student can inherit behavioural traits of the teacher---including misalignment---even from data that is semantically unrelated to the trait (Cloud et al., 2026). All existing defences require knowing the trait. We remove this requirement and prove that a subliminally transferred trait can be recovered from the parameter updates alone, without supervision, by exploiting a single asymmetry: the trait is expressed consistently across diverse datasets generated by the teacher, whereas task-specific and shared capabilities vary. The resulting estimator returns a weight-space direction that can be amplified to discover and interpret the trait or projected out to suppress it. Applied to the subliminal-learning benchmarks of (Cloud et al., 2026), our method recovers the transmitted animal-preference traits without any trait labels and suppresses their expression with almost no impact to task performance.

    Constructing Pareto Frontiers of Optimal Reasoning Termination Methods for Overthinking in Reasoning Models

    构建推理模型过度思考问题的最优推理终止方法帕累托前沿

    Weixin Guan, Liang Li, Shiyu Xie, Jiapeng Liu, Bing Li, Peng Fu, Chengyang Fang, Xiaoshuai Hao, Can Ma, Weiping Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops probing metrics, termination strategies, and a benchmark to characterize and mitigate overthinking in reasoning models, a substantial contribution to reasoning evaluation and test-time computation control. Its dynamic routing and early exit concern model computation, but the abstract does not describe broader agent or memory systems.

    本文开发了探测指标、终止策略和基准，用于刻画并缓解推理模型的过度思考，为推理评估和测试时计算控制作出了实质性贡献。其动态路由和提前退出涉及模型计算，但摘要没有描述更广泛的智能体或记忆系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning models can benefit from test-time scaling, but continued reasoning may become ineffective or harmful, a phenomenon termed overthinking. Evaluations against full thinking compare accuracy and token usage but lack references for overthinking severity and strategies' theoretical mitigation potential. To characterize overthinking at the model-task level, we first introduce Step-wise Truncation Probing (STP), repeatedly generating answers from multiple retained prefixes along each fixed sampled reasoning trajectory. Using each trajectory's earliest measured position attaining maximum empirical accuracy as a reference, we define Overthinking Ratio and Accuracy Degradation as the fraction of thinking tokens generated afterward and the accuracy decrease from this reference to full thinking, respectively. Secondly, we then formulate dynamic routing, fixed budgets, and dynamic early exit within a unified framework to quantify the theoretical mitigation potential of different termination strategies. Based on this unified framework, we use the complete STP measurements to construct a token-accuracy Pareto frontier for each strategy under a common normalized thinking-token budget. We further develop OTBench, a reusable benchmark built from the STP process, which produced 70.5B reasoning tokens and the corresponding probing measurements across six models and four benchmark groups.

    中文

    推理模型可以受益于测试时扩展，但持续推理可能变得无效甚至有害，这种现象称为过度思考。与完整思考相比的评估会比较准确率和 token 用量，但缺少衡量过度思考严重程度以及策略理论缓解潜力的参照。为在模型与任务层面刻画过度思考，我们首先提出逐步截断探测（Step-wise Truncation Probing，STP），沿每条固定采样的推理轨迹，反复从多个保留前缀生成答案。我们以每条轨迹上实测准确率首次达到经验最大值的位置作为参照，分别将过度思考比率（Overthinking Ratio）和准确率下降（Accuracy Degradation）定义为此后生成的思考 token 所占比例，以及从该参照位置到完整思考时准确率的下降幅度。其次，我们在统一框架内形式化动态路由、固定预算和动态提前退出，以量化不同终止策略的理论缓解潜力。基于这一统一框架，我们利用完整的 STP 测量结果，在共同归一化思考 token 预算下，为每种策略构建 token—准确率帕累托前沿。我们还开发了 OTBench，这是基于 STP 流程构建的可复用基准；该流程在六个模型和四组基准任务上生成了 70.5B 个推理 token 及相应的探测测量结果。

    MENTOR: Learning from Failure with On-Policy Pedagogical Intervention

    MENTOR：通过策略内教学干预从失败中学习

    Guanlan Yue, Hang Yu, Xiaoyong Huang, Ruipeng Li, Wei Zhang, Bingchang Liu, Rui Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MENTOR uses diagnosed failures to generate adaptive prompts during RLVR training, targeting recovery of mathematical and coding reasoning; this is a substantial training contribution, though the abstract does not establish a new account of reasoning mechanisms. Its multi-agent mentor and learner architecture is also a main systems contribution, while internal representations and compositional generalization are not addressed.

    MENTOR 利用诊断出的失败在 RLVR 训练期间生成自适应提示，旨在帮助数学和代码推理恢复；这是重要的训练贡献，但摘要没有确立一种新的推理机制解释。其导师与学习者的多智能体架构也是主要的系统贡献，而文中没有涉及内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) is a key driver for Large Reasoning Models, but it is vulnerable to "zero-reward collapse", a training failure where a sudden increase in task difficulty causes the learning signal to vanish. We argue that the conventional approach of discarding these failed trajectories is wasteful, as they contain valuable diagnostic information about the model's cognitive gaps, a bright side that can be leveraged for recovery. Existing solutions, however, often regress to static, "off-policy-style" interventions like pre-defined hint libraries or perform post-hoc refinement, failing to provide the adaptive, forward-looking guidance needed to escape the collapse. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift towards on-policy pedagogical intervention and introduce MENTOR, a multi-agent framework that acts as a live mentor. MENTOR diagnoses the root cause of failure in real-time and dynamically generates targeted, instructional prompts to guide the learning agent's next attempt. As a plug-and-play module, MENTOR integrates seamlessly into existing policy optimization pipelines like GRPO without modifying the training infrastructure. Extensive experiments on math and code generation show that MENTOR effectively mitigates zero-reward collapse, outperforming state-of-the-art baselines. Notably, it achieves massive average relative gains of up to 78.3% on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct over its base model.

    中文

    可验证奖励强化学习（Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards，RLVR）是大型推理模型的重要驱动力，但容易出现“零奖励崩溃”：任务难度突然增加导致学习信号消失的一种训练失败。我们认为，丢弃这些失败轨迹的传统做法很浪费，因为其中包含有关模型认知缺口的宝贵诊断信息，这一积极面可以用于帮助模型恢复。然而，现有解决方案往往退回到静态的“策略外式”干预，例如预定义提示库，或进行事后优化，未能提供摆脱崩溃所需的自适应、前瞻性指导。为此，我们提出转向策略内教学干预的新范式，并引入 MENTOR，一个充当实时导师的多智能体框架。MENTOR 会实时诊断失败的根本原因，并动态生成有针对性的指导提示，引导学习智能体进行下一次尝试。作为即插即用模块，MENTOR 可无缝集成到 GRPO 等现有策略优化流程中，无需修改训练基础设施。在数学和代码生成任务上的大量实验表明，MENTOR 能有效缓解零奖励崩溃，表现优于最先进的基线。值得注意的是，在 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 上，相较于基础模型，其平均相对增益最高达 78.3%。

    AudioTETRIS: Token Elimination via Transitional Importance Signals for Efficient Audio LLMs

    AudioTETRIS：通过过渡重要性信号为高效音频 LLM 消除 token

    Shreya Sajid, Anna Vettoruzzo, Joaquin Vanschoren

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AudioTETRIS uses encoder representation geometry to identify acoustically important tokens, offering a limited connection to representation structure without analyzing internal mechanisms. Its main contribution is a transferable token-selection method that reduces audio LLM inference compute while preserving task performance, strongly advancing efficient model computation.

    AudioTETRIS 利用编码器表征几何结构识别声学上重要的 token，与表征结构有一定关联，但并未分析内部机制。其主要贡献是一种可迁移的 token 选择方法，在保持任务表现的同时减少音频 LLM 的推理计算量，显著推动了高效模型计算。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) achieve strong performance on speech-text tasks, but standard audio encoders produce hundreds of tokens for even short audio clips. Because self-attention scales quadratically in sequence length, this inflates inference-time compute substantially. Current training-free token compression methods prune or merge tokens based solely on coarse attention or feature similarity. However, treating audio tokens as generic, isotropic features smooths over spectral transitions, destroying fine-grained phonetic transitions essential for decoding speech. In contrast, speech signals exhibit highly structured temporal patterns where information density peaks at acoustic transitions. We propose AudioTETRIS, a training-free, two-stage framework that uses the audio encoder's representation geometry as an acoustic prior for token importance before applying attention-based compression. Instead of discarding encoder structure after the encoding stage, AudioTETRIS propagates this prior directly into the LLM decoder to compute a per-token fused score. This score drives progressive top-$k$ token selection across decoder layers without requiring additional training or auxiliary models. Evaluated on Qwen2-Audio-7B, Phi-4-Multimodal, and Audio Flamingo 3, AudioTETRIS retains near-uncompressed performance on several speech tasks using only 25% of audio tokens, matches or surpasses full-token accuracy at moderate compression rates, and consistently outperforms existing training-free baselines.

    中文

    大型音频语言模型（Large Audio Language Models，LALMs）在语音—文本任务上表现出色，但标准音频编码器即使处理很短的音频片段也会产生数百个 token。由于自注意力的计算量随序列长度呈二次增长，这会大幅增加推理时的计算开销。当前无需训练的 token 压缩方法仅依据粗粒度注意力或特征相似度来剪枝或合并 token。然而，将音频 token 视为通用的各向同性特征会抹平频谱过渡，破坏解码语音所必需的细粒度语音过渡。相比之下，语音信号具有高度结构化的时间模式，信息密度在声学过渡处达到峰值。我们提出 AudioTETRIS，这是一种无需训练的两阶段框架，在进行基于注意力的压缩之前，利用音频编码器的表征几何结构作为判断 token 重要性的声学先验。AudioTETRIS 不会在编码阶段后丢弃编码器结构，而是将这一先验直接传递给 LLM 解码器，以计算每个 token 的融合分数。该分数用于在解码器各层逐步选择前 $k$ 个 token，无需额外训练或辅助模型。在 Qwen2-Audio-7B、Phi-4-Multimodal 和 Audio Flamingo 3 上的评估表明，AudioTETRIS 仅使用 25% 的音频 token，就能在多项语音任务上保持接近未压缩时的表现；在中等压缩率下，其准确率可与使用全部 token 时持平或更高，并且始终优于现有无需训练的基线。

    zip2zip++: Towards Inference-Time Token Compression with Minimal Quality Loss

    zip2zip++：迈向质量损失极小的推理时 token 压缩

    Saibo Geng, Andrea Gentilini, Xinxian Ma, Nathan Ranchin, Yunzhen Yao, Robert West

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper improves inference-time token compression through changes to embeddings, positional encoding, and segmentation, and evaluates effects on mathematical reasoning. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to efficient model computation and reasoning quality, but the abstract gives no mechanistic account of internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文通过修改嵌入、位置编码和分段方式改进推理时 token 压缩，并评估其对数学推理的影响。这是对高效模型计算和推理质量的重要算法贡献，但摘要未提供关于内部表征或组合泛化的机制性解释。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Dynamic vocabularies built on-the-fly via Lempel-Ziv-Welch (LZW) compression let a language model represent the same text in fewer tokens, but prior work shows that this efficiency comes at a cost to reasoning and perplexity. We show that this quality gap is not a fundamental price of compression but can be substantially closed through targeted improvements to the compression layer and LZW codec, without modifying the underlying pretrained language model. Our analysis reveals four key issues: (1) LZW's compression algorithm creates an implicit conflict between the input embedding and the output embedding, a tension that a single shared embedding cannot resolve; (2) naively applying RoPE to LZW-compressed sequences ignores that merged tokens can span multiple tokens; (3) merging certain tokens (notably digits) disproportionately hurts downstream accuracy; and (4) dynamic vocabularies introduce an inherent segmentation ambiguity that confounds standard evaluation. We address these through decoupled input/output dynamic embedding layer, size-aware RoPE positioning, and a modified LZW codec supporting selective merges and multi-view segmentations. Across four models, our recipe improves perplexity on every corpus we evaluated as well as mathematical reasoning accuracy, closing roughly half the quality gap between zip2zip and the uncompressed baseline at a similar compression ratio on general text. This represents a significant step toward lossless adaptive-vocabulary compression for language models.

    中文

    通过 Lempel-Ziv-Welch（LZW）压缩动态构建词表，可以让语言模型用更少的 token 表示相同文本，但先前研究表明，这种效率提升会以推理能力和困惑度为代价。我们表明，这种质量差距并非压缩必然付出的代价；通过有针对性地改进压缩层和 LZW 编解码器，可以大幅缩小差距，而无需修改底层预训练语言模型。我们的分析揭示了四个关键问题：（1）LZW 压缩算法在输入嵌入和输出嵌入之间造成隐式冲突，单一共享嵌入无法化解这种矛盾；（2）直接对 LZW 压缩序列应用 RoPE，忽略了合并后的 token 可能跨越多个 token；（3）合并某些 token（尤其是数字）会不成比例地损害下游准确率；（4）动态词表会带来固有的分段歧义，使标准评估受到干扰。我们通过解耦的输入／输出动态嵌入层、感知大小的 RoPE 位置编码，以及支持选择性合并和多视角分段的改进 LZW 编解码器来解决这些问题。在四个模型上，我们的方法在所评估的每个语料库上都提升了困惑度表现，也提高了数学推理准确率；在一般文本上，以相近的压缩率将 zip2zip 与未压缩基线之间的质量差距缩小了约一半。这是迈向语言模型无损自适应词表压缩的重要一步。

    Tarek Naous, Craig Boutilier, Wei Xu, Ofer Meshi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes user simulators whose latent feedback supplies turn-level evaluations and reward signals for multi-turn RL, improving assistant training. The latent states are evaluation signals rather than an analysis of model mechanisms, and the abstract gives no substantive compositional contribution.

    本文提出的用户模拟器通过潜在反馈提供逐轮评估和多轮 RL 的奖励信号，从而改进助手训练。这些潜在状态是评估信号，而非对模型机制的分析；摘要也未提供实质性的组合能力贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    User simulators are gaining attention as environments to train LLM assistants that can better cope with the nuances of multi-turn conversations with real users. Prior work on user simulation has emphasized generating realistic user utterances, leaving unexplored their potential as a source of direct feedback on the assistant's responses. Such evaluation signals may not be explicitly communicated in language, but can instead reside in the latent reasoning of users. In this work, we introduce user simulators with intrinsic feedback, namely, models equipped with latent evaluation states: internal thoughts, reactions, and scalar ratings that evaluate the assistant from a first-person user perspective at each conversation turn. We train LLM-based simulators using interaction logs between real users and assistants and demonstrate that intrinsic feedback improves simulation realism and critiquing behaviors versus prompted simulator baselines, while also providing turn-level evaluations that existing fine-tuned simulators lack. Further, evaluations generated by our trained simulators correlate better with human judgments than those of prompted simulators of the same size. Lastly, our experiments reveal that simulators with intrinsic feedback provide effective reward signals for multi-turn RL training, matching setups that rely on external judge LLMs for rewards while cutting RL compute by more than half.

    用户模拟器日益受到关注，可作为训练 LLM 助手的环境，帮助其更好地应对与真实用户进行多轮对话时的细微之处。以往的用户模拟研究侧重于生成逼真的用户话语，尚未探索模拟器作为助手回复直接反馈来源的潜力。此类评估信号可能不会通过语言明确表达，而可能存在于用户的潜在推理中。在这项工作中，我们提出具有内在反馈的用户模拟器，即配备潜在评估状态的模型：在每轮对话中，从第一人称用户视角评价助手的内心想法、反应和标量评分。我们使用真实用户与助手之间的交互日志训练基于 LLM 的模拟器，并证明，与提示式模拟器基线相比，内在反馈提升了模拟逼真度和批评能力，同时还能提供现有微调模拟器所缺乏的逐轮评估。此外，我们训练的模拟器生成的评估与人类判断的相关性高于同等规模的提示式模拟器。最后，实验表明，具有内在反馈的模拟器能为多轮 RL 训练提供有效的奖励信号；与依赖外部评判 LLM 提供奖励的设置效果相当，同时将 RL 计算量削减了一半以上。

    多流注意力残差

    Xiaohan Qin, Xiangdong Zhang, Tuo Dai, Sunan Zou, Huaijin Wu, Yebin Yang, Zhuo Xia, Lin Yao, Yuliang Liu, Junchi Yan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MSAR is a residual architecture that retrieves and adaptively mixes representations across network depth, with experiments showing improved model performance and compute efficiency. This is a substantial contribution to model computation, but the abstract does not claim compositional generalization, reasoning mechanisms, or analysis of internal representations.

    MSAR 是一种残差架构，可跨网络深度检索并自适应混合表征；实验显示其提升了模型性能和计算效率。这是对模型计算的重要贡献，但摘要未声称其能实现组合泛化、解释推理机制或分析内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Attention Residuals (AttnRes) enables content-dependent retrieval over network depth, which can be viewed as single-stream softmax attention along the depth axis. Inspired by the success of multi-head attention along the sequence axis, we introduce Multi-Stream Attention Residuals (MSAR), an extension of AttnRes that generalizes this mechanism to multi-head depth attention, yielding substantial performance gains with minimal additional overhead. MSAR draws stream diversity from sequence context through multi-scale causal convolutions, allowing different heads to retrieve historical representations through distinct contextual views while preserving the integrity of the hidden representation. The retrieved streams are combined through lightweight adaptive mixing to generate the single-stream layer input. By retaining single-stream sources and expanding them on demand, MSAR supports multi-stream computation without requiring persistent multi-stream storage or communication. Across all 12 downstream benchmarks at the 18B and 28B MoE scales, MSAR consistently outperforms prior residual variants, including standard residual connections, manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections (mHC), and AttnRes. Scaling-law experiments yield an iso-loss compute speedup of $1.58\times$ over the standard residual baseline, compared with $1.35\times$ for AttnRes and $1.30\times$ for mHC. These results make MSAR a promising residual architecture for large-scale pre-training.

    中文

    注意力残差（Attention Residuals，AttnRes）能够实现跨网络深度的内容依赖检索，可视为沿深度轴进行的单流 softmax 注意力。受多头注意力沿序列轴取得成功的启发，我们提出多流注意力残差（Multi-Stream Attention Residuals，MSAR），这是 AttnRes 的扩展，将该机制推广到多头深度注意力，在仅增加极少额外开销的情况下带来显著性能提升。MSAR 通过多尺度因果卷积从序列上下文中获取流的多样性，使不同注意力头能够通过不同的上下文视角检索历史表征，同时保持隐藏表征的完整性。检索到的各流通过轻量级自适应混合进行组合，生成单流层输入。通过保留单流源并按需扩展，MSAR 支持多流计算，无需持久化多流存储或通信。在 18B 和 28B MoE 规模的全部 12 项下游基准上，MSAR 的表现始终优于先前的残差变体，包括标准残差连接、流形约束超连接（manifold-constrained Hyper-Connections，mHC）和 AttnRes。缩放定律实验表明，相较于标准残差基线，等损失计算速度提升为 $1.58\times$；相比之下，AttnRes 为 $1.35\times$，mHC 为 $1.30\times$。这些结果表明，MSAR 是一种适用于大规模预训练的前景良好的残差架构。

    Zhengyang Zhang, Jing Xiong, Hongzhou Lin, Juihui Chung, Zijian Zhang, Song Han, Sihao Liu, and Ligeng Zhu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HOA coordinates agent sessions through review, task-specific knowledge, and formal verification, reporting strong results on olympiad and proof tasks. This substantially advances problem-solving workflows and agent organization, while composition is only implicit in coordinating feedback channels and the abstract does not study compositional generalization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents are rapidly improving on long-horizon scientific and olympiad tasks. Recent systems have produced a Lean-formalized resolution of the Navier--Stokes problem and autonomous solutions to four open questions in the Erd\H{o}s Conjectures database. Yet neither system releases both its underlying model and complete inference stack. More broadly, a single agent session remains brittle on difficult problems: early errors can propagate, missing domain knowledge can stall progress, and apparent success can mask a misinterpretation or weakening of the original task. We introduce HOA (Humanize Olympiads Agent), an open, flow-level framework that coordinates multiple agent sessions through three complementary feedback channels. First, an independent reviewer evaluates each candidate and provides actionable feedback. Second, a structured wiki supplies task-specific knowledge that may be missing or unreliable in model pretraining. Third, a verifier checks generated Lean proofs against trusted challenge statements. With GPT-5.6 Sol, HOA achieves perfect scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI 2026, near-full marks on the IChO 2026 problem set, and solves all 672 problems (100%) on PutnamBench. On the Lean-Eval leaderboard, HOA ranks first, solving 251 of 304 problems (82.6%). We further evaluate HOA with open models. Using Kimi-K3, HOA achieves full scores on the IMO, IPhO, and IOI, and a gold-level score of 97.1% on the IChO. These results closely match the closed-source GPT-5.6 Sol + /Goal baseline on the IMO and IPhO, while exceeding it on the IChO and IOI, demonstrating that systematic feedback can help bridge substantial differences in base-model capability.

    审视测试时强化 LLM 的幂采样

    Abiel Malkani Talwar, Christopher Nemeth, Henry Moss

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether power-distribution sampling improves LLM reasoning, finding that sampler gains largely reflect selecting likely sequences and that direct fine-tuning gives noisy, task-specific results. This provides substantial empirical evidence about a reasoning training and inference strategy, but the abstract does not investigate internal mechanisms, composition, or system organization.

    本文检验了幂分布采样能否提升 LLM 推理，发现采样器的收益大多来自选取高概率序列，而直接微调带来的结果则波动较大且依赖特定任务。这为一种推理训练和推理策略提供了重要的实验证据，但摘要没有研究内部机制、组合性或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved LLM reasoning, yet growing evidence suggests it mainly performs distribution sharpening: concentrating probability mass on reasoning paths the base model already produces. Recent work therefore seeks RLVR's gains without needing reward signals, by sampling from the power distribution $\pi_\alpha \propto \pi_{\text{base}}^\alpha$ via Markov chain Monte Carlo or sequential Monte Carlo. We show that these samplers fail to converge to $\pi_\alpha$ under realistic compute budgets, and that their gains are largely recreated via simple Best-of-$N$ with appropriate grading . This suggests they succeed by selecting high-probability sequences, not by approximating $\pi_\alpha$, raising a natural question: is the power distribution itself a worthwhile target? We test this hypothesis directly by fine-tuning the base model to match $\pi_\alpha$, sidestepping sampler convergence issues entirely. Despite approximating the target far more faithfully than existing samplers, this strategy yields gains that are noisy and specific to certain models and sampling tasks. Together, our results suggest that the value of power sampling lies not in faithfully targeting $\pi_\alpha$, but in the simpler goal of extracting sequences the base model already deems likely.

    中文

    带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）显著提升了 LLM 的推理能力，但越来越多的证据表明，它主要进行的是分布锐化：将概率质量集中到基础模型本就会生成的推理路径上。因此，近期研究试图无需奖励信号，通过马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛或序贯蒙特卡洛从幂分布 $\pi_\alpha \propto \pi_{\text{base}}^\alpha$ 中采样，以获得 RLVR 带来的提升。我们表明，在现实的计算预算下，这些采样器无法收敛到 $\pi_\alpha$；通过适当评分，简单的 Best-of-$N$ 也能在很大程度上复现它们带来的收益。这表明它们成功的原因是选出了高概率序列，而非逼近 $\pi_\alpha$，由此自然引出一个问题：幂分布本身是否值得作为目标？我们通过直接微调基础模型使其匹配 $\pi_\alpha$ 来检验这一假设，从而完全绕过采样器收敛问题。尽管这种策略对目标分布的逼近比现有采样器忠实得多，但其收益波动较大，且仅对特定模型和采样任务有效。综上，我们的结果表明，幂采样的价值不在于忠实地瞄准 $\pi_\alpha$，而在于更简单的目标：提取基础模型本就认为可能性较高的序列。

This paper addresses the automatic tuning of these components and proposes a framework transferable across models of different nature. The multi-agent large language model (LLM) framework has three roles---analyst, coder, and recorder~---with an experiment log and a sandboxed execution environment. Unlike systems that optimize the entire ML script or search architectures in a discrete space, the framework operates over an open but semantically narrow space: the agent generates code only for the specified components, leaving the overall network structure unchanged. The approach is validated in two directions: tuning a classification spiking neural network with correlation learning, and solving high-order differential equations with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN). Across five tasks---spiking classification on MNIST and Digits, and boundary-value problems for the generalized nonlinear Schr\"odinger equation (GNLSE) and Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS) equations---the agent outperforms the baselines: classification accuracy is 13 percentage points (MNIST) and 6 percentage points (Digits) higher; the error against the analytical single-soliton solution is reduced approximately 2491-fold; the invariant-preservation error drops approximately 325-fold in the selected GNLSE run with a Gaussian perturbation and by more than 100-fold on average over repeated initializations; and the mass drift drops 14-fold for the KS problem with a Gaussian perturbation. The framework thus tunes key components on tasks of different nature without changing its internal structure.

    中文

    许多机器学习方法分为两个层次：专家先选择一类方法，而在该类别中，关键组件的选择至关重要，且通常依赖人工完成。本文针对这些组件的自动调优问题，提出一个可迁移到不同类型模型的框架。该多智能体大型语言模型（LLM）框架包含三个角色——分析员、编码员和记录员——并配有实验日志和沙盒执行环境。与优化整个机器学习脚本或在离散空间中搜索架构的系统不同，该框架在开放但语义范围较窄的空间中运行：智能体只针对指定组件生成代码，整体网络结构保持不变。我们从两个方向验证该方法：调优具有相关性学习的分类脉冲神经网络，以及求解高阶微分方程的物理信息神经网络（Physics-Informed Neural Networks，PINN）。在五项任务中——MNIST 和 Digits 上的脉冲分类，以及广义非线性薛定谔方程（GNLSE）和 Kuramoto--Sivashinsky（KS）方程的边值问题——智能体均优于基线：分类准确率在 MNIST 上高出 13 个百分点，在 Digits 上高出 6 个百分点；相较于解析单孤子解的误差约降低 2491 倍；在选定的带高斯扰动 GNLSE 运行中，不变量保持误差约降低 325 倍，在重复初始化上的平均降低超过 100 倍；对于带高斯扰动的 KS 问题，质量漂移降低 14 倍。因此，该框架无需改变自身内部结构，即可在不同性质的任务上调优关键组件。

    Ronghan Li, Fei Chen, Mingyu Lu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates a staged, policy-relative difficulty curriculum for GRPO and finds that moderate progression improves math accuracy while further progression hurts it. This is a substantial contribution to training reasoning capabilities, while curriculum sequencing alone provides only an incidental connection to compositional generalization.

    本文评估了一种相对于策略分阶段调整难度的课程，并发现适度递进能提高数学准确率，而进一步递进则会使准确率下降。这对推理能力训练作出了实质性贡献，而仅凭课程排序与组合泛化的联系较为间接。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Curriculum learning typically organizes training samples from easy to hard. In GRPO, medium-difficulty samples are attractive for online selection because they are more likely to yield informative group-relative learning signals, and prioritizing them can improve training efficiency. However, it remains unclear whether persistently selecting such samples also leads to the strongest final model performance, or whether training can benefit from progressing toward harder samples. Meanwhile, sample difficulty changes as the policy evolves, so fixed difficulty estimates can become misaligned with the current policy. We therefore re-estimate sample difficulty under the current policy and, inspired by the easy-to-hard principle of curriculum learning, design and evaluate a staged curriculum that progressively shifts the active difficulty band toward harder samples. Experiments on GSM8K show that persistent medium-difficulty selection does not achieve the strongest observed performance. Across three random seeds, progressing to a moderately harder difficulty band improves test accuracy to $0.6591 \pm 0.0077$, compared with $0.6449 \pm 0.0024$ for the fixed-medium curriculum. However, further progression to a harder difficulty band reduces accuracy to $0.6405 \pm 0.0053$. These results show that staged difficulty progression can outperform persistent medium-difficulty selection, but its benefit is non-monotonic. Effective GRPO curricula can therefore benefit from progressing beyond medium difficulty, while avoiding excessive progression toward overly difficult samples.}

    中文

    课程学习通常将训练样本按从易到难的顺序组织。在 GRPO 中，中等难度的样本适合在线选择，因为它们更可能产生有信息量的组相对学习信号，优先选择这些样本可以提高训练效率。然而，持续选择这类样本是否也能带来最强的最终模型性能，或者训练是否能从逐步转向更难的样本中受益，目前仍不清楚。同时，随着策略不断演进，样本难度也会变化，因此固定的难度估计可能与当前策略不再匹配。因此，我们在当前策略下重新估计样本难度，并受课程学习由易到难原则的启发，设计并评估了一种分阶段课程，逐步将当前训练的难度区间转向更难的样本。在 GSM8K 上的实验表明，持续选择中等难度样本并未达到观测到的最佳性能。在三个随机种子下，将训练转向难度适度提高的区间，可将测试准确率提升至 $0.6591 \pm 0.0077$与固定中等难度课程的 $0.6449 \pm 0.0024$ 相比。然而，进一步转向更难的难度区间会使准确率降至 $0.6405 \pm 0.0053$。这些结果表明，分阶段递进难度可以优于持续选择中等难度样本，但其益处并非单调变化。因此，有效的 GRPO 课程可以从超越中等难度中受益，同时应避免过度转向过于困难的样本。}

    Weiqi Sun, Qianyue Wu, Wenjia Wang, Tianyang Hu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s central contribution is an outlier-aware quadratic kernel for linear-time attention approximation, with dimension grouping and evaluation in pretrained-model conversion. This advances efficient model computation, while its dimension analysis concerns approximation design rather than internal representations; improved benchmark scores alone do not establish reasoning or compositional insight.

    本文的核心贡献是一种用于线性时间注意力近似的离群值感知二次核，其中采用维度分组，并在预训练模型转换中进行评估。这推动了高效模型计算的发展；其维度分析针对的是近似设计，而非内部表征；仅凭基准分数提升不足以证明推理或组合方面的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Linearizing softmax attention offers a route to efficient Transformer inference, but preserving pretrained attention remains challenging. We identify an important source of approximation error overlooked by standard linearization methods: a small number of outlier dimensions contribute disproportionately to query-key dot products and account for a large fraction of the approximation error. Motivated by this heterogeneity, we propose Outlier-Aware Attention Linearization (OAL), a dimension-aware method for constructing quadratic attention approximations. Starting from a second-order Taylor approximation, we introduce a Hadamard-product formulation that makes individual query-key contributions explicit. This formulation relaxes globally shared coefficients to support dimension-specific linear terms and cross-dimensional quadratic interactions while preserving separable evaluation. To retain this flexibility with fewer parameters, OAL groups dimensions with similar contribution scales to share coefficients, while allowing distinct treatment of the few outliers. The resulting positive quadratic kernel is calibrated against pretrained attention outputs and admits linear-time evaluation with respect to sequence length for fixed head dimensions. On Qwen2.5-0.5B, OAL reduces frozen-attention output relative MSE by approximately 8.9% compared with DiJiang. Replacing middle-layer attention modules and jointly fine-tuning the kernel coefficients with LoRA further lowers WikiText-103 perplexity from 31.71 to 27.50 compared with a learned global quadratic, while improving accuracy on PIQA, HellaSwag, and ARC-E. These results demonstrate the value of outlier-aware dimension grouping for both attention approximation and pretrained-model conversion. The code is available at https://github.com/wuqianyue09/OAL

    中文

    将 softmax 注意力线性化为高效的 Transformer 推理提供了一条路径，但要保留预训练注意力仍然颇具挑战。我们发现了标准线性化方法忽略的一项重要近似误差来源：少数离群维度对查询—键点积的贡献异常突出，并造成了很大一部分近似误差。受这种异质性的启发，我们提出离群值感知注意力线性化（OAL），这是一种用于构造二次注意力近似的维度感知方法。我们从二阶泰勒近似出发，引入一种 Hadamard 乘积形式，使各个查询—键贡献显式可见。该形式放宽了全局共享系数的限制，支持维度特定的线性项和跨维度二次交互，同时保留可分离计算。为以更少参数保留这种灵活性，OAL 将贡献尺度相似的维度分组并共享系数，同时允许对少数离群维度作不同处理。由此得到的正二次核针对预训练注意力输出进行校准，并且在头维度固定时，能够以关于序列长度线性的时间复杂度进行计算。在 Qwen2.5-0.5B 上，与 DiJiang 相比，OAL 将冻结注意力输出的相对 MSE 降低了约 8.9%。替换中间层注意力模块，并与 LoRA 联合微调核系数后，与学习得到的全局二次核相比，WikiText-103 困惑度从 31.71 进一步降至 27.50，同时提升了 PIQA、HellaSwag 和 ARC-E 上的准确率。这些结果表明，离群值感知维度分组对注意力近似和预训练模型转换均有价值。代码见 https://github.com/wuqianyue09/OAL

    Variance-Reduced Policy Gradient is Nearly Minimax-Optimal

    方差缩减策略梯度近乎达到极小极大最优

    Leonardo Cesani, Matteo Papini, Marcello Restelli

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a first-order variance-reduced policy-gradient framework and proves near-minimax sample complexity for convergence, a substantial contribution to reasoning-related optimization and learning. Its focus is policy optimization rather than internal model mechanisms, compositionality, or system design.

    本文提出一阶方差缩减策略梯度框架，并证明其收敛所需的样本复杂度近乎达到极小极大最优，对推理相关的优化与学习作出了实质性贡献。本文关注的是策略优化，而非模型内部机制、组合性或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Standard Policy Gradient (PG) algorithms suffer from high estimation variance because they rely on Monte Carlo updates. While off-policy variance reduction mitigates this problem, establishing optimal sample complexity currently requires either restrictive assumptions, such as uniformly bounded importance weights, or impractical second-order operations. In this work, we introduce Loopless Variance-Reduced PG (LVR-PG), a unified theoretical framework that abstracts a class of first-order estimators that integrate recursive updates with defensive importance sampling, including known estimators such as PAGE-PG and STORM-PG. We prove that this algorithmic class achieves $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ last-iterate global convergence under weak gradient domination for general parametric policies. We establish this guarantee using purely first-order updates, with minimal assumptions and without gradient preconditioners. By extending state-of-the-art lower bounds to continuous parametric policies, we establish an $\Omega(\epsilon^{-2})$ sample complexity limit, confirming our framework is minimax-optimal up to logarithmic factors and horizon terms.

    中文

    标准策略梯度（PG）算法依赖蒙特卡洛更新，因此估计方差较高。离策略方差缩减可以缓解这一问题，但要证明最优样本复杂度，目前要么需要严格假设，例如重要性权重一致有界，要么需要不切实际的二阶运算。在这项工作中，我们提出无循环方差缩减 PG（LVR-PG），这是一个统一的理论框架，用于抽象一类将递归更新与防御性重要性采样相结合的一阶估计器，其中包括 PAGE-PG 和 STORM-PG 等已知估计器。我们证明，对于一般的参数化策略，这类算法在弱梯度支配条件下实现 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\epsilon^{-2})$ 的最后迭代点全局收敛。我们仅使用一阶更新，在假设条件最少且无需梯度预条件器的情况下建立了这一保证。通过将当前最优下界扩展到连续参数化策略，我们得出了 $\Omega(\epsilon^{-2})$ 样本复杂度下限，证实该框架除对数因子和时域项外达到了极小极大最优。

    ENGLISH

    Long-context serving runs out of KV memory before the hardware reaches its useful throughput. HiSparse stores history in host memory and fetches only the selected entries, but it uses one cache budget at every load and does not handle draft-model speculative decoding such as DSpark and DFlash2. We present Adaptive DHiSparse, which supports speculative decoding over hierarchical sparse KV and adapts residency to load. It protects the required working set, retains additional history while GPU memory is spare, and recovers the rest through exact fused retrieval. DSpark and DFlash2 keep their proposal and acceptance rules: queries share missing-row retrieval, draft KV uses a window-bounded ring, and verification staging is reused across layer groups. At 100K context and concurrency 128, GLM-5.3 with DFlash2 delivers 793 output tokens/s per decode GPU, 1.45$\times$ HiSparse and 1.27$\times$ non-speculative adaptive serving. Held to the same latency bounds as HiSparse, it sustains up to 4$\times$ the concurrency and 2.3 to 3.7$\times$ the output, depending on the per-token bound. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at 500K context and concurrency 512, Adaptive DHiSparse with DSpark delivers 1.85$\times$ the output of resident serving with DSpark. In a load step, optional residency reduces host fetches from 14.2% to 1.4% of selected rows at low load and releases memory under pressure.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Legal language understanding requires reasoning over semi-structured regulatory documents, yet standard pre-training objectives do not explicitly target this structural capability. Because current legal language models rely solely on masked language modeling, they treat statutory text as flat token sequences and ignore the underlying hierarchical constraints. To bridge this gap, we present a multi-task pre-training approach for German traffic law (StVO). Our approach combines three complementary objectives: Next Sentence Prediction (NSP), Knowledge Graph (KG) Guided Clustering (CLU), and Knowledge Graph (KG) Aware Paragraph Classification (CLS). This approach explicitly encodes structured legal knowledge directly into the model weights. This encoding enables zero-shot legal reasoning at inference time and removes the need for discrete graph traversal. We evaluate our approach across nine Transformer-based encoders and 324 experimental runs. On synthetic StVO question answering, our models demonstrate consistent relative improvements between 10.3% and 155.0% over baselines. Furthermore, relative to the established LexGLUE baselines (Chalkidis et al., 2022), our models improve over prior results on four of seven legal benchmarks. It also achieves consistent zero-shot transfer gains between 3.4% and 15.8% on Austrian driving regulations. These experimental results indicate that our training approach generalizes successfully beyond the initial training legal domain.

However, the strongest models rely on video diffusion transformers that are far too computationally expensive for resource-constrained edge devices. Trained in 3.6 GPU-hours, SmolWAM succeeds in 95.5% of 400 LIBERO episodes at 57 ms and 2.3 TFLOP per 16-action chunk with 2.4 GiB of GPU memory, 11x faster than its teacher with 18.5x fewer FLOPs and 3.2x less memory, and its world head still forecasts scene motion.

    Basic mathematical tasks like modular addition have been a valuable tool for illuminating aspects of neural network behavior that are challenging to see in noisy, unverifiable, large-scale, real-world settings. These studies have typically focused on a single task. However, modern language models are exposed to a vast number of tasks despite being trained with a next-token prediction objective. In this work, we introduce two mathematical task ecosystems, IntWorld and PermWorld, built from distinct but related tasks on integers and permutations. Both are designed to simulate task diversity within a cohesive mathematical 'world' where tasks are distinct but related. Because the datasets are procedurally generated, we can precisely vary the number of tasks, allowing us to begin to disentangle the role of task variety from other factors in training. After describing the datasets, we provide some initial results obtained from these datasets which support the idea that increasing task diversity increases the richness of a model's internal representations.

    MCGPO is a training procedure for assigning credit to intermediate agent actions from terminal feedback, with modest success gains across interactive environments. Its action matching uses contextual structure, but the abstract does not show compositional generalization; the main contribution is agent training and organization, not internal mechanisms or general reasoning capability.

    MCGPO 是一种训练方法，利用终局反馈为智能体的中间动作分配功劳，并在交互环境中取得了幅度不大的成功率提升。它的动作匹配利用了上下文结构，但摘要没有显示组合泛化；其主要贡献是智能体训练与组织，而非内部机制或通用推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Training long-horizon language model agents requires assigning credit to intermediate decisions from sparse terminal feedback. Within a finite group of sibling rollouts, useful action comparisons depend on their context, evidence for both alternatives, and how that evidence enters learning. We propose Matched-Context Group Policy Optimization (MCGPO), a procedure for constructing weighted action preferences from already collected trajectories. MCGPO defines comparison contexts with pre-action state summaries and observed rubric progress, annotated by task rules. Two-action support selects among ordered exact and coarse matching rules. Fixed folds separate candidate decisions from the terminal outcomes used to orient their preferences, and support-dependent evidence weights scale an auxiliary pairwise objective alongside shared GraphGPO task learning. MCGPO reuses rollout data and each response's original history, preserving critic-free training. Across six environment-backbone settings with three training seeds each, MCGPO improves mean success over matched GraphGPO: by 0.47-1.46 percentage points on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B and 7B, and by 3.96 and 5.16 points on WebShop with Qwen3-4B and 8B. The ALFWorld gains build on baseline success above 92%, where remaining headroom is limited. Integrated success improves in three of four Qwen2.5 settings. Three-seed factorial controls support opposite-fold evidence and evidence weighting; joint state-rubric matching achieves the highest mean in all four representation-control settings.

    Ze-Wei Liou, Harris Nover, Amey Naik, Andrii Skliar, Igor Shovkun, Ido Shahaf, Tri Dao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ReplaySSM changes recurrent-state management for efficient decoding, speculative rollback, and lower-precision output computation, with implementations and serving results across hybrid models. Its memory and computation design substantially advances model systems, while the abstract gives no evidence of interpretability, compositional generalization, or reasoning contributions.

    ReplaySSM 改变了循环状态管理方式，以实现高效解码、推测回滚和低精度输出计算，并在多种混合模型上进行了实现和服务测试。其内存与计算设计显著推动了模型系统的发展，但摘要没有提供关于可解释性、组合泛化或推理贡献的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.

    中文

    状态空间模型（SSM）维持固定大小的循环状态，但在每个解码步骤中读写该状态可能成为混合模型的瓶颈。这种急切的状态管理会造成大量状态 I/O，而算术强度较低；它使推测解码无法廉价回滚，还会将状态量化误差带入后续循环更新。我们提出 ReplaySSM，通过展开递归，将状态表示为一个检查点和一个近期 SSM 输入缓冲区。这种做法将输出计算与检查点更新分离。通过定期更新检查点，ReplaySSM 在大多数步骤中避免写入状态，并将主要状态内存流量大致减半。保留近期输入也使推测回滚只需操作缓冲区指针，并支持无需物化中间状态的纯输出验证。同样的分离方式允许低精度检查点在大多数步骤中用于输出计算，同时由高精度检查点负责循环更新，因此低精度副本中的舍入误差永远不会进入后续更新。我们在 vLLM 中为 Mamba-2 和 Gated DeltaNet 实现了 ReplaySSM。在服务批次大小为 256 时，在四种混合模型上，相较于经过调优的 vLLM 基线，它使标准解码加速了 $1.20$–$1.47\times$ 倍；在两种 120B 级模型上，其吞吐量约为 vLLM 推测解码的 $1.8\times$ 倍。与共享的低精度检查点相比，分开设置状态精度还能降低输出 KL 散度和下游准确率损失。

    William Sheffield, Jiahui Chen, Amy Zhang, Alex Warstadt, Junyi Jessy Li, Kanishka Misra

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper combines behavioral and mechanistic analyses to localize units sensitive to discourse particles, finding asymmetric transfer patterns that suggest sense-organized lexical representations. This substantially informs representation mechanisms, while the transfer result is limited evidence about composition rather than a main compositional contribution.

    该论文结合行为分析和机制分析，定位了对话语助词敏感的单元，并发现不对称的迁移模式，表明词汇表征可能按义项组织。这为理解表征机制提供了重要信息；迁移结果则只为组合性提供了有限证据，并非论文的主要组合性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English "just" and "only" ("John only/just drinks water"). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to "just" and "only" in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to "just" compared to "only". Second, when sampling from LLMs with and without these particles, we find LLMs consistently rate generations as more likely, given their source context, demonstrating their particle sensitivity. In both experiments, instruction tuning increases sensitivity. Finally, we localize particle-sensitive units within LLMs and find the overlap between "just" and "only" is asymmetric: "only" units transfer selectively to exclusive "just", while all "just" units transfer to "only" equally well regardless of sense, suggesting LLM lexical-level particle representations are partially organized by sense. We release our code, sense-labeled dialogue stimuli, and human preference annotations at https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation.

    中文

    话语助词通过反映对话语境和交谈者态度，微妙地影响话语展开，往往不改变真值条件意义。它们也常具有多种功能，拥有彼此不同但与其他助词部分重叠的义项；例如，英语 “just” 和 “only” 的排他性用法（“John only/just drinks water”）。尽管这些词在自然语言中十分常见，但由于其影响微妙，长期以来鲜少受到研究。我们通过行为分析和机制分析，研究 LLM 在自然对话中对 “just” 和 “only” 的敏感性。首先，我们发现 LLM 和人类同样倾向于在语境中使用这些助词，而且两者对 “just” 的敏感程度都高于对 “only” 的敏感程度。其次，我们分别从包含和不包含这些助词的 LLM 输出中采样，发现 LLM 一贯认为这些生成内容在其源语境下更可能出现，表明它们对助词具有敏感性。在这两项实验中，指令微调都会提高敏感性。最后，我们定位了 LLM 内部对助词敏感的单元，并发现 “just” 和 “only” 之间的重叠具有不对称性：“only” 单元会选择性地迁移到排他性用法的 “just”，而所有 “just” 单元无论其义项如何，都能同样有效地迁移到 “only”。这表明，LLM 的词汇层级助词表征在一定程度上按义项组织。我们在 https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation 发布了代码、带义项标签的对话刺激材料以及人类偏好标注。

    梦中铭记：利用世界模型持续引导通用机器人策略

    Bahey Tharwat, Iman Nematollahi, Marvin Alles, Xingyuan Zhang, Akshay L Chandra, Abhinav Valada

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    D2R uses imagined rehearsal from a world model to retain earlier robot skills while continually steering a frozen policy toward new tasks, with results in simulation and on a real robot. The main contribution is a continual-learning and agent-system method; task sequences alone provide only an incidental connection to compositional generalization, and the abstract does not study reasoning mechanisms.

    D2R 利用世界模型进行想象式重演，在持续引导冻结策略学习新任务的同时保留先前的机器人技能，并在模拟环境和真实机器人上取得了结果。其主要贡献是一种持续学习和智能体系统方法；任务序列本身与组合泛化只有偶然联系，摘要也没有研究推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherwise, it learns the task in the environment while using the world model only to rehearse prior tasks. On CALVIN, D2R improves eight tasks in sequence entirely in imagination, raising average success from 63.7% to 74.8%, while LoRA fine-tuning on the same sequence drops it to 11.7%. With a frozen off-the-shelf generalist policy and world model, $\pi_0$ and A2World, D2R learns unseen LIBERO-90 tasks in the environment while keeping $\pi_0$'s performance on the LIBERO suites it was fine-tuned on, even though the world model is not accurate enough for policy optimization. Finally, on a real Franka robot, D2R improves three tasks in sequence entirely in imagination while retaining the earlier improvements.

    中文

    通用机器人策略通过模仿学习训练，其能力受演示数据的质量和覆盖范围限制。强化学习可以通过微调策略权重，或训练一个小型模块来引导冻结生成策略的输入噪声，从而改进和扩展这些策略。当任务按顺序到来时，这两种方法都会遭遇灾难性遗忘。针对一个任务进行微调会损害先前任务的表现，而引导方法只是将遗忘转移到了共享引导模块上。我们提出 Dream to Remember（D2R），它持续引导冻结的通用策略学习新任务，同时保留先前技能。当引导模块学习新任务时，一个冻结的预训练世界模型通过想象 rollout 重演先前任务，使模块保持原有行为，而无需使用重放缓冲区或新数据。如果世界模型足够忠实，D2R 就能完全在想象中学习新任务；否则，它会在环境中学习该任务，同时仅用世界模型重演先前任务。在 CALVIN 上，D2R 完全通过想象按顺序改进了八项任务，将平均成功率从 63.7% 提升到 74.8%；在相同任务序列上进行 LoRA 微调则使成功率降至 11.7%。使用冻结的现成通用策略和世界模型 $\pi_0$ 与 A2World 时，D2R 在环境中学习了未见过的 LIBERO-90 任务，同时保持了 $\pi_0$ 在其经过微调的 LIBERO 套件上的表现，尽管该世界模型的准确度不足以用于策略优化。最后，在真实的 Franka 机器人上，D2R 完全通过想象按顺序改进了三项任务，同时保留了先前的改进。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SpatialASM trains vision-language models to plan viewpoints and imagine scenes during spatial problem solving, improving results across seven benchmarks.     SpatialASM 训练视觉语言模型在空间问题求解中规划视角并想象场景，在七个基准上提升了表现。这显著推进了空间推理，但摘要没有直接提供有关内部表征、组合泛化或智能体系统设计的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.

    普通人在解决复杂空间推理任务时，会自然地从与任务相关的视角重新审视场景，并在头脑中从这些视角重建空间布局。但大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）能否主动以同样的方式思考？我们将这种能力称为主动空间心理化（ASM），它是视觉智能的内在组成部分，但在当前 LVLM 中仍远未充分发展。为弥补这一差距，我们提出 SpatialASM，这是一种可扩展框架，通过训练时空间模拟将 ASM 内化到 LVLM 中。SpatialASM 使用一个以自我中心以外视角生成新视图的生成器，将假设视角锚定于视觉证据，并提供两种互补的监督形式：i）显式 ASM 轨迹，教会 LVLM 在空间推理过程中何时以及如何自适应地调用视角规划和想象；ii）自动构造的视角转换任务，进一步强化以视角为条件的场景想象。在七个基准上，从偏重感知的空间理解到更具挑战性的多图像、跨视图和视角变换推理任务，SpatialASM 提升了四种 LVLM 骨干模型的空间推理表现，同时保留了其原有的通用视觉能力。实验结果表明，我们的方法提高了七个空间基准上的平均准确率。此外，合成 ASM 轨迹为缓解空间思维链（CoT）监督稀缺提供了一条可扩展途径，有助于激发主动视角探索和心理场景模拟。

    Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates snapshot-based branching as a search strategy for recovering progress in coding agents, finding that runtime state outside the repository drives much of the benefit. This is a substantial contribution to agent execution and state management, while the coding-task context alone provides only an incidental connection to reasoning and none to interpretability or compositional generalization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.

    中文

    编程智能体常在失败前已取得有用进展，但从头重试会丢弃过程中创建的机器状态。这使失败恢复成为一个有意思的搜索问题：如果中间环境状态保留了有意义的进展，那么从这些状态恢复并分支搜索，可能胜过反复从初始状态重新开始。我们在完整的 Daytona 快照上实现了 Go-Explore 风格的搜索，发现更高且更有效的求解率主要取决于仓库之外的进展，例如数据库、服务和其他运行时状态。我们的结果表明，当长时程编程工作涉及多个服务，且其状态无法通过单个差异文件重建时，完整快照搜索最为有效。

    Inference-Time Steering Across Scaffolds and Epitopes for Sample-Efficient De Novo Nanobody Design

    跨支架与表位的推理时引导，实现样本高效的从头纳米抗体设计

    Mason Minot, Simon Friedensohn, C\'edric R. Weber

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper’s main contribution is dynamic allocation of inference compute across nanobody design configurations using SMC and successive elimination. This advances adaptive compute allocation, while the molecular design application alone offers no substantive interpretability, compositionality, or reasoning insight.

    该论文的主要贡献是利用 SMC 和逐次淘汰，在不同纳米抗体设计配置之间动态分配推理算力。这推进了自适应算力分配；分子设计这一应用本身并未带来实质性的可解释性、组合性或推理洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Generative molecular design typically relies on over-generation and post-hoc filtering. Inference-time steering methods like Feynman-Kac (FK) steering improve efficiency by biasing trajectories toward high-reward candidates, yet they optimize within a single fixed configuration. In de novo nanobody design, upfront commitment to conditioning choices like scaffold identity or target epitope creates a bottleneck. Since yield varies across these conditions, steering unpromising setups wastes compute. We recast generative condition selection as an inference-time resource-allocation problem. We propose two dynamic budget allocators: a joint Global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) formulation that steers and allocates compute across configurations concurrently, and a decoupled approach adapting Batched Successive Elimination (BaSE). Empirically, these dynamic allocators increase the yield of designable candidates per GPU-hour nearly 5$\times$ without sacrificing diversity across distinct therapeutic targets and generative configurations.

    中文

    生成式分子设计通常依赖过量生成和事后筛选。Feynman-Kac（FK）引导等推理时引导方法通过使轨迹偏向高奖励候选来提高效率，但它们只在单一固定配置内进行优化。在从头设计纳米抗体时，预先确定支架身份或靶标表位等条件选择会形成瓶颈。由于不同条件下的产出率各异，对前景不佳的设置进行引导会浪费算力。我们将生成条件选择重新表述为推理时资源分配问题。我们提出两种动态预算分配器：一种联合的全局序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）方案，可同时引导不同配置并分配计算资源；另一种是采用分批逐次淘汰（BaSE）的解耦方案。实证结果显示，这些动态分配器使每 GPU 小时产出的可设计候选数量提高了近 5$\times$，同时不牺牲不同治疗靶标和生成配置之间的多样性。

    X-AgentRed: Red-Teaming Personal Agents in Evolving Multi-Service Ecosystems

    X-AgentRed：在不断演进的多服务生态系统中对个人智能体进行红队测试

    Yeonsung Jung, Zhiyuan Wang, Zifan Wang, V\'itor Albiero, Benjamin Newman, Edoardo Debenedetti, Ivan Evtimov, Ninareh Mehrabi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    X-AgentRed builds and refines tool-dependency paths with execution feedback to find harmful outcomes in personal agents, and reports gains in path rate and tool coverage. Its explicit composition of tool effects and preconditions offers partial compositional insight, while the main contribution is an agent red-teaming system rather than a study of internal mechanisms or reasoning.

    X-AgentRed 构建并利用执行反馈优化工具依赖路径，以发现个人智能体可能造成的有害结果，并报告了有害路径率和工具覆盖率的提升。它对工具效果与前提条件的显式组合提供了部分组合性洞见；但其主要贡献是智能体红队测试系统，而非对内部机制或推理的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Personal agents increasingly connect to services across the web and applications by using tools. As the effects of their actions accumulate and interact across services, unintended or harmful outcomes can arise when agents fulfill benign user requests. Proactively identifying these compositional failures requires systematically exploring diverse cross-service paths. Existing red-teaming methods often simply prompt LLMs to identify potentially harmful paths from task and environment descriptions or decompose harmful objectives specified by humans or LLMs into seemingly benign action combinations. However, generation is biased toward patterns learned during training, potentially favoring familiar tool combinations and leaving novel cross-service interactions underexplored. To address this, we propose X-AgentRed, a self-evolving red-teaming framework that discovers harmful tool call paths through a graph of tool dependencies and expands and refines them using execution feedback. By analyzing each tool's effects, potential harms, and preconditions for execution, the red-teaming agent constructs a directed graph that captures how one tool's effects can satisfy another's execution preconditions. Recipes sampled from this graph are instantiated as realistic scenarios in which agents can produce harmful outcomes. Execution feedback enables self-improvement by diversifying paths that produce harm through tool substitution and refining preconditions at blocked steps in unsuccessful paths to enable further execution. Across four frontier agentic models, X-AgentRed achieves $1.77\times$ the harmful path rate of STAC and explores a more diverse set of tools, yielding $2.99\times$ the tool coverage on average.

    中文

    个人智能体越来越多地通过工具连接网络和应用中的各类服务。当其行动效果在不同服务间累积并相互作用时，即使智能体是在满足用户的无害请求，也可能产生意外或有害结果。要主动识别这些组合性失效，就需要系统地探索多样化的跨服务路径。现有红队测试方法通常只是提示 LLM 根据任务和环境描述找出潜在有害路径，或将人类或 LLM 指定的有害目标分解为看似无害的行动组合。然而，生成结果会受到训练期间所学模式的偏向，可能偏好熟悉的工具组合，而未能充分探索新颖的跨服务交互。为解决这一问题，我们提出 X-AgentRed，这是一种自我演进的红队测试框架，通过工具依赖关系图发现有害的工具调用路径，并利用执行反馈对其进行扩展和优化。红队智能体通过分析每种工具的效果、潜在危害和执行前提条件，构建有向图，以表示一种工具的效果如何满足另一种工具的执行前提条件。从该图中采样的方案会被实例化为真实场景，在这些场景中智能体可能产生有害结果。执行反馈可以实现自我改进：通过替换工具来扩展能够造成危害的路径，并优化失败路径中受阻步骤的前提条件，以使路径得以继续执行。在四种前沿智能体模型上，X-AgentRed 的有害路径率达到 STAC 的 $1.77\times$ 倍，并探索了更多样的工具，平均工具覆盖率达到 $2.99\times$。

    RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics

    RATED：通过执行动态实现可靠性感知的 AI 智能体工具检索

    Weiliang Chen, Song Liao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RATED contributes a contextual-bandit method for adapting tool retrieval to runtime failures and a benchmark for evaluating reliability. Its agent-tool focus is incidental to reasoning, while its retrieval and execution-feedback design gives a substantial systems contribution.

    RATED 提出一种上下文老虎机方法，使工具检索能够适应运行时故障，并提供了一个用于评估可靠性的基准。其智能体工具主题与推理只有偶然联系，而其检索和执行反馈设计则对系统领域作出了重要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.

    中文

    随着 AI 智能体越来越依赖外部工具，准确检索对于可靠行为至关重要。现有方法优化语义相关性，却基本忽略了执行期间工具是否可用。为弥补这一缺口，我们提出 RATED（通过执行动态实现可靠性感知的工具检索），这是一种结合稳健语义匹配与动态可靠性适应的检索框架。RATED 使用经过对比微调的冻结双编码器进行语义匹配，并采用轻量级上下文老虎机模块，根据实时执行反馈重新排列候选项。该设计无需昂贵的模型重新训练，即可快速适应运行时工具故障。我们推出 EcoAgent，这是一个包含 5,172 种真实世界工具和超过 210,000 个查询—工具对的基准，用于离线检索和动态可靠性评估。实验结果表明，在真实世界查询上，RATED 相较于 ToolLLM API 检索器的 MRR 相对提升了 52.2%；在 API 故障率为 30% 的严重宕机场景下，故障工具选择率从 86.2% 降至 2.9%，同时相较于仅编码推理的延迟开销可忽略不计，不到 1 毫秒。代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent 获取。
